title: Admissions Specialist
description:
Bradford Health Services is seeking an Admissions Specialist to add to our dynamic team. The Admissions Specialist plays a critical role in facilitating the intake process for individuals seeking behavioral health services. This position is responsible for managing all aspects of admissions documentation, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and confidentiality throughout the process. The specialist serves as a primary point of contact for prospective clients and their families, providing clear communication and support to guide them through admission procedures. By coordinating with clinical and administrative teams, the Admissions Specialist helps to streamline patient flow and optimize service delivery. Ultimately, this role contributes to the organization's mission by ensuring timely and compassionate access to behavioral health care.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct thorough intake assessments and gather necessary documentation for behavioral health admissions.
  • Verify insurance coverage and eligibility to facilitate smooth admission processes.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records in compliance with regulatory standards and organizational policies.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, families, and healthcare providers to coordinate admission logistics and answer inquiries.
  • Collaborate with clinical staff to ensure timely placement and appropriate care planning for incoming patients.
  • Monitor and update admission status and documentation within electronic health record systems.
  • Assist in resolving any issues or barriers that may delay or complicate the admission process.


Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree or higher preferred.
  • Experience working in behavioral health settings or related healthcare environments.
  • Proficiency in admissions documentation and data entry.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA regulations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, social work, psychology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems and insurance verification processes.
  • Experience in customer service or patient advocacy within behavioral health.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health terminology and treatment modalities.
  • Certification related to healthcare admissions or behavioral health services.


Skills

The Admissions Specialist utilizes behavioral health knowledge daily to understand client needs and the nuances of mental health care admissions. Proficiency in admissions documentation ensures that all client information is accurately recorded and compliant with legal standards, which is essential for smooth processing and billing. Strong communication skills are employed to interact compassionately and clearly with clients, families, and clinical teams, facilitating trust and cooperation. Organizational skills are critical for managing multiple admissions simultaneously while maintaining meticulous records. Additionally, familiarity with healthcare software and insurance processes supports efficient verification and data management, reducing delays and improving overall patient experience.

description:

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Position Location:
This is aFlexible (Hybrid) position. Flexible positions require 2 days per week in a ServiceNow office location. We have offices in several locations, including San Francisco, CA; Pleasanton, CA; Santa Clara, CA; San Diego, CA; and Kirkland, WA

Please Note:This position will includesupporting our US Regulated Markets.
“This position requires passing a ServiceNow background screening, USFedPASS (US Federal Personnel Authorization Screening Standards). This includes a credit check, criminal/misdemeanor check and taking a drug test. Any employment is contingent upon passing the screening.Due to Federal requirements, only US citizens, US naturalized citizens or US Permanent Residents, holding a green card, will be considered.


About the team:
We are seeking aSenior Staff Software Engineer(IC5 Level) to join our Data Platform Engineering organization. You will be a hands-on technical lead who will leadthe design and delivery of shared, multi-tenant platform services — Postgres, queueing/streaming, and key-value stores — on Kubernetes, and serves as the technical anchor for their availability, resilience, and operating model.

What you get to do in this role:

  • You will lead the design and delivery of shared platform services — managed Postgres, queueing/streaming, and key-value/cache — that run on Kubernetes across a large global fleet and that product teams across the company depend on, owning them from design through production operation.
  • You will act as the technical lead on major initiatives within your team, breaking down ambiguous problems — “offer HA Postgres as a service to every cluster,” “make our queueing tier survive a zone loss” — into clear, executable designs with explicit availability, durability, and cost targets.
  • You will define the HA, failover, disaster-recovery, and multi-region architecture for the services you own, and the Kubernetes-native automation (operators, controllers, CRDs, self-service APIs) that provisions, scales, upgrades, and fails them over without human intervention.
  • You will partner with principal and distinguished engineers to align your work with the broader platform architecture and standards, and with product teams to set consumption contracts, tenancy models, and SLOs for shared services.
  • You will identify technical risks early and drive them to resolution, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and operability — leading failure-mode analysis, game days, and post-incident reviews for stateful systems.
  • You will spend significant time hands-on — designing, coding, and reviewing the core systems your team builds, such as operators, controllers, infrastructure automation, and platform services.
  • You will mentor mid-level and junior engineers and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing — particularly around distributed-systems and data-service design.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work — whether using AI-powered tooling, automating operational workflows, building agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
  • 12+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree; OR 8+ years witha Master's degree; OR 5+ years with a PhD; OR equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years building production software, with solid experience operating distributed systems and running stateful workloads on Kubernetes at scale.
  • A track record of leading the design and delivery of at least one shared, multi-tenant infrastructure service used broadly by other teams — a relational database service (Postgres or similar), a message queue or streaming platform (Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar), or a key-value/cache service (Redis/Valkey, etcd, or similar) — including its HA, failover, and operating model.
  • Deep understanding of high availability and failure handling: replication topologies, leader election, quorum and consensus, split-brain avoidance, backup/restore and point-in-time recovery, and designing to explicit RPO/RTO and durability targets.
  • Strong system design skills — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, partitioning and rebalancing, capacity planning, tenant isolation, and noisy-neighbor mitigation, and communicate the trade-offs clearly to engineers and stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP), including its core compute, networking, storage, and IAM primitives.
  • Strong working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes (including stateful primitives: StatefulSets, CSI/persistent storage, PDBs, topology spread), CI/CD and GitOps-based delivery, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Strong programming skills in Go (or strong systems-language skills with a willingness to work primarily in Go).

It also helps if you have:

  • Experience building or extending Kubernetes operators that manage stateful systems (e.g., CloudNativePG, Zalando/Crunchy Postgres operators, Strimzi, Redis/Valkey operators), and opinions on when to adopt versus build.
  • Deep expertise in one of the target systems: Postgres internals (WAL, streaming/logical replication, vacuum, connection pooling with PgBouncer/PgCat, major-version upgrades); Kafka/NATS (partitioning, ISR/replication, exactly-once semantics, consumer scaling); or Redis/Valkey (cluster mode, persistence, eviction, hot-key handling).
  • Experience running data services across multiple regions or clusters — cross-region replication, failover orchestration, and DR testing.
  • Experience with zero-downtime upgrades, schema/data migrations, and fleet-wide rollouts of stateful services.
  • Experience with observability and SLOs for stateful systems — replication lag, saturation, tail latency, error budgets — and with capacity and cost management for shared infrastructure.
  • Experience designing multi-tenancy: quotas, isolation, chargeback/showback, and self-service provisioning APIs or CRDs.
  • Experience with container networking (CNI) and/or service mesh, and with workload identity, mTLS, and secrets management as applied to data services.
  • Experience with managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), managed data services (RDS/Aurora, Cloud SQL, MSK, ElastiCache), and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Crossplane.

title: RF Manufacturing Technician Lead (Production & People Leadership)
description:
RF Manufacturing Technician Lead (Production & People Leadership)

You Know the Equipment. Are You Ready to Lead the Team?

Location: Palo Alto, CA (On-Site)

Yearly Salary: $95,000–$120,000 (Exempt)

Are you the person other technicians turn to when the equipment isn't behaving the way it should? Maybe your title right now is RF (radio frequency) Test Lead, Senior RF Technician, Electronics Technician, Test Engineer, Production Lead, or Manufacturing Supervisor.We're interested in what you actually know and do, not just what your title says.

At Microwave Power Products (MPP), we manufacture RF and electronic components used in aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial equipment. Our work requires precision, attention to detail, and teamwork, and our technicians play an important role in building products our worldwide customers depend on.


MPP has more than 70 years of manufacturing experience and is now part of TransDigm Group, a global aerospace and defense company. We offer a stable work environment, hands-on training, and opportunities to grow your skills while working with experienced technicians and engineers. MPP is looking for a technically strong leader who can help lead production while developing the knowledge needed to understand and support a specialized RF and high-voltage test environment.

You'll work alongside technicians and assemblers, help troubleshoot production problems, coordinate with Engineering and Quality, and help keep technically complex work moving safely and on schedule.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and coordinate daily production activities and prioritize work to support schedule commitments.
  • Provide technical and day-to-day leadership to technicians.
  • Help identify production constraints and remove obstacles before they affect delivery.
  • Work directly with technical employees to troubleshoot equipment, process, and production issues.
  • Partner with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to resolve problems.
  • Ensure work is performed safely, accurately, and according to established procedures.
  • Identify and implement improvements to workflow, quality, productivity, and schedule adherence.
  • Support training, cross-training, and development of technical employees.
  • Communicate production status, risks, technical issues, and resource needs to leadership.
  • Help build a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

We Need Real Hands-On RF Experience

RF experience is required, but we're not looking for someone who has simply worked around RF terminology. We're looking for someone who has personally worked with RF systems, RF test equipment, high-power electronics, electrical instrumentation, or similarly complex technical equipment and can explain what they actually did.

Your experience might come from:

  • RF or microwave production
  • RF test and measurement
  • High-power RF systems
  • Radar or transmitter systems
  • Aerospace or defense electronics
  • Electronics test
  • High-voltage electrical systems
  • Other technically demanding RF/electrical environments

Tell Us What You Actually Worked On

A strong candidate should be able to explain:

  • What RF or electrical systems you personally worked with
  • What operating conditions or parameters you monitored
  • What measurements you personally performed
  • What test equipment or instrumentation you used
  • How you diagnosed an abnormal RF or electrical condition
  • A technical problem you personally troubleshot and how you approached it
  • How you determined whether the equipment was operating correctly

Experience with oscilloscopes, DMMs, RF power meters, spectrum analyzers, high-voltage measurement equipment, power supplies, and specialized test fixtures is valuable.

Experience with high-power/high-voltage RF systems, energized equipment, conditioning or burn-in processes, or tube-based technology is especially relevant.

Vacuum Electronics Experience Is a Plus

MPP works with specialized vacuum-electronic technology, so direct experience with tubes or related high-power RF systems can be valuable. However, we will consider candidates from other RF and high-power electronics environments who can demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, hands-on troubleshooting ability, and the ability to learn specialized equipment.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, test, electronics, RF, or a related technical environment.
  • 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, coordinating, or supervising technical employees or production work.
  • Hands-on RF experience.
  • Experience troubleshooting technical equipment in a production or test environment.
  • Ability to understand electrical/mechanical assembly and production workflows.
  • Ability to read and follow technical documentation, procedures, drawings, and work instructions.
  • Experience with process improvement, Lean principles, or similar continuous-improvement practices.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A hands-on, decisive approach to solving problems.
  • Interest in developing people and taking broader ownership of production.

You may already be an experienced supervisor or you may be the technical lead everyone calls when something goes wrong. Either way, we're interested in the depth of your technical experience and your ability to lead people.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR). Access to certain controlled information may be limited to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons” (generally U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and certain protected individuals). Non-U.S. persons may still apply; however to be eligible for the role, access to controlled information may require U.S. government authorization.

Applicants must be able to comply with applicable export control requirements. For security clearance position, the candidate must be a US citizen with the ability to obtain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Security Clearance as required, holding a security clearance is a plus.

The Environment

MPP's production and test environment combines RF, high voltage, electronics, specialized instrumentation, and experienced technical employees.

You won't be expected to know our products on day one. You will be expected to learn them.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable getting close to the work, asking technical questions, learning from experienced technicians, and using sound judgment when production problems arise.

The role is primarily on-site and requires flexibility to work beyond standard business hours when necessary to support high-priority production needs or critical issues.

Why MPP?

At MPP, technical knowledge matters. You'll work alongside experienced technicians and manufacturing professionals while helping translate technical expertise into reliable production execution. If you're an RF technical professional who is ready to move from "the person who solves the problem" toward "the person who helps the team solve the problem," we'd like to hear from you.

What We Offer

Compensation of $95,000–$120,000 on annual salary (exempt)

  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Generous 401(k) match

  • Commuter benefits and more within the Stanford Research Park

  • Complimentary EV charging

  • Paid time off and holidays

  • Training and opportunities for skill development and growth

Our Workplace Commitment

We value the unique and diverse skills, qualities, and backgrounds that each employee brings to MPP, and we respect each employee as an integral member of our growing team. MPP is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all current and prospective employees, as well as to promoting a culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. We celebrate the innovation that diversity creates in the work environment, and we recognize that each employee brings their own unique capabilities, experiences, and perspectives to the organization. It is this variety that adds value to our teams, as well as to our stakeholders. We welcome and encourage applicants to reach their full potential with us.

MPP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

description:
About the Company & Project

Our client is a leading global Consultancy renowned for delivering high-profile, complex, iconic, large-scale capital projects.

We are currently seeking a dedicated and accomplished Construction Inspector; FTA & BABA Compliance for the Hudson Tunnel Project (HTP). This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to contribute to this landmark project that is poised to deliver transformative impacts across economic, transportation, and environmental sustainability.

The busiest rail connection between New York, New Jersey, and the Northeast Corridor, the Hudson Tunnel Project will improve capacity, reliability, and resiliency of commuter and intercity rail transit serving 800,000 daily passengers from Washington, D.C. to New York and New England. This is a milestone project that is slated to receive nearly $12 billion in federal funding, the largest investment in a mass transit project in modern history.

As the Construction Inspector; FTA & BABA Compliance, you will play a pivotal role in the delivery of this significant project. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a mission that aligns with our client's purpose: to create responsible places that bring transformative impact to their people, communities, and societies.

Responsibilities

  • Support implementation and oversight of applicable FTA Buy America and BABA requirements, federal regulations, contract requirements, and project procedures.
  • Review contractor and subcontractor processes to verify that federal requirements are incorporated into procurement, sourcing, manufacturing, fabrication, delivery, and construction activities.
  • Review Bills of Materials Lists (BMLs) and supporting documentation for completeness, consistency, traceability, and domestic sourcing.
  • Verify supporting documentation such as manufacturer certifications, supplier information, origin documentation, and other required records.
  • Monitor applicable waivers, including non-availability and de minimis provisions, and identify items requiring further review or corrective action.
  • Track compliance status and escalate potential or confirmed non-compliance to the Quality Manager.
  • Conduct audits, surveillance, and document reviews of contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, manufacturers, and testing agencies.
  • Verify implementation of approved Quality Management Plans, Quality Control Plans, inspection procedures, and federal compliance processes.
  • Review inspection, testing, procurement, fabrication, and material acceptance records for compliance and objective evidence.
  • Document audit findings, deficiencies, observations, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor corrective and preventive actions through completion.
  • Perform field surveillance, as assigned, to verify materials and construction activities are consistent with approved documentation and project requirements.
  • Verify material traceability from approved source through delivery and incorporation into the project.
  • Review material certifications, mill test reports, certificates of compliance, manufacturer documentation, and related quality records.
  • Coordinate with inspection and testing personnel to confirm required records are complete and properly maintained.
  • Maintain accurate, systematic, and retrievable quality and federal compliance records.
  • Maintain compliance matrices, BML tracking logs, audit records, certifications, correspondence, and corrective action documentation.
  • Identify and document nonconforming materials, processes, or documentation and support preparation of NCRs and deficiency reports.
  • Prepare periodic quality and compliance status reports, including outstanding actions and identified risks.
  • Support preparation of documentation required for project acceptance, closeout, and federal oversight.
  • Support preparation for and response to FTA, federal, owner, and project audits and oversight reviews.
  • Assist with responses to FTA information requests, findings, and corrective actions.
  • Participate in quality meetings, audits, procurement reviews, technical discussions, and compliance coordination meetings.
  • Coordinate with GDC Delivery, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, testing agencies, and other stakeholders to promote consistent implementation of requirements.
  • Assist with training and communication regarding FTA, Buy America/BABA, and project quality requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, Quality Management, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in quality assurance, construction quality, federal compliance, or construction management on major infrastructure or transportation projects.
  • Experience with federally funded transportation projects and FTA, Buy America, BABA, or FRA requirements preferred.
  • Experience conducting audits, document reviews, quality surveillance, or compliance assessments preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Quality Assurance/Quality Control principles and construction quality management systems.
  • Working knowledge of FTA Buy America requirements and BABA, including applicable domestic preference requirements and waiver processes.
  • Familiarity with 49 U.S.C. § 5323(j) and applicable FTA requirements.
  • Ability to review BMLs and supporting domestic sourcing, manufacturing, and material documentation.
  • Knowledge of material traceability, supplier/manufacturer documentation, NCRs, corrective actions, and quality records.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic document management systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to identify compliance gaps and inconsistencies and effectively communicate findings.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with contractors, engineers, project management, and stakeholders.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and addressing quality and federal compliance risks.
  • Commitment to quality, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with major transit, rail, tunnel, or transportation infrastructure projects.
  • Direct experience supporting FTA-funded projects and federal oversight/audits.
  • Experience developing or implementing Buy America/BABA compliance procedures, matrices, or tracking systems.
  • Quality or construction-related certifications are a plus.

description:

At Bradford Health Services, we don’t just invest in our patients—we invest in our people.



About the Role:

As a Therapist, you will play a critical role in supporting individuals, families, and groups through various mental health challenges and life transitions. Your primary objective will be to provide compassionate, evidence-based therapeutic interventions that promote emotional well-being and behavioral health. You will assess clients’ psychological needs, develop personalized treatment plans, and facilitate therapy sessions that address issues such as crisis intervention, anger management, and family dynamics. Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, you will ensure a holistic approach to client care while maintaining strict confidentiality and ethical standards. Ultimately, your work will empower clients to achieve improved mental health outcomes and enhanced quality of life.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree in Counseling, Social Work, or related field that is eligible for licensure.
  • Valid state licensure as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or equivalent; or eligibility for licensure with the ability to obtain full licensure within an established timeframe upon hire.
  • Demonstrated experience in mental health counseling, including individual and group therapy.
  • Strong knowledge of crisis intervention techniques and behavioral health principles.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a commitment to client-centered care.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Specialized training or certification in family therapy, anger management, or trauma-informed care.
  • Experience working with diverse populations across different age groups and cultural backgrounds.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems and teletherapy platforms.
  • Additional credentials such as Certified Clinical Trauma Professional (CCTP) or equivalent.
  • Experience in program development or community outreach related to mental health services.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct individual, group, and family therapy sessions tailored to client needs.
  • Perform comprehensive psychological assessments and develop treatment plans.
  • Provide crisis intervention and support clients through acute mental health episodes.
  • Facilitate skill-building in areas such as anger management and coping with life transitions.
  • Maintain detailed and confidential client records in compliance with legal and ethical guidelines.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to coordinate care and referrals.
  • Stay current with best practices and emerging research in counseling psychology and behavioral health.

Skills:

The required skills such as counseling psychology and psychotherapy are essential for conducting effective therapy sessions and developing treatment plans that address clients’ unique mental health needs. Group therapy and family therapy skills enable you to facilitate dynamic sessions that promote healing within interpersonal relationships. Crisis intervention and anger management expertise are critical for managing acute situations and helping clients develop healthier coping mechanisms. Life transitions and behavioral health knowledge allow you to support clients through significant changes and challenges in their lives. Preferred skills like trauma-informed care and familiarity with teletherapy enhance your ability to provide comprehensive, accessible, and culturally sensitive mental health services.

* **Customer Focus:** A deep commitment to understanding and serving customer needs, with a track record of delivering user-centric products.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video:

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

  • Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
  • Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
  • Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
  • Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
  • Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Summary

This is an UNPAID internship through the DoD SkillBridge Program for transitioning active-duty US military personnel. DoD SkillBridge Internships are available to help transitioning active-duty military personnel gain real-world experience in the work force sometime during their final 180 days of active-duty service. The intern will actively train on meaningful projects and work closely with a mentor and with senior company leadership. HII Mission Technologies Internship programs are focused on placing transitioning military into internships that require KSAs, Education & Military Training similar to their current or previous military jobs; positions that could easily transition over to a full-time regular and permanent job with HII.

Objective

The SkillBridge intern will train as a Program Cost Control Analyst within HII Mission Technologies, working with Program Managers and supporting financial planning, tracking, analysis, and reporting activities. The primary goal is to learn the program financial lifecycle, government contracting financial procedures, cost controls, Earned Value concepts, and cross functional coordination with contracts, accounting, procurement, and subcontracts. The intern will be assigned special projects as needed to develop competence and confidence in real financial-management tasks.

Desired End State (2-month target)
At the end of two months, the intern will be able to:

  • Describe core functions of program cost control, financial management, and government contract financial compliance
  • Demonstrate a functional understanding of revenue planning, program funding analysis, cost monitoring, manpower tracking, and financial risk/opportunity identification
  • Explain how contract modifications impact financials and how to assess those impacts
  • Produce basic Estimates at Complete (EACs), variance analyses, and cost reports
  • Understand financial-reporting requirements including CDRLs, Ops Reviews, and internal/external reporting
  • Coordinate cross‑functionally to resolve cost, schedule, and accounting discrepancies
  • Read, understand, and apply GAAP, FAR, and corporate procedures in daily financial tasks
  • Work within one primary geographic location while supporting remote teams and multiple business functions
  • Track cost, schedule, and technical performance in support of program execution
  • Provide value through military experience, discipline, and analytical skills
  • HII Mission Technologies will benefit from the military and experiential background of the SkillBridge intern and considers the SkillBridge internship an overall positive experience.

Assumptions/Restrictions

  • SkillBridge interns are not authorized to represent HII to DoD or Government customers while participating in the DoD SkillBridge Program Internship. Interns can participate and train behind the scenes as long as they are not interacting with customers.
  • If candidate is selected and approved, SkillBridge Intern can be present to work with one of the Business Development or Capture teams located at one of the primary HII Office locations nationwide.

Program of Instruction

Training Location: REMOTE

Training Plan

Phase 1 – Foundations of Program Cost Control

Week 1 – Intro to Program Finance In‑processing, introductions, workspace setup. Overview of Program Manager partnership, Program Financials responsibilities, contract types, revenue planning, funding profiles, cost tracking, and basic financial terminology. Review of project setup aligned to contract terms.

Week 2 – Cost Tracking & Budget Controls Basics of monitoring cost and manpower actuals. Understanding job numbers, charge codes, labor categories. Reporting actuals vs plans/forecasts. Identifying cost issues and escalation paths. Intro to financial risks and opportunities.

Week 3 – Contract Impacts & Compliance Reviewing contract mods and assessing financial impacts. Intro to GAAP, FAR, SOX, and corporate policy. Understanding accruals and alignment with subcontractor, vendor, and receipt activity. Overview of Contracts, Accounting, Procurement, Subcontracts functions.

Phase 2 – Program Financial Analysis

Week 4 – EACs & Forecasting Steps to build an EAC, including actuals, commitments, and ETCs. Submission timelines and review expectations. Intro to revenue recognition and profit analysis. Practice identifying variances.

Week 5 – Variance Analysis & Reporting Preparing cost, schedule, and performance variance analysis. Understanding variance drivers and how to communicate them. Supporting Ops Reviews. Overview of financial metrics and reporting cycles.

Week 6 – Funding & Subcontractor Integration Monitoring funding by line item. Financial notification processes. Supporting billing cycles. Preparing subcontractor and vendor accruals. Working with Procurement and Contracts on cost elements.

Phase 3 – Federal Contracting & Integration

Week 7 – Contract Deliverables Preparing financial CDRLs and ensuring accurate customer submissions. How financial data ties to contract vehicles. Understanding hybrid contract types and cost-reporting differences. Overview of tools like Costpoint.

Week 8 – Business Development Alignment How Operations and Finance support BD and Capture. Analyst role in proposals and pricing. Standardization to prevent project failures. Final review, Q&A, assessment, internship closure, leadership engagement.

Additional Goals

Introductions to senior Mission Technologies leadership. Exposure to the broader financial ecosystem. Understanding how financial performance drives operational outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Active-Duty Military ONLY within final 180 days of active-duty service. Applications accepted within final 12 months of active-duty US Military service.

  • Education/Experience: Bachelor's + 6 yrs; Master's + 4 yrs; or HS diploma + 10 yrs relevant experience
  • Strong background with government contract types (FFP, FPI, FPLOE, T&M, CPAF, CPFF, CPIF, hybrid)
  • Proficient in Excel, MS Office, and relevant software
  • Excellent organizational skills; able to multitask and meet deadlines
  • Analytical with strong communication skills; works independently and in teams
  • Customer service focused

Preferred Requirements

  • Government contracting experience
  • Deltek Costpoint experience

title: Lead Project Manager, Workplace Operations
description:
About OpenLoop

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

About the Role

OpenLoop’s mission is to bring care anywhere by powering telehealth solutions at scale. We’re hiring a Lead Project Manager, Workplace Operations to own workplace design and construction from concept through occupancy, managing scope, schedules, budgets, and relationships with architects, engineers, contractors, landlords, and client partners.

Your initial portfolio includes a security and breakroom upfit in Dallas and multiple industrial and mixed-use build-outs that improve operational flow, increase capacity, and support growth. You’ll coordinate projects across Madison, Dallas, and satellite sites, aligning shared vendors, standards, and dependencies across the portfolio.

As we build this capability internally, you’ll help establish how OpenLoop delivers projects and hold internal teams and external partners accountable without direct reporting authority. This remote role is approximately 40 hours per week, with 25–50% travel for active design and construction, site walks, inspections, and turnover.

What You'll Do

Lead design and construction: Own delivery from programming and design-team selection through construction documents, bidding, construction, punch list, closeout, and warranty. Lead design reviews, ensure plans meet operational needs, evaluate submittals, RFIs, and change orders, and conduct site quality reviews.

  • Manage the portfolio: Sequence design, construction, and activation across sites. Coordinate shared vendors, long-lead items, and dependencies; identify opportunities for standardization and bulk purchasing; and escalate schedule conflicts with recommended solutions.

  • Own budgets and capital reporting: Track budgets, actuals, commitments, spending, contingency, and forecasts at completion. Explain variances, evaluate cost-saving opportunities, manage changes, and support annual capital planning.

  • Lead procurement and vendor performance: Run competitive bids for design, construction, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), and specialty trades. Evaluate total cost of ownership and partner with contract administration on contracts, scopes, certificates of insurance, and purchase requests through Zip/Ramp.

  • Represent OpenLoop and drive accountability: Serve as the owner’s contact for clients, landlords, property managers, brokers, designers, and contractors. Run productive meetings, communicate status and risks, and track decisions and commitments in a project management tool with clear owners and deadlines.

  • Coordinate permitting and compliance: Manage permitting, code review, local authority requirements, and inspections across jurisdictions. Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Credentialing on facility licensing, registration, and inspection readiness.

  • Deliver operational readiness: Coordinate FF&E, IT and security installations, signage, utilities, occupancy, and moves. Partner with IT, Security, People Ops, Legal, and Finance to deliver spaces ready for day-one operations, with complete turnover documentation.

  • Build repeatable processes: Develop SOPs, design standards, templates, checklists, and intake workflows in Confluence. Apply lessons learned, reduce manual work, and support related cross-functional projects and reporting needs.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent field experience.

  • 5+ years managing design and construction projects, ideally as an owner’s representative or in-house project manager.

  • Experience delivering concurrent projects across sites and representing an owner or client with external stakeholders.

  • Ability to interpret construction documents, bids, and change orders and translate them into clear scope, cost, and risk assessments.

  • Strong project financial skills, including budgeting, contingency management, and change-order evaluation; advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency required.

  • Hands-on experience building and managing project plans in Monday, Jira, or a similar platform.

  • Working knowledge of permitting, codes, and inspections across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Clear, concise communication; strong organization and attention to detail; and the ability to lead meetings and hold peers and partners accountable without direct authority.

  • A service-minded approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multi-site environment with shifting priorities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual meeting platforms, plus availability for approximately 25–50% travel.

  • Preferred: Healthcare, pharmacy, lab, or industrial build-out experience; PMP, CCM, or equivalent certification; and familiarity with Bluebeam, AutoCAD or Revit viewers, Procore, Zip, Ramp, or Confluence.

Our Benefits

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision plans

  • Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts

  • Flexible PTO

  • 401(k) + Company Match

  • Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

Our Company

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

title: Talent & OD Specialist

We are looking for an experienced Talent & Organisational Development Specialist to join our People & Culture team.

Reporting to the Head of Talent & OD, you will play a key role in designing and delivering learning, leadership, talent and organisational development initiatives across Bapcor.

This is a highly hands-on role where you will take ideas from concept through to implementation. You’ll design learning solutions, facilitate programs, develop capability frameworks and support broader talent and OD initiatives. Working closely with P&C Business Partners and senior leaders, you’ll help build the capability our people and leaders need to succeed now and into the future.

  • Design, develop and deliver blended learning programs across digital, facilitator-led, social and on-the-job learning channels.
  • Design and facilitate leadership development programs for frontline, mid-level and senior leaders.
  • Develop and maintain behavioural, technical and leadership capability frameworks that support career pathways, development and performance.

You will bring:

title: Yardi Systems Specialist
description:
Yardi Systems Specialist

POSITION SUMMARY

The Yardi Systems Specialist is a subject matter expert and administrator on the team for the Yardi Property Management system. This individual is accountable for the operational integrity, user support and continuous enhancement of the Yardi platform, the modules implemented to date, and those that are on the implementation roadmap. Particular emphasis on identifying and resolving data discrepancies arising from system integrations is an integral part of this role. The role bridges systems accuracy across Pratum's disciplines, including accounting aspects, with technical troubleshooting and process optimization, serving as both a hands-on problem solver and strategic system guide.

This is not a remote role and will require on-site daily office presence as a standard expectation in one of our company's property management offices in the Philadelphia, PA metro region. Travel may include visits to property sites and the company's corporate headquarters in Gaithersburg, MD.

PRIMARY/ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support and Administration

  • Provide technical support to users of the Yardi products including Voyager Affordable, RentCafe, Procure to Pay and others in a timely manner.
  • Create and maintain users, manage permissions and property assignments, scheduled reports, custom menus and workflows.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for clients experiencing Yardi software-related problems, guiding them through problem identification, resolution, and prevention.
  • Serve as the escalation point and liaison for Yardi support; collaborate with other team members and Yardi client support to resolve complex technical issues promptly.
  • Track and review performance data of various Yardi modules to identify trends and issues and develop improvement plans.
  • Work with vendors to establish and maintain Yardi data exchange.

Yardi Migration and Implementation

  • Serve as primary point of contact and technical project lead to migrate properties to Yardi platform.
  • Assist with the onboarding of new properties and associated setup as part of the transition team, as well as the offboarding/transition of properties as the circumstances arise.
  • Work with departments to test and implement new Yardi modules.
  • Practice sound project management skills to ensure projects stay on track and implementation milestone objectives are met.

Training

  • Participates in, and serves as a facilitator and subject matter expert, in ensuring all system users are trained and capable of performing required job tasks within the Yardi system. This includes new hire and onboarding training, support for staff at new-hire orientation, development of training guides and curriculum/course materials, training of current staff who are or will be users of the system, etc.
  • Analyze support tickets and work with department heads to create opportunities for additional training and continuous education.
  • Identify and streamline processes and work with other departments to implement.
  • Maintain system documentation, including configuration records, process workflows.


REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Over 3 years' experience as a Yardi user and administrator including Voyager Affordable, RentCafe, Procure to Pay, and other system applications/features. Prior experience with other residential multi-family property management systems (e.g. RealPage/OneSite) is helpful.
  • Experience in serving as a subject matter expert with the Yardi system, with demonstrated capability in handling/managing/resolving software system access, new property set-up, new user set-up and permissions, ad-hoc and scheduled report generation, custom menus, workflow creation, etc. Prior experience in-house with a multi-family property management company, including affordable housing (LIHTC, HUD Project Based Section 8, etc.).
  • Prior experience in leading a software implementation effort from beginning to successful completion. Yardi software implementation experience strongly preferred. Capable of rallying positive support for achieving project milestones, managing and collaborating with stakeholders, both inside and outside of the company, to stay on-track and on-schedule with tact and professionalism.
  • Capable of training employees in all operational aspects of Yardi. Comfortable presenting the subject matter one-on-one, to small groups in-person in a classroom setting, on-line via virtual/web-based training, etc.
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with excellent attention to detail. Adept at owning projects and tasks, managing deliverables to meet deadlines, connecting with people and facilitating effective collaboration to achieve successful outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office Suite experience (Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, etc.)


WORK ENVIRONMENT

The role will be based at one of our company's property management offices in the Philadelphia, PA metro region and the work environment is predominantly office/clerical. This is not a remote role and will require on-site daily office presence as a standard expectation.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to read, write, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to sit; use hands/fingers to handle or feel (e.g. type); and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20+ pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Must have reliable transportation and ability to meet attendance/punctuality requirements and to facilitate on-site visits to properties (10-20% travel estimated).


This role is exempt and has an anticipated annualized base salary range of $65k-$75k for a new employee depending on a number of relevant factors including individuals’ experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, abilities, client/property or company budgetary limitations/guidelines, and other job-related company and market considerations. This position may be eligible to receive discretionary and/or performance-based bonuses on a spot or annual basis, which are variable depending on individual merit/performance, budgetary limitations, company performance, and other job-related factors. Full-time positions (30+ hours/week) are eligible for 2 weeks paid vacation, 1 week sick and related leave, 11 paid holidays, and health & welfare benefits as outlined on the Company’s website. ESSENTIAL TASKS:

  • Material handling

Furnace Operator

  • Operate all anneal and leveler furnaces associated with the facility. Work from schedules, mill orders, written and verbal instructions to operate furnaces to heat material for conversion in a safe and economical manner.
  • Must be capable of performing every aspect of operating furnaces such as lighting, fuel selection, minimum/maximum controllable temperature, maximum rate of rise, maximum furnace load, minimum clearance from floors and walls, etc.
  • Acquire and maintain general working knowledge of the deviation limitations of particular materials and use judgment in operating furnaces so these limitations will not be exceeded.
  • Maintain all required work and material identification. Verify data collection to maintain logs, records and other paperwork that is required.
  • Operate as many furnaces as required to meet the production requirements, maintaining the same degree of control and monitoring as required on each furnace.
  • Responsible for staging and marking material for loading.
  • Detect and report any improper operation, defective material, or unusual conditions to proper supervision.

Grinder Operator

  • Operate automatic grinders to finish grind, spot grind, and grind plate to desired dimensional tolerances.
  • Work from mill orders and procedures to obtain specifications such as dimensions, tolerances, and other instructions to grind material to meet customer specifications.
  • Set-up and operate the grinder, grinder feed, and rotating table and auxiliary equipment.
  • Set-up includes proper setting of grinder wheel speed, feed rates, and head pressure control, holding fixture, clamps and turning apparatus.
  • Manually operate feeds and speeds to perform spot grinding operations.
  • Maintain logs and records covering starting weights and finish weights of material ground.
  • Change worn grinding wheels as necessary or for various grits and/or grades of alloy being ground.
  • Detect and report improper equipment operation or defective material to supervision.

Pickling Line

  • Schedules and assists with operation of pickling line to pickle, clean, coat, desensitize and/or de-copper material as required to meet specified requirements.
  • Maintains operating temperatures, concentrations and levels of solutions as required per operation specifications.
  • Operates valves and/or control devices to make up and maintain solutions according to specifications and to drain weak and /or dirty solution from tanks.

NON-ESSENTIAL TASKS:

  • Perform any other duties as required and directed by management.

title: Adviseur/ Specialist levensverzekeringen
description:
Onze klant is geen stoffig verzekeringskantoor. Nee, het is een warme, groeiende organisatie waar medewerkers en zaakvoerder gepassioneerd zijn.

Hun specialiteit? Levensverzekeringen, tweede-pijler oplossingen en pensioenopbouw voor mensen die vooruit willen.

Samen een toekomst bouwen voor ondernemers en particulieren. Dat is wat we doen!

Jij wordt onze specialist of misschien ben je dat al, maar wacht je net nog op de juiste plek om te ontwikkelen.

Requirements

We bieden de kans aan iemand met de volgende skills of nog niet, maar daar krijg je dan een opleiding voor.

  • Je hebt ervaring in de verzekeringssector, vooral in de tak leven. Heb je ervaring in tweedepijlerproducten? Dan is dat de jackpot!

  • Je begrijpt zelfstandigen en ondernemers, soms beter dan ze zichzelf begrijpen want jij zoekt hun oplossingen al zien ze nog geen problemen.

  • Je bent iemand die complexe zaken eenvoudig kan uitleggen. Geen technische termen, maar een simpele uitleg om hun toekomst te garanderen.

  • Je wilt niet vastroesten. Je wilt blijven groeien en bijleren.

  • Je bent professioneel, maar je neemt jezelf niet te serieus.

Hoe ziet je takenpakket er dan uit?

  • Je verdiept je in VAPZ’s, IPT’s en POZ’s alsof het een bord sudoku is, maar dan met rendement.

  • Je begeleidt klanten van ‘‘Wat is een tweede pijler?’’ naar ‘‘Bedankt je hebt mijn toekomst veiliggesteld’’.

  • Je overlegt met collega’s en de zaakvoerder en je komt met ideeën die klanten echt helpen.

  • Je houdt de wetgeving en fiscale voordelen scherp in het oog.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?

  • Een interne opleiding op maat. Ieder kantoor en bedrijf werkt anders, je wordt bij ons deel van onze en ineens ook jouw toekomst.

  • Een werkplek waar je vooruit komt.

  • Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met alles wat je verwacht. We kunnen hier bedragen opschrijven, maar alles hangt af van jouw ervaring. Wil je meteen als zelfstandige aan de slag? Ook dat is een optie! Kortom, we denken samen in mogelijkheden.

  • Flexibiliteit; We verwachten professionaliteit, dus je bepaalt ineens ook je eigen agenda. Je moet dus niet inchecken en uitchecken wanneer je ‘s morgens wakker wordt.

description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior PLM Business Analyst – Digital Thread & Product Data

📍 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden

🏢 Work Model: On-site (0% remote)

About the Role

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong PLM/PDM expertise for a strategic consulting assignment in Gothenburg.

The assignment focuses on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Data Management (PDM), Digital Thread, product information, and component-related business capabilities.

You will work at the intersection of business processes, product information, technology, and digital transformation, helping organizations structure complex requirements, define future ways of working, and translate business needs into actionable solutions.

The role combines business analysis, process development, solution design, stakeholder management, and delivery support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct business analysis and capability assessments related to PLM and product information.
  • Map current-state and future-state processes, information flows, capabilities, and user needs.
  • Gather, analyze, structure, and document business requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Work closely with architects, product managers, developers, and subject matter experts to detail solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops, interviews, stakeholder discussions, and cross-functional alignment sessions.
  • Develop process maps, solution concepts, business cases, and decision material.
  • Support backlog management, prioritization, and roadmap development.
  • Drive assigned initiatives from initial analysis through implementation support.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, gaps, and decision points across business and technical functions.
  • Contribute to change management, communication, and user adoption activities.
  • Help improve the quality, traceability, governance, and reusability of product information across the product lifecycle.
  • Support initiatives involving product structures, configurations, technical documentation, and engineering information.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, PLM Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Product Data Management (PDM).
  • Extensive understanding of PDM processes, information structures, logic, and system solutions.
  • Experience working within complex product development and engineering environments.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and implementable solutions.
  • Experience facilitating workshops and working with stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Strong understanding of business processes, information flows, and digital solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned activities through to completion.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Digital Thread initiatives.
  • Experience with product information management or master data initiatives.
  • Experience managing product structures, configurations, technical documentation, and engineering information.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation within product development organizations.
  • Knowledge of PLM/PDM architecture, information models, and associated enterprise tool landscapes.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar agile delivery tools.
  • Experience working in large, complex industrial or engineering organizations.
  • Experience with component sales, aftermarket, or product information initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Analytical, structured, and proactive.
  • Comfortable working with complex business and technical environments.
  • Able to quickly understand complex processes and information structures.
  • Skilled at turning ambiguity into clear requirements and actionable activities.
  • Comfortable communicating with both business stakeholders and technical specialists.
  • Strong at facilitating discussions and creating alignment across different functions.
  • Able to challenge assumptions constructively and drive work forward.
  • Comfortable working independently while maintaining strong stakeholder collaboration.

Background Verification

Due to the nature of the assignment, background verification will be required before the selected consultant starts the assignment.

The required verification may include identity, right-to-work, address history, education, financial fitness, corporate directorships, criminal records where permitted by applicable legislation, and basic open-source/media checks.

Further information regarding the verification process will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Why Join Hykmann?

As a consultant with Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB, you will have the opportunity to work on strategic digital transformation initiatives within leading organizations in Sweden.

We work with experienced professionals across IT, engineering, digital transformation, business analysis, PLM, software development, and technology consulting.

description:

Full time

Our platform empowers customers who leverage multiple Falcon products to create and manage advanced, unified detections and content. This core platform capability is a strategic imperative for CrowdStrike, aiming to provide a competitive advantage that is difficult to replicate, ensuring our customers have unparalleled detection and response capabilities across the entire Falcon ecosystem.

  • Extensive experience with data streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, Flink) and distributed computing concepts.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity or SIEM principles, data models, and content/rule authoring lifecycles is a significant plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in a Staff-level role, driving multi-quarter initiatives, and influencing technical direction across multiple teams.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with query languages and runtime environments
  • Familiarity with the challenges of low-latency, real-time event processing and pattern matching.
  • Prior work in a security domain or building platforms for developers/content authors.

Role Overview

The Associate Director of Quality Assurance Compliance is responsible for developing, maintaining, and continuously strengthening Quality Compliance programs, QA procedures, GMP and GLP compliance, regulatory inspection readiness, product testing support, quality planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role provides leadership and direction to the QA team while driving practical upgrades to GMP practices, procedures, documentation standards, and inspection readiness across the organization.

Areas of Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain GXP required Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other required documents in line with industry and regulatory requirements. Author and/or approve required SOPs ensuring control of GXP operations and activities.
  • Assist in / or perform periodic reviews of all established programs including Vendor qualification Management, Quality Agreements, Annual Quality Management Reviews, and in the performance of internal audits of quality-controlled activities as executed by other departments.
  • Management and preparation, review and /or approval of customer specifications and other related technical documents as per customer requirements per Product Development direction
  • Management of product specifications, COAs, SDS, review of product label and supplement facts
  • Review and/or approval of Food Safety Plan, Validation, Verification protocols, reports, and other quality related documents.
  • Oversee the day -to-day activities of the quality assurance team in line with industry and regulatory requirements, provide GMP training, mentoring and performance management.
  • Provide assistance to Quality management during audits performed by external groups, customers and regulatory agencies. Develop action plans to resolve documented observations and ensure adequate resolutions are achieved.
  • Lead Quality Compliance initiatives to meet current GMP expectations and proactively upgrade GMP practices, procedures, documentation, training, and inspection readiness systems to support sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
  • Own preparation, hosting, coordination, response management, and follow-up for external third-party audits including GMP, Kosher, Halal, Organic, customer audits, and regulatory inspections or audits by agencies such as State authorities, FDA, TGA, and other applicable regulatory bodies.
  • Manage internal and external audits, ensuring that findings are addressed, and corrective actions are implemented in a timely manner.
  • Document, resolve or provide assistance to other groups with Corrective Actions, Deviations, Non- Conformance, Customer Complaints and Change Controls.
  • Approve actions as necessary and monitor for effectiveness and timeliness of completion.
  • Assures the implementation of GMP procedures throughout the company.
  • Collaborate with cross – functional teams including production, engineering, supply chain and customer service, to identify and resolve quality issues.
  • Develop and implement quality metrics and KPI’s, regularly report on performance to management.
  • To perform any other tasks as given by the management

Education & Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in science or related scientific disciplines
  • About 10-12 years of relevant work experience in the dietary supplement, nutraceutical, food, pharmaceutical, or biotech industry, with strong preference for hands-on Quality Assurance and Quality Compliance experience in a Dietary Supplement GMP manufacturing or CDMO environment.
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience


Certifications, Licenses, Credentials:

  • PCQI certification is required. Certifications in auditing, FSMA, HACCP, or other applicable quality and food safety programs are preferred.

Skills & Ability

  • Strong knowledge of Dietary Supplement GMP requirements and compliance expectations, including 21 CFR Part 111, 21 CFR Part 117, GLP principles, and applicable electronic records expectations such as 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience in preparation of compliance documents for product approval by customer, transition from product development / R&D stage to commercial quality systems and operations as per product specification & quality requirements.

May reach with hands and arms and infrequently may lift up to 30lbs. Use desk telephone/cell phone to talk and hear or converse with other employees.

title: Software Engineer
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/29/2026

Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

We run the platform that serves foundational models to Cisco IT. Our Foundational Model Service, gives engineering teams across the company access to small, large language, and embedding models. youWe serve those models on Kubernetes clusters, with Nim, Vllm and other runtimes. Beyond serving, We benchmark, evaluate, monitor, and release new models as improvements and demand warrant. Our customers depend on the platform under a 99.9% uptime SLA, and we build and operate accordingly.

As a Software Engineer on the FMS team you'll keep that platform running and make it easier to run. You'll support model onboarding and releases, take your turn on call, help automate the validation that gates every deployment, and contribute to the monitoring that shows us and our customers how the service is behaving. You'll also apply Agentic solutions to our own operations to catch problems earlier and remediate them automatically.

Your Impact

You'll develop software consistent with Cisco Design Thinking Principles, with simplification and user experience at its core, using secure coding practices, protecting user privacy, and following software development best practices. You'll partner with design, product management, and other engineering teams to build the right solution for our customers. You'll create technical design documentation for the team, contribute to the documentation end users rely on, and debug platform issues both in development and in production.

This is a strong role for a systems or infrastructure engineer who has worked with LLMs, whether through academic coursework or by building and running them on the job, and who understands how inference serving works. We're looking for a self starter who takes on unfamiliar work and grows into it. You'll work with engineers who have built these systems from the ground up. New runtimes and new models arrive frequently, so the platform is always evolving, and you'll develop a deep understanding of developing AI infrastructure, model runtimes, and delivering products at scale. On call is shared across the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field with 3 years of related experience; master’s degree with 1 year of related experience; PhD; or equivalent practical work experience.
  • Experience developing and operating production services on Kubernetes and Linux, including exposure to GPU based AI infrastructure.
  • Hands on experience serving models with vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Triton, or a comparable inference runtime, including building supporting services.
  • Experience leading technical work, mentoring engineers, documenting systems, and supporting critical services through an on call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience evaluating and benchmarking models to support production release decisions.
  • Experience operating GPU workloads with NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm.
  • Familiarity with distributed inference, disaggregated serving, KV cache aware routing, capacity planning, or cost optimization.
  • Experience fine tuning transformer models or evaluating RAG and agent systems using relevant frameworks.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sektionsleder med blik for borgeren, det tværgående samarbejde og den strategiske retning til Plejecentre og Korttidspladser i Ikast-Brande Kommune
description:
Vil du være en del af Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen i Ikast-Brande Kommune og stå i spidsen for sektionen Plejecentre og Korttidspladser? Brænder du for at arbejde i et område, hvor gavmildhed i samarbejdet, nærhed, værdighed og fællesskab er fundamentet? Finder du motivation i at udvikle stærke relationer på tværs af organisationen og i samspil med civilsamfundet? Så er det dig, vi søger som sektionsleder pr. 1. januar 2027.

Du vil træde ind i en ambitiøs ledergruppe i Sundhed og Ældre, som er handlings- og udviklingsorienteret og vægter fælles succes og tværgående samarbejde højt. Du bliver en del af et ledelsesfællesskab, hvor vi læner os ind mod hinanden og prioriterer samarbejde på tværs af sektioner højt. Vi forventer derfor, at du aktivt vil samarbejdet og ser værdien i fælles løsninger til gavn for borgerne.

Som sektionsleder får du en central rolle i udviklingen og driften af plejecentre, korttidspladser og daghjem i Ikast-Brande Kommune. Vi søger en nærværende leder, der er tæt på både de 6 lokalledere, medarbejdere, borgere, pårørende og aktører i civilsamfundet – og som med oprigtig interesse og engagement i de enkelte steder formår at balancere drift, udvikling og økonomisk ansvarlighed.
Et fokusområde er, at du i tæt samarbejde med resten af afdelingen, arbejder på at omsætte Ældrelovens værdier om selvbestemmelse, tillid og et stærkt samspil med pårørende, lokale fællesskaber og civilsamfundet til lokal praksis.
Et andet vigtigt fokusområde er at udvikle de kommunale korttidspladser og sikre, at der opbygges et stærkt og velfungerende samarbejde i Det Nære Sundhedsvæsen. Det kræver, at du både kan arbejde struktureret med drift og samtidig holde fokus på det langsigtede strategiske perspektiv.

Din rolle:

Som sektionsleder får du en central position, hvor du

  • sikrer værdighed i mødet med borgerne
  • understøtter og udvikler et stærkt samarbejde med pårørende og civilsamfundet
  • sikrer høj faglig kvalitet med afsæt i personcentreret omsorg
  • har ansvar for budgetoverholdelse, sygefravær og økonomistyring
  • er en del af et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab med fokus på samarbejde og sparring
  • er tæt på driften og prioriterer regelmæssig nærværende sparring med lokalledere
  • bidrager til udviklingen af Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen på både kort og langt sigt
  • bidrager aktivt i videreudviklingen af Det Nære Sundhedsvæsen

Vi ønsker os en sektionsleder, der:

  • har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse suppleret med en lederuddannelse
  • har solid ledelseserfaring og evner at opnå følgeskab i et stort og komplekst ledelsesområde med flere fagligheder. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med ledelse af ledere
  • er en synlig og nærværende leder, der trives med at være tæt på hverdagens opgaver
  • har blik for både drift og udvikling, og kan arbejde med det lange perspektiv
  • har stærke samarbejdsevner og aktivt bidrager til fællesskabet
  • er optaget af at skabe gode forløb for borgerne – “vi gør det for Gerda”
  • har forståelse for at navigere i en kommunal og politisk styret organisation og kan omsætte strategier og politiske visioner til konkrete handlinger og indsatser i driften

Yderligere information:

Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sundheds- og Ældrechef Kirsten Løgsted på tlf. 41818058.

På vores hjemmeside finder du:

  • information om Ikast-Brande Kommune som arbejdsplads, herunder kan du se introduktionsvideoer om onboarding i kommunen: Job i Ikast-Brande Kommune
  • faktaark om Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen, der er udarbejdet i forbindelse med Kommunalvalget 2025: Faktaark - Sundhed og Ældre
  • organisationsdiagram for Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen: Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen

Der er ansøgningsfrist mandag den 26. oktober kl. 12.00.

1. samtalerunde forventes afholdt tirsdag den 3. november 2026, hvorfra 2-3 kandidater vil blive udvalgt til 2. samtalerunde fredag den 13. november 2026.

title: Mental Health Clinician
description:
Mental Health Clinicians – Charles County, MD & Other Maryland Locations

Make a Difference. Build Connections. Grow Your Career.

Interdynamics, Inc. is a behavioral health organization dedicated to providing quality, compassionate outpatient behavioral health services to children, families, and communities throughout Maryland.

We are seeking dedicated, compassionate Mental Health Clinicians to join our growing team. If you are passionate about helping individuals and families thrive and enjoy working collaboratively with schools, families, and other professionals, we would love to hear from you.

Our clinicians have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of students and families while receiving the professional support they need to succeed.

Position Overview

As a Mental Health Clinician with Interdynamics, you will provide behavioral health services in a supportive, multidisciplinary environment. Depending on your assignment, you may work directly with students, families, teachers, school staff, and community partners.

Our clinical team includes licensed professionals such as:

  • Licensed Graduate Professional Counselors (LGPC)

  • Licensed Clinical Professional Counselors (LCPC)

  • Licensed Master Social Workers (LMSW)

  • Licensed Clinical Social Workers (LCSW/LCSW-C)

  • Psychology Associates

Positions are available in Charles County and other locations throughout Maryland.

What You’ll Do

School-based clinicians have the opportunity to:

  • Provide individual and family counseling to students, as well as support to teachers and parents.

  • Consult with teachers and develop classroom-based interventions.

  • Conduct classroom observations and functional behavioral assessments.

  • Provide crisis intervention and support to students, staff, and families.

  • Conduct educational trainings and workshops for staff, students, and parents.

  • Collaborate with school psychologists, counselors, social workers, administrators, teachers, and other support professionals.

  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings.

  • Provide family support and connect families with appropriate community resources and agencies.

  • Conduct community outreach and strengthen connections between families and available services.

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and professional documentation.

  • Meet regularly with an Interdynamics Clinical Supervisor for guidance and clinical support.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for clinicians who are compassionate, dependable, collaborative, and committed to providing high-quality behavioral health services.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in social work, mental health counseling, psychology, or a related field.

  • Current Maryland licensure in good standing as an LMSW, LCSW/LCSW-C, LGPC, LCPC, or Psychology Associate, as applicable to the position.

  • Ability to meet required screening and employment requirements.

  • Professional liability insurance.

  • Strong communication, organization, and documentation skills.

  • Commitment to ethical and professional standards of practice.

What You Can Expect

At Interdynamics, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Make a meaningful impact in the lives of children, families, and communities.

  • Work as part of a collaborative multidisciplinary team.

  • Receive ongoing support from a Clinical Supervisor.

  • Apply your clinical skills in a school and community setting.

  • Build relationships with educators, families, and community providers.

  • Continue developing your professional skills and experience as a behavioral health clinician.

School-Based Position Requirements

  • School-based clinicians must satisfactorily complete the first 90 days of service to continue employment.

  • Clinicians must follow the Interdynamics and school schedules, including Monday–Friday reporting and workday requirements.

  • Follow Interdynamics policies, procedures, and protocols.

  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Maryland licensing regulations, ethical principles, and professional standards.

  • Attend required orientations, meetings, and training activities.

  • School-based clinicians must commit to a minimum one-year contract.

  • Communicate absences and interruptions in services to the Clinical Supervisor in accordance with contract requirements.

Join the Interdynamics Team

If you're a Maryland-licensed behavioral health professional looking for an opportunity to make a difference, collaborate with other professionals, and grow your clinical career, we invite you to apply.

Locations: Charles County, Maryland and other Maryland locations
Job Type: Full-time
Education: Master’s degree required
Licensure: Maryland licensure required — LMSW, LCSW/LCSW-C, LGPC, LCPC, or Psychology Associate

Interdynamics, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer (EEO).
