title: FRAME SUPERVISOR
description:
Position Summary:

The Frame Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the Frame Building department and providing direction and support to Frame Builders. This position ensures that frames are built safely, efficiently, and according to established quality standards and production requirements. The Frame Supervisor coordinates workflow, monitors employee performance, addresses production and quality concerns, and helps maintain a safe, productive, and positive work environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supervise and provide daily direction to Frame Builders within the department.
  • Plan and coordinate daily work assignments to meet production schedules and department goals.
  • Monitor production flow and make adjustments as needed to maintain an efficient workflow.
  • Ensure frames are constructed accurately and according to specifications, drawings, work instructions, and quality standards.
  • Inspect completed and in-process frames for quality, workmanship, dimensions, and proper assembly.
  • Identify and address quality issues and work with employees to correct problems and prevent recurring defects.
  • Train new and existing employees on proper frame-building procedures, equipment, tools, safety practices, and quality expectations.
  • Provide coaching, feedback, and direction to employees regarding job performance, attendance, work quality, and productivity.
  • Communicate production priorities, changes, and expectations clearly to department employees.
  • Monitor employee attendance and staffing levels and adjust assignments as needed to maintain production.
  • Work with other departments to coordinate material availability and ensure frames move through the production process efficiently.
  • Monitor the availability and condition of materials, tools, equipment, and supplies needed for production.
  • Report equipment, material, or process issues to the appropriate department or management.
  • Ensure employees follow all company safety policies, procedures, and proper equipment-use requirements.
  • Promote good housekeeping and organization within the Frame Building area.
  • Assist with identifying opportunities to improve productivity, quality, safety, and efficiency.
  • Participate in problem-solving and continuous improvement activities.
  • Maintain accurate production, quality, and employee-related records as required.
  • Conduct or participate in department meetings and communicate important information to employees.
  • Assist management with employee evaluations, performance concerns, disciplinary matters, and other employee-related issues as needed.
  • Serve as a resource for Frame Builders by answering questions and assisting with technical or process-related concerns.
  • Perform frame-building duties when necessary to support production, training, or staffing needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to effectively lead, train, and motivate employees.
  • Strong understanding of frame-building processes and manufacturing practices.
  • Ability to read and understand work instructions, drawings, measurements, and production specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to identify problems, determine appropriate solutions, and follow through on corrective actions.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to organize work and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, and other departments.
  • Ability to enforce safety and quality standards consistently and fairly.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn company production and administrative systems.

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Previous experience in furniture manufacturing, frame building, woodworking, or a related manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, or lead experience preferred.
  • Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
  • Ability to frequently bend, stoop, reach, push, pull, and use hands and arms.
  • Ability to lift, carry, and maneuver materials and frames as required.
  • Ability to work around manufacturing equipment, tools, noise, dust, and other typical production-environment conditions.

title: NETWORK ENGINEER
description:
NETWORK ENGINEER POSITION

CROSS LINK CONSULTING

Cross Link Consulting is seeking to hire a Network Engineer at our Augusta, Georgia location. This is a full-time permanent position with long-term focus and growth potential within a company on the move. The role exists to help bring order, security, and consistency to our clients' technology infrastructure-serving not just their systems, but the people who depend on them. Qualified candidates may also be considered for a similar role with one of Cross Link's partner organizations.

ABOUT CROSS LINK

At Cross Link Consulting (www.crosslinkconsulting.net), we don't fix computers, we serve people! We are a Managed Services Provider (MSP) offering IT support, cybersecurity, and strategic technology services to businesses and organizations across the Greater Augusta and Central Savannah River Area. Over the years we've built something more than outsourced IT-we've become "the friendly IT department down the hall."

We believe our success comes from more than technical know-how; it comes from people who are called to serve others. Our team thrives when we put our clients first, solve problems with creativity, and protect people from risk with diligence. That's why we foster a company culture that values both professional excellence and personal calling.

A DAY IN THE LIFE AS A NETWORK ENGINEER

As a Network Engineer at Cross Link, you'll step into a role where every day brings both technical problem-solving and people-focused service. One moment you may be planning switch configurations in Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Center), ensuring uptime and reliability for a client's campus network. Later that same day, you might be helping a colleague troubleshoot Active Directory group policies or mentoring a junior technician on how to manage permissions responsibly.

You'll also play a role in managing virtual server infrastructure (currently VMware, though this may evolve), supporting high-availability environments for our clients. Documentation, planning, and oversight are part of your stewardship, ensuring that our team stays aligned and our clients experience seamless network operations.

In short: your work helps keep organizations running smoothly while building up the skills of those around you.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A serving mindset for client and team interactions
  • Humility and a desire for the team to succeed
  • Passion and drive to work hard, take ownership and seek additional responsibility
  • Good judgment and intuition with uncompromising integrity
  • High aptitude and demonstrated ability to manage and troubleshoot:
    • Cisco switching infrastructure (with tools like Cisco DNA/Catalyst Center)
    • Windows Active Directory tasks such as Group Policy and permissions
    • Virtual server environments (VMs, not limited to a specific vendor)

PREFERENCES

  • Resolution mindset focused on practical solutions and implementations to serve, vs. elitist attitude
  • Experience mentoring or planning work for less experienced technicians
  • In-depth Cisco switching experience, including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, and switch configuration through the command line and Cisco Catalyst Center
  • Strong Active Directory skills, including users, groups, organizational units, permissions, and Group Policy design and troubleshooting
  • 3+ years of Windows Server administration, including DNS, DHCP, and patching
  • Network security experience, including firewall rules, VPNs, network segmentation, and access controls
  • Experience maintaining backup, disaster recovery, and remote monitoring tools
  • Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CompTIA Security+ are a plus but not required
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and Azure Cloud Services, including endpoint protection and Microsoft 365 security
  • Proficiency with work order systems
  • Scripting / Programming experience, especially PowerShell

WHAT WE OFFER

Highly competitive salary range commensurate with your background and skills, plus:

  • Healthcare benefits
  • Flexible hours and independence
  • Continuing education opportunities
  • A culture where people matter more than machines

Are you called to humbly serve others? Are you organized and reliable? Do you have excellent communication and customer service skills? Are you driven to protect others from cybersecurity threats and help your team shine? If so, you are made for such a place as this!

If you are excited by how well this opportunity fits your skills and calling, then please take the time to put your best foot forward with our online application and questionnaire. It can be completed in as little as 10 minutes, but we encourage you to plan for extra time so that you aren't rushed and can answer each question fully and with personality. Apply here:

Employment for this position is contingent upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screening. Applicants must consent to these screenings as part of the hiring process. Any offer of employment is conditional until these requirements are satisfactorily met.

title: Pharmacy Specialist
description:
At K2 Medical Research, we are transforming healthcare by delivering tomorrow’s treatments today. As a rapidly growing clinical research organization across Florida, Tennessee, and Rhode Island, we lead multiphasic trials in therapeutic areas ranging from neurodegenerative to cardiometabolic medicine. Our culture is grounded in clinical excellence and a patient-first mission. We are seeking mission-driven individuals ready to play a meaningful role in bringing life-changing treatments to the patients who need them most.

K2 is seeking an experienced Pharmacy Specialist to support our clinic out of Boston, MA in a full-time capacity.

The Pharmacy Specialist assists the Pharmacy team in the administrative and technical operations of the pharmacy. This role involves assisting in the development and continued evaluation of a training process for Clinic staff interacting with the pharmacy, to assure compliance with pharmacy procedures (i.e., drug accountability, storage, administration of doses, and proper documentation of the trail of study drug to and from the pharmacy).

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Drug Management & Compliance: The Pharmacy Specialist assists staff in the receipt, storage, dispensing, and return of drug products while acting as a liaison with Pharmacy management, Clinical teams, Project Managers, and Operations. This role prepares and reviews the accuracy of labels, assists in packaging of doses, and accounts for all dosage units entering and leaving the Clinic per FDA regulations and guidelines and per study protocol requirements. The specialist assures proper protocol and regulatory procedures are followed in the receipt and handling of drug by team members and other staff responsible for dosing.
  • Quality Assurance: The Pharmacy Specialist assists in assuring that study drug product prepared and/or checked by pharmacy technical staff is of the highest quality standards to ensure the safety of the study participants and integrity of the study. This includes assisting with the completion of all required in-house sterile technique skills tests for all staff.
  • Training & Development: The Pharmacy Specialist assists in the continued evaluation of a training program for Clinic staff that interacts with the pharmacy, to assure compliance with pharmacy procedures.
  • Sponsor Relations & Study Close-Out: The Pharmacy Specialist interacts with sponsors and clients in regard to potential and on-going studies, explaining K2 Med procedures and responding to sponsor/client requests regarding handling of drug, close-out issues, and other operational matters. This role assures close-out of studies are handled properly, including ensuring drug is returned to sponsor, stored correctly, or otherwise managed depending on protocol and sponsor requirements.
  • Additional Duties: The Pharmacy Specialist performs other duties as assigned to support the expanding needs of both Phase 1 and outpatient pharmacy operations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of aseptic techniques and IV
  • Basic computer skills including Microsoft Office
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Effective time management skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities in a calm, professional manner
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment
  • Ability to adapt to increasing workload demands and support dual pharmacy operations

Qualifications:

  • Registered Pharmacists or PharmD required
  • 2+ years pharmacy technician experience
  • Pharmacy technician certification, licensed with the Board of Pharmacy

Your growth and well-being are our priority. Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes medical, dental, and vision options, supplemental insurance plans, 401(k) with immediate employer match, generous paid time off, and paid holidays. Most notably, we support a healthy work-life balance through a four-day work week, consisting of 10-hour shifts from Monday through Thursday. Fridays are reserved only for critical business needs or administrative tasks; otherwise, they are your chance to kick-start your weekend.

Join the K2 Family: Where Compassion and Connection Lead the Way! At K2 Medical Research, people come first and we're seeking warm, wonderful humans who effortlessly click with everyone, from our incredible patients to brilliant physicians and dedicated research staff.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate what makes you uniquely you and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital, or veteran statuses.

We value the differences among our team members and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact Talent@k2med.com. We are here to ensure you have the support and tools you need to shine.

Scope:

Technology and Innovation ministry requires Information Technology (IT) professional resources to provide a Senior Technical Business Analyst for the project delivery of the IMT ministry projects to Modernize & Enhancements of GoA Service Delivery within the ministry of T&I for the Alberta Public Safety and Emergency Services Ministry (PSES) - Correctional Services Division (CSD)

Initiatives to Modernize & Enhancements of GoA Service Delivery include multiple Department applications including the following:

Establish Effective Wi-Fi in Correctional Facilities- Phase 2 Implementation- Alberta's provincial correctional centers continue to face technology and connectivity limitations that restrict access to modern digital services and can impede the delivery of key justice, health, and correctional initiatives. The Correctional Services Division (CSD) Wi-Fi Implementation initiative is delivering secure end-to-end wireless infrastructure across all provincial correctional facilities, with implementation now substantially complete and only two of the ten facilities remaining. Once fully deployed, the solution will support virtual court appearances, electronic disclosure, e-learning, telehealth, staff mobility, and other digital services, improving operational efficiency, enhancing service delivery, and enabling correctional facilities to support current and future government digital transformation priorities.

Video Visitation Service (VVS)– Implementation

Alberta Correctional Services has been implementing a province-wide Video Visitation Service (VVS) to provide inmates with secure, reliable virtual access to family, friends, legal counsel, and other approved professional visitors. The initiative was originally established to ensure visitation services could be maintained during pandemic-related or similar disruptions while also modernizing the overall visitation experience across provincial correctional facilities. With implementation completed at the Edmonton Remand Centre (ERC) and the project now in its final key phase, the focus is on realizing the original vision of a modern, standardized video visitation platform, including enhanced technology capabilities and system-to-system integration with the Offender Management System. In addition to improving accessibility, operational efficiency, and service delivery, the initiative establishes the foundation for future province-wide expansion of video visitation capabilities, enabling Correctional Services to support evolving operational needs and deliver a consistent, scalable visitation experience across Alberta's correctional network.

title: Senior Backend Engineer II - Data
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer II - Data to design, build, and maintain the data foundation that powers our clinical products and workflows.

This is a software engineering role at its core. You will play a key role in building and evolving our Medical Data Server, working alongside the existing Medical Data Platform team across its Python services, APIs, database architecture, and production operations. You will also apply industry best practices to design the data models, integrations, and pipelines that make complex clinical information reliable and accessible across Prenuvo products.

You will work with complex healthcare data, including FHIR and HL7, to build reliable data models, integrations, and pipelines. Your work will make clinical information accessible and trustworthy across clinical applications, reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Build and Evolve the Medical Data Server: Collaborate with engineers across the Clinical Data team to design, build, and operate the Python backend services and RESTful APIs responsible for managing clinical data.
  • Clinical Data Architecture: Partner closely with the Architecture team and other engineering stakeholders to design and evolve scalable clinical data models using healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7. Help establish clear boundaries, ownership, and contracts across clinical data domains.
  • Data Pipeline Development: Build and maintain reliable batch and event-driven pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver clinical data across operational systems, data platforms, reporting tools, and downstream applications.
  • Data Quality and Reliability: Establish automated validation, testing, reconciliation, and monitoring to identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated, or incorrectly mapped clinical data before it affects users or downstream systems.
  • Data Modeling and Transformation: Develop maintainable transformation layers and curated datasets that support clinical reporting, operational analytics, product functionality, and AI use cases.
  • Data Governance and Lineage: Implement practices for data documentation, lineage, provenance, versioning, retention, and auditability. Help ensure clinical data remains trustworthy and explainable throughout its lifecycle.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with clinical, product, application engineering, architecture, data analytics, and AI teams to translate clinical workflows and business needs into durable technical solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead design discussions, contribute to architectural decisions, review technical implementations, mentor engineers, and help establish engineering standards for clinical data development.

What You’ll Bring

  • Backend Engineering Experience: 6–8 years of software engineering experience, including ownership of production services and databasesPython Expertise: Strong experience building production Python applications and APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
  • Data Engineering: Experience designing and operating scalable ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines using batch, streaming, or event-driven patterns.
  • Healthcare Data: Hands‑on experience working with clinical or healthcare data, including a strong understanding of FHIR resources, HL7 standards, terminology, and interoperability challenges.
  • Data Modeling: Experience designing normalized, dimensional, and domain‑oriented data models. You understand how modeling decisions affect data quality, usability, and system performance.
  • Engineering Ownership: Ability to independently lead complex initiatives, make sound technical decisions, and balance short‑term delivery with long‑term maintainability.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with FHIR servers, clinical data repositories, electronic health record systems, or medical imaging and reporting workflows.
  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology standards such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, or DICOM.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and clinical reporting or AI-enabled healthcare products.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform‑Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre‑tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role is $165,000 to $180,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location

We are an equal‑opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain (prenuvo.com). If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

description:
Job Description


Title: Milk Receiving

Classification/Job Grade: Hourly

Pay Scale: $21.63 - $29.75

Location: Battle Creek, MI

Department: Receiving

Supervised by: Supervisor

Job Summary

The Milk Receiver plays a critical role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant receipt of raw milk and cream products used in dairy production. This position is responsible for inspecting, sampling, testing, documenting, unloading, and storing incoming milk shipments while adhering to all food safety, quality, sanitation, and regulatory requirements. The Milk Receiver must maintain accurate records, operate and monitor receiving equipment, ensure proper cleaning and sanitation of tankers and silos, and support overall plant operations. This position requires strong attention to detail, effective communication skills, the ability to work independently, and a commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Receive raw milk and dairy products in accordance with company, state, federal, quality, and food safety requirements.
  • Inspect incoming tanker loads and verify documentation prior to unloading.
  • Collect and maintain milk samples for required testing and quality verification.
  • Ensure sample integrity through proper handling, storage, and documentation.
  • Monitor silo capacity and confirm silos are properly drained and prepared prior to receiving products.
  • Operate and monitor milk receiving, transfer, and storage equipment.
  • Wash and sanitize milk tankers, silos, and receiving equipment using automated Clean-In-Place (CIP) systems.
  • Verify and document chemical concentrations and CIP wash effectiveness.
  • Accurately complete all receiving, sanitation, quality, and regulatory documentation.
  • Maintain records related to milk receipts, silo usage, testing results, and sanitation activities.
  • Load and unload trucks as required.
  • Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), food safety policies, quality requirements, and company policies.
  • Identify, communicate, and escalate equipment, quality, safety, or operational concerns.
  • Effectively prioritize work assignments to meet operational demands.
  • Maintain a professional working relationship with team members, drivers, supervisors, and other departments.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and effective decision-making skills.
  • Support cross-functional plant operations as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Soft Skills

  • Must be able to follow both verbal and written instructions.
  • Coachable and willing to learn new processes, procedures, and equipment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment with people of varying skills and backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and operational needs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

Core Competencies

  • Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations accurately.
  • Effective time management skills to achieve results through prioritization and organization.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking and sound decision-making abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Must demonstrate proficiency in essential job tasks and responsibilities.
  • Analytical skills to interpret operational and production data.
  • Strategic thinking and reporting skills to support operational needs.
  • Strong communication skills for collaboration with drivers, team members, supervisors, quality personnel, and other departments.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability and productivity.


Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing duties of this role, the employee may be frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts and forklifts.
  • The employee will occasionally be exposed to wet, humid, and cold conditions (non-weather related).
  • The noise level in the work environment may be loud.
  • Will be required to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work in varying temperatures and climates.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and maneuver products weighing up to 50 pounds out of confined spaces and occasionally lift products overhead.
  • Ability to stand, kneel, climb ladders, and perform other physical requirements as needed.
  • Work may require weekends, holidays, overtime, and varying shifts based on operational needs.


Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to frequently climb stairs and access elevated work areas.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, kneel, squat, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.
  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and maneuver products and materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to occasionally lift materials overhead.
  • Ability to work safely in confined spaces and around production equipment.
  • Ability to climb ladders and access equipment as necessary.
  • Must be able to wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE).

About Prairie Farms

"Farmer Owned. Locally Produced. Since 1938."

Prairie Farms Dairy is a farmer-owned cooperative operated by more than 800 farm families dedicated to producing nutritious, high-quality dairy products. Since 1938, Prairie Farms has represented American agriculture and remains committed to supporting local communities, employees, customers, and farm families through quality products and responsible business practices.

Our Mission

  • To conduct our business with professional integrity.
  • To exceed expectations of our customers and consumers.
  • To support our communities in a positive, sustainable manner.
  • To deliver exceptional patronage to our network of farm families.

  • Join a collaborative team that values accountability, curiosity, clear communication, and continuous learning.



About the Role

As an IT Technical Specialist Level 2, you will own and resolve Level 2 service requests in a fast-paced MSP environment. You will investigate issues thoroughly, use available documentation and ticket history, communicate professionally with clients and colleagues, and keep work moving without needing step-by-step supervision.

This role is for a capable Level 2 technician who can complete routine infrastructure work once the objective and design are established. Larger or more complex projects will be directed and reviewed by senior team members; this position is not expected to independently architect complex solutions or act as the primary technical contact for assigned client accounts.



Key Responsibilities

  • Own, investigate, resolve, document, and escalate Level 2 tickets within SLA.
  • Troubleshoot Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, virtualization, networking, firewalls, VPNs, and endpoint issues.
  • Review ticket history and documentation before escalating issues.
  • Support and guide Level 1 technicians on escalated requests.
  • Complete routine infrastructure work with direction, including server and Hyper-V migrations, domain controller replacements, Cisco Firepower firewall work, managed-switch replacements, VLANs, and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and communicate professionally with clients and internal teams.



Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of technical support, systems administration, or IT client-services experience.
  • MSP experience is required.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset, ownership, organization, and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
  • Able to accept feedback and work collaboratively.
  • Valid driver’s licence and reliable vehicle for onsite client visits.
  • Available for an on-call rotation.
  • Experience with RMM/PSA tools, preferably N-able N-central and ConnectWise Manage.



Technical Skills

You should have hands-on experience with:

  • Windows Server 2016–2022, including Active Directory, Group Policy, file and share permissions, domain controller administration, and server administration.
  • Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.
  • VMware and Hyper-V virtualization, including virtual machine management and routine host replacement or migration work.
  • Enterprise workstation deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Networking fundamentals, including switches, routers, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN connectivity.
  • Firewall configuration and troubleshooting, preferably Cisco Firepower, Fortinet FortiGate, and Ubiquiti UniFi.
  • Endpoint protection, incident response, and remediation using tools such as SentinelOne, Bitdefender, and FortiClient EMS.
  • Remote monitoring and management tools, ticketing systems, and technical documentation.



Preferred Credentials

  • CompTIA Network+ or equivalent practical experience.
  • Microsoft certifications, CCNA, or comparable certifications are an asset.
  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is an asset.
  • ITIL or IT project coordination experience is an asset.


What Success Looks Like

  • Level 2 incidents are owned, resolved accurately, and completed within SLA.
  • Client environments and ticket histories are understood well enough to troubleshoot confidently and escalate thoughtfully.
  • Routine infrastructure work is prepared, executed, and documented reliably once scope and design are established.
  • Level 1 technicians receive practical support and clients feel informed and well supported.
  • Documentation is current, communication is constructive, and recurring issues are reduced through thorough investigation.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Software Development Engineer

Precision Analytical (PA) is the creator of the DUTCH Test, an innovative hormone test that creates better tools for healthcare professionals to explore hormone issues with their patients. PA exists to make it easier for patients and their healthcare providers to find answers to complex clinical questions. We are fully committed to our mission of providing the best diagnostic tools in functional medicine.

This position is located in McMinnville, Oregon, in the beautiful Willamette Valley. This is a hybrid role. We are seeking candidates who can work effectively from both a home office and our McMinnville office or other worksites.

Compensation & Benefits

At PA, we base our pay ranges on the market median of similar jobs, as determined by third-party salary benchmark surveys. The salary range reflects the minimum to midpoint of the salary range to provide room for growth. Your individual pay will vary based on skills, experience, and internal equity. During your initial interview with the Talent partner, you can expect to have an open discussion about your pay expectations.

With a career at PA, you get:

  • Market-based competitive wage
  • Bonus potential
  • 401(k) with employer contribution
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Wellness program
  • Onsite gym
  • Paid time off
  • Holiday & Floating holiday
  • Casual work environment
  • Employee assistance program
  • Free DUTCH Tests
  • …and more!

About the Role

We're rebuilding our architecture from the ground up, and we're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help shape it. You'll design, build, and ship scalable cloud-native applications with a focus on AWS serverless, event-driven architecture, and TypeScript/Node.js, while drawing on solid experience with traditional application architectures too.

Who You Are

You're a hands-on engineer with a curious streak. You've opened up a codebase, asked "why does it work like this?", and then actually gone and found out. You're equally comfortable with serverless and traditional architectures, and you know when each one is the right tool. You enjoy hard problems, ambiguous requirements don't rattle you, and you care about how your code connects to the business it serves. When you dig into an existing system, you can tell the difference between what the business actually needs and what someone bolted on years ago as a workaround.

What You'll Do

Most of your work will be building new systems, and those systems will need to integrate closely with our existing applications and platforms. That means designing clean, well-defined integrations that keep our architecture flexible as it evolves. On our small team you won't be siloed: you'll have a hand in every stage of the software lifecycle, from shaping requirements to shipping to production.

This role reports to the VP of Technology.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

  • Help shape our new architecture from the ground up, choosing between serverless, containerized, and traditional approaches, and between monolithic and microservice designs, based on what each problem actually needs
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, cloud-native applications using AWS and modern software development practices
  • Build serverless and event-driven systems using AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Step Functions, as well as ECS and Docker containers
  • Apply distributed-system patterns such as pub/sub, saga, idempotency, retries and dead-letter queues, and CQRS to build reliable and resilient systems
  • Develop infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and/or SAM
  • Build backend services and applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js
  • Design and work with both relational SQL databases and NoSQL databases, including DynamoDB
  • Apply strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, software design patterns, SOLID principles, and separation of concerns
  • Use sound judgment when applying design patterns, recognizing when a pattern improves maintainability and when it introduces unnecessary complexity
  • Participate in Git-based development and pull-request workflows, including code reviews and collaborative problem solving
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated testing, including unit, integration, and characterization testing
  • Analyze existing applications and workflows to understand their business logic, identify the true business rules, and translate them into modern cloud-native designs
  • Design integrations between new services and existing applications and platforms, including data synchronization and migration between database platforms
  • Monitor and troubleshoot applications using AWS observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray, along with structured logging and other appropriate practices
  • Apply sound IAM and cloud security fundamentals when designing and implementing AWS solutions
  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements, explain trade-offs, and make practical decisions
  • Stay current with emerging development tools, including AI-assisted coding and AI application development, and apply them thoughtfully with appropriate review and testing
  • Contribute to LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, vector search, MCP servers, agent tooling, and evaluation of LLM output quality, as applicable to business needs
  • Contribute across the technology stack as needed, including frontend development, infrastructure, data, and direct interaction with users

Qualifications

Required

  • The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of professional software development experience and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered
  • Hands-on experience building AWS serverless and event-driven applications, including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS, and Docker
  • Experience designing and building with both serverless and traditional application architectures, and the judgment to know when each is the right fit
  • Strong experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, and NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB
  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, complexity, software design patterns, SOLID principles, and separation of concerns
  • Experience with AWS CDK/SAM, Git, pull-request workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing
  • Understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and resilient architecture, including pub/sub, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, saga, and CQRS
  • Ability to work effectively with existing systems, including reverse‑engineering business logic and using characterization testing to capture current behavior

Preferred

  • Experience with React/Next.js, Python, Java, AWS observability and security, and software development in healthcare or other regulated industries
  • Experience integrating new cloud-native services with established applications, including data synchronization and migration between platforms
  • Experience using AI coding tools effectively and critically reviewing generated code
  • Experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG, embeddings/vector search, MCP servers, agent tooling, and LLM evaluation
  • Familiarity with C#/.NET, Angular, Azure, Jira, and Confluence

Work Environment

This position is in an office (or a home) environment with frequent use of a computer and related hardware. A person must be able to stand and/or sit; see, hear and talk; use hands to type, handle or feel tools or controls; use hands and arms to reach. Occasionally lifting/moving up to 30lbs is also required.

In addition, this position may require a person to travel via car, airplane, and other modes of transportation to various sites including Precision Analytical locations, stores or vendor locations, training or meeting venues, or conferences.

EEO Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

title: Teamleder - Middelfart
description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Teamleder, der kan hjælpe os med at få hverdagen til at glide som smør på friskbagt brød i butikken. Her bruger du din erfaring med service, overblik og ansvar, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Det fortæller en af vores kollegaer om at være Teamleder
“Det bedste ved arbejdet er friheden under ansvar. Man får virkelig lov til at tage ejerskab over hverdagen i butikken og være med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både gæster og kollegaer.”

Dine hverdag bliver fyldt med…
Kort sagt handler rollen som Teamleder om at være tæt på den daglige drift og hjælpe teamet godt på vej.
Den lidt længere version er, at du sammen med butikschefen er med til at skabe en butik, hvor både gæster og kollegaer mærker den gode stemning fra morgenstunden. Du skaber struktur i hverdagen, støtter teamet og er med til at sikre gode oplevelser for vores gæster. Samtidig bidrager du til et trygt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi lykkes sammen, og træder naturligt frem, når butikschefen ikke er der. Du får selvfølgelig også en grundig introduktion, så du hurtigt føler dig godt hjemme.

Vi tror på, at du vil trive hos os, hvis du…

  • kan kommunikere klart og tydeligt med alle du møder.
  • får energi af at se andre lykkes - og selv være en vigtig brik i det.
  • tager initiativ og kan bevare roen, når tempoet er højt.
  • har mod på at vokse med opgaven og tage nye skridt i din udvikling.

Hvad vi tilbyder dig
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos os
Din arbejdsuge er på 30 timer, og arbejdstiden fordeler sig på alle ugens dage i tidsrummet kl. 06.00 til 19.00. Du skal forvente at arbejde hver anden weekend og på helligdage.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

title: Director, Software Test Engineering & Quality Assurance
description:
At Apple, the systems and technology that power our internal operations, supply chain, and customer support are just as important as the products we build. The IS&T, Operations, and AppleCare Technologies organizations are essential to how Apple delivers at scale, enabling everything from global logistics and enterprise infrastructure to the world-class support experiences our customers depend on every day. Spanning three of Apple's most mission-critical domains and a diverse technology landscape that includes cloud, mobile, legacy, and emerging AI/ML systems, this organization is responsible for ensuring that every application, system, and process that powers Apple's internal and customer-facing operations meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance.

As the Director of Software Test Engineering & Quality Assurance, you will lead a unified, global quality organization responsible for defining and executing Apple's enterprise-wide software validation vision, bringing together a world-class team under a single, cohesive testing approach that raises the bar on engineering excellence across IS&T, Operations, and AppleCare Technologies.

This leader owns the end-to-end testing strategy across IS&T, Operations, and AppleCare Technologies, ensuring that every application, system, and process meets Apple's exceptionally high bar for quality before it reaches the people who depend on it. Leading a global organization, this leader defines and executes a unified, enterprise-wide testing strategy, modernizes QA infrastructure by replacing manual overhead with scalable automation frameworks, and partners closely with engineering, product, and operations leaders to embed quality throughout the software development and systems lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software portfolio management, quality engineering, test strategy, and/or related technical disciplines, with 7+ years leading large, globally distributed quality or engineering organizations.
  • Proven track record of building, scaling, or transforming BPR, engineering or testing functions across multiple geographies and distinct technology domains
  • Expertise in testing methodologies** across enterprise applications, cloud-native systems, mobile platforms, legacy architectures, and AI/ML pipelines in large-scale technology environments.
  • Strong automation acumen, with a demonstrated ability to replace manual testing pipelines with scalable automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, and Selenium, and robust API testing methodologies including Postman and RestAssured
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational transformation, including team integrations, functional consolidations, or the establishment of shared services functions
  • Exceptional cross-functional influence, with a proven ability to drive alignment across engineering, product, DevOps, and operations stakeholders and engage confidently at the senior executive level
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading testing functions across multiple distinct domains simultaneously, such as enterprise IT, supply chain and operations, and customer support technologies
  • Experience managing quality across multi-stack environments, including cloud-native SaaS, mobile, legacy core systems, and emerging AI/ML pipelines
  • Familiarity with enterprise platforms and systems commonly used in IS&T, operational, or customer support environments
  • Demonstrated success consolidating or standing up large-scale quality organizations or shared services functions

Her bruger du din erfaring med service, nærvær og overblik, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Det fortæller en kollega om rollen
”Hverdagen er travl på den gode måde, og ingen dage er helt ens. Jeg elsker energien i butikken og følelsen af, at vi løfter i flok."

title: Ergoterapeuter til Hedens Hjemmepleje
description:
Vi søger 2 ergoterapeuter til helt nye stillinger i helhedsplejen

Vil du være med fra starten – og have mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på både stillingen, arbejdsopgaverne og den ergoterapeutiske indsats i helhedsplejen?

Så er det nu, du skal læse med.

Hedens Hjemmepleje søger 2 ergoterapeuter til to helt nyoprettede stillinger i vores helhedspleje.

Stillingerne er nye, og derfor får du og din kommende ergoterapeutkollega en helt særlig mulighed for at være med til at forme funktionen fra begyndelsen. I får mulighed for at præge arbejdsopgaver, arbejdsgange, samarbejdsformer og den måde, vi integrerer den ergoterapeutiske og rehabiliterende tilgang i den daglige hjemmepleje.

Vi har rammerne og ambitionerne – men vi ønsker, at I er med til at skabe indholdet.

Hvem er Hedens Hjemmepleje?

Hedens Hjemmepleje er fritvalgsleverandør i Herning Kommune, og vi dækker hele kommunen med personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp.

Vi startede op i november 2023 og er i dag ca. 90 medarbejdere.

Vores kerneværdier er:

Kvalitet – Samarbejde – Sammenhæng

Vi har stort fokus på kontinuitet for både vores borgere og medarbejdere. Vi tror på, at kendte ansigter, gode relationer og et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde er med til at skabe kvalitet og sammenhæng i borgernes forløb.

Hos os prioriterer vi synlig og nærværende ledelse. Der vil altid være en leder på arbejde og til stede, og vi lægger vægt på, at problemstillinger bliver håndteret, når de opstår – og ikke nødvendigvis skal vente til næste dag.

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af funktioner og fagligheder. Ingen er for store eller små til at tage over for hinanden. Uanset om du er udekørende medarbejder, terapeut, koordinator eller leder, løfter vi i flok og hjælper hinanden med at få hverdagen til at hænge sammen.

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Som ergoterapeut bliver du tilknyttet enten Team Land eller Team By.

Team Land dækker områderne nord, syd og dele af vest, mens Team By dækker øst og dele af vest.

I hvert team vil der være ca. 12–18 udekørende medarbejdere, som du får et tæt samarbejde med.

Du og den anden ergoterapeut vil samtidig få et tæt samarbejde på tværs af de to teams. I skal sparre med hinanden, hjælpe hinanden og sammen være med til at udvikle den ergoterapeutiske og rehabiliterende indsats i Hedens Hjemmepleje.

Derudover vil der være faglige møder og mulighed for sparring med kommunens øvrige terapeuter.

Din rolle i helhedsplejen

Som ergoterapeut bliver du en vigtig del af borgernes samlede forløb.

Du skal ikke kun arbejde med den enkelte borger, men også være med til at understøtte vores udekørende medarbejdere i deres daglige arbejde.

Du får blandt andet en central rolle i forhold til APV, rehabilitering, hjælpemidler, funktionsevne og opfølgning på borgerforløb.

En vigtig del af din funktion bliver at sikre, at der arbejdes rehabiliterende omkring borgeren, at igangsatte tiltag bliver fulgt op, og at forløb bliver justeret eller afsluttet, når borgerens behov ændrer sig.

Du bliver dermed både en faglig sparringspartner for medarbejderne og en aktiv del af borgerens forløb.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

· deltage aktivt i tværfaglige møder, opstartsmøder, borgerkonferencer, triagering og øvrige relevante koordinerende fora

· bidrage til planlægning og gennemførelse af visiterede borgerforløb med afsæt i rehabilitering, borgerens egne mål og en helhedsorienteret indsats

· udrede og vurdere borgerens funktionsevne, aktivitetsudførelse, ressourcer og rehabiliteringspotentiale samt iværksætte relevante ergoterapeutiske indsatser

· identificere borgere med potentiale for rehabiliteringsforløb, herunder ABLE-forløb, og gennemføre disse i samarbejde med Forebyggelse og Samtidsindsatser

· vurdere behovet for træningshjælpemidler, APV-hjælpemidler, velfærdsteknologiske løsninger og mindre boligtilpasninger samt bidrage til koordinering med kommunens myndighedsområder

· gennemføre boligvurderinger i forbindelse med udskrivelse fra sygehus eller ved væsentlige ændringer i borgerens funktionsevne

· vejlede borgere, pårørende og medarbejdere om hjælpemidler, aktivitetsfremmende metoder, energiforvaltning, hverdagsmestring og hensigtsmæssige arbejdsgange

· understøtte en rehabiliterende tilgang i helhedsplejen og bidrage til, at borgeren bevarer eller udvikler evnen til at klare mest muligt selv

· sikre brobygning til relevante trænings-, aktivitets- og fællesskabstilbud

· bidrage til tidlig opsporing af funktionsfald og iværksættelse af relevante indsatser

· sikre rettidig, fyldestgørende og fagligt begrundet dokumentation

· bidrage til medarbejdernes kompetenceudvikling gennem undervisning, faglig sparring, vejledning og sidemandsoplæring

· medvirke til udvikling og implementering af rehabiliterende metoder, faglige standarder og arbejdsgange

· følge op på igangsatte indsatser og sikre, at borgerforløb justeres og afsluttes, når målene er nået eller behovet ændrer sig

· understøtte de udekørende medarbejdere i forhold til APV og sikre gode og forsvarlige arbejdsgange omkring borgeren

· deltage i relevante faglige netværk, møder og udviklingsaktiviteter.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, der er uddannet ergoterapeut, og som har lyst til at bruge din faglighed tæt på både borgere og medarbejdere.

Det er et krav, at du har erfaring fra hjemmeplejen og/eller plejehjem, da stillingen kræver en god forståelse for den daglige drift, arbejdsgangene og kompleksiteten i plejen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

· brænder for rehabilitering og for at hjælpe borgere til størst mulig selvstændighed

· trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med andre faggrupper

· kan omsætte din faglige viden til konkrete løsninger i hverdagen

· har lyst til at undervise, vejlede og sparre med medarbejdere

· kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig ser dig selv som en del af et fælles team

· er fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en hverdag, hvor planer nogle gange ændrer sig

· tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver og borgerforløb til dørs

· har lyst til udvikling og tør komme med nye idéer og forslag.

To nye stillinger – med plads til dine idéer

Vi har ikke lavet en færdig kasse, som du skal passe ned i.

Tværtimod.

Det er første gang, vi ansætter ergoterapeuter direkte ind i denne funktion, og derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som har lyst til at være med til at bygge funktionen op sammen med os.

Vi ved, hvad vi gerne vil opnå: endnu stærkere rehabilitering, bedre sammenhæng i borgerforløbene og tættere faglig understøttelse af vores udekørende medarbejdere.

Hvordan vi bedst kommer derhen, vil vi gerne have, at du er med til at forme.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

Stillingerne er primært i dagvagt.

Derudover skal du arbejde hver 6. weekend, hvor du vil have en tovholderfunktion og være med til at sikre overblik, koordinering og sammenhæng i weekendens drift.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Aftales i forbindelse med samtale og ansættelse.

Ansøgning og samtaler

Ansøgningsfrist: 6. november 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde første samtaler 16. eller 17. november 2026.

Der kan eventuelt blive afholdt 2. samtale den 24. november 2026.

Hvis du er interesseret i en af stillingerne, bedes du sende din ansøgning til:

andreas@hedenshjemmepleje.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker at høre mere om jobbet og mulighederne for at være med til at forme den nye funktion, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Andreas på tlf. 41 34 99 48.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde dig velkommen som en af de første ergoterapeuter i Hedens Hjemmepleje.

title: Servicespecialist

  • Provide accountability for helpdesk administration, end-user forums, and complaint management systems

  • Develop comprehensive asset management strategies for hard services with lifecycle planning for the managed site

  • Direct predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance programs across assigned properties

  • Manage subcontractor performance, ensuring compliance with contract requirements and company standards

  • Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of asset histories in client systems

  • Coordinate engineering support for critical systems including elevators, plumbing, and building mechanical systems

  • Manage MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) supplies and maintain tools inventory

  • Manage General Building Works, Cleaning, Landscaping and other soft-services related scope.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)

senior Remote Remote US

Description

At Affir, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affir's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affir services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems.

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build and scale Relational and Distributed SQL Databases identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productionize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What you’ll do

  • You will build and operate the control plane for large-scale distributed SQL databases such as MySQL and TiDB, automating provisioning, failover, backups and upgrades end to end.
  • You will design and execute reliability-focused schema and data migrations across multi-tenant database clusters, with zero downtime for the products that depend on them.
  • You will own the networking stack that connects services to storage on Kubernetes, including connection proxies such as ProxySQL, and tune it for latency, resilience and failover.
  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

title: Yardi Systems Specialist
description:
Yardi Systems Specialist

POSITION SUMMARY

The Yardi Systems Specialist is a subject matter expert and administrator on the team for the Yardi Property Management system. This individual is accountable for the operational integrity, user support and continuous enhancement of the Yardi platform, the modules implemented to date, and those that are on the implementation roadmap. Particular emphasis on identifying and resolving data discrepancies arising from system integrations is an integral part of this role. The role bridges systems accuracy across Pratum's disciplines, including accounting aspects, with technical troubleshooting and process optimization, serving as both a hands-on problem solver and strategic system guide.

This is not a remote role and will require on-site daily office presence in our company's Gaithersburg, MD HQ as a standard expectation.

PRIMARY/ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support and Administration

  • Provide technical support to users of the Yardi products including Voyager Affordable, RentCafe, Procure to Pay and others in a timely manner.
  • Create and maintain users, manage permissions and property assignments, scheduled reports, custom menus and workflows.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for clients experiencing Yardi software-related problems, guiding them through problem identification, resolution, and prevention.
  • Serve as the escalation point and liaison for Yardi support; collaborate with other team members and Yardi client support to resolve complex technical issues promptly.
  • Track and review performance data of various Yardi modules to identify trends and issues and develop improvement plans.
  • Work with vendors to establish and maintain Yardi data exchange.

Yardi Migration and Implementation

  • Serve as primary point of contact and technical project lead to migrate properties to Yardi platform.
  • Assist with the onboarding of new properties and associated setup as part of the transition team, as well as the offboarding/transition of properties as the circumstances arise.
  • Work with departments to test and implement new Yardi modules.
  • Practice sound project management skills to ensure projects stay on track and implementation milestone objectives are met.

Training

  • Participates in, and serves as a facilitator and subject matter expert, in ensuring all system users are trained and capable of performing required job tasks within the Yardi system. This includes new hire and onboarding training, support for staff at new-hire orientation, development of training guides and curriculum/course materials, training of current staff who are or will be users of the system, etc.
  • Analyze support tickets and work with department heads to create opportunities for additional training and continuous education.
  • Identify and streamline processes and work with other departments to implement.
  • Maintain system documentation, including configuration records, process workflows.


REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Over 3 years' experience as a Yardi user and administrator including Voyager Affordable, RentCafe, Procure to Pay, and other system applications/features. Prior experience with other residential multi-family property management systems (e.g. RealPage/OneSite) is helpful.
  • Experience in serving as a subject matter expert with the Yardi system, with demonstrated capability in handling/managing/resolving software system access, new property set-up, new user set-up and permissions, ad-hoc and scheduled report generation, custom menus, workflow creation, etc. Prior experience in-house with a multi-family property management company, including affordable housing (LIHTC, HUD Project Based Section 8, etc.).
  • Prior experience in leading a software implementation effort from beginning to successful completion. Yardi software implementation experience strongly preferred. Capable of rallying positive support for achieving project milestones, managing and collaborating with stakeholders, both inside and outside of the company, to stay on-track and on-schedule with tact and professionalism.
  • Capable of training employees in all operational aspects of Yardi. Comfortable presenting the subject matter one-on-one, to small groups in-person in a classroom setting, on-line via virtual/web-based training, etc.
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with excellent attention to detail. Adept at owning projects and tasks, managing deliverables to meet deadlines, connecting with people and facilitating effective collaboration to achieve successful outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office Suite experience (Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, etc.)


WORK ENVIRONMENT

The role will be based at the company’s corporate offices in Gaithersburg, MD and the work environment is predominantly office/clerical. This is not a remote role and will require on-site daily office presence as a standard expectation.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to read, write, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to sit; use hands/fingers to handle or feel (e.g. type); and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20+ pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Must have reliable transportation and ability to meet attendance/punctuality requirements and to facilitate on-site visits to properties (5-10% travel estimated).

This role is exempt and has an anticipated annualized base salary range of $65k-$75k for a new employee depending on a number of relevant factors including individuals’ experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, abilities, client/property or company budgetary limitations/guidelines, and other job-related company and market considerations. This position may be eligible to receive discretionary and/or performance-based bonuses on a spot or annual basis, which are variable depending on individual merit/performance, budgetary limitations, company performance, and other job-related factors. Full-time positions (30+ hours/week) are eligible for 2 weeks paid vacation, 1 week sick and related leave, 11 paid holidays, and health & welfare benefits as outlined on the Company’s website. title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description

Full Stack Developer – Digital Experience

Full-time | Hybrid role | Brisbane

Join the Canstar Group and make a real difference every day!

We are seeking a proactive, product-minded Full Stack Developer to engineer the best online experience for Canstar customers. In this role, you will build and scale high-performing web applications that enable millions of Australians to compare financial and consumer products online, while also developing internal tooling and cutting-edge GenAI/agentic solutions for our operations teams.

Working within a cross-functional Agile squad alongside Product Owners, Designers, and Data Engineers, you will work across our modern front-end stack (Next.js/React) and robust backend GraphQL APIs deployed on AWS and GCP. If you thrive on taking end-to-end ownership, from building high-traffic customer interfaces to connecting AI agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP), this is the perfect opportunity to make a tangible digital impact.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Application Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performing, accessible front-end applications using Next.js, React, and modern web architectures.
  • Develop, scale, and optimize business-critical GraphQL and REST APIs deployed on cloud infrastructure.
  • Design efficient relational data models in PostgreSQL and build data pipelines in BigQuery using Dataform.
  • Deliver and deploy code through modern DevOps/CI pipelines targeting AWS and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, GCE, Cloud Build).

GenAI, Automation & Internal Tooling

  • Build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connecting internal enterprise data and SaaS tools (AWS, GCP, Atlassian) to LLM “agents”.
  • Develop internal tools and workflow applications to streamline operations for tech and other teams.

Quality, Reliability & Security

  • Establish and enforce rigorous automated testing standards (unit, integration, and E2E testing).
  • Maintain enterprise-grade monitoring, logging, and alerting using cloud-native tools to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Participate in routine operational activities including logging, monitoring, incident triage, and proactive system maintenance.
  • Adhere strictly to security best practices, ensuring zero public exposure of PII or sensitive customer data, and proactively remediate code vulnerabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Full Stack Experience: 3–5 years of web application development experience in commercial environments.
  • Core Languages & Frameworks: Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript/Node.js, with hands-on experience using Next.js, GraphQL, and REST APIs.
  • Database & Data Pipelines: Solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), query optimization, data modeling, and constructing data pipelines in BigQuery via GCP Dataform.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Proven experience deploying and operating services on AWS and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, GCE, Cloud Build, IAM, Secrets Manager, monitoring).
  • AI & LLM Integration: Exposure to large language models or GenAI (Vertex AI, Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic) with hands-on experience building simple LLM-backed endpoints or apps (prompting, function calling, RAG).
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Ability to build and maintain MCP servers connecting internal data and SaaS products (GCP, AWS, Atlassian) to LLM “agents”.
  • Security, Governance & Reliability: Deep awareness of PII, data residency, and compliance constraints (mindful of never exposing customer data publicly). Experience maintaining enterprise-level monitoring/alerting and remediating high-severity vulnerabilities across multiple repositories.

Desired skills and experience

  • Domain Curiosity: Curiosity about product and business workflows, with the willingness to shadow and learn directly from internal teams (e.g., Editorial).
  • AI Ownership Trajectory: Comfortable starting as a “regular” Full Stack developer, with the drive to take on increasing ownership of AI and agentic tooling work over time.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Clear communication and documentation habits, backed by strong analytical skills to explain AI behavior, risks, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Product Mindset: Cares deeply about adoption, usability, and measurable commercial/customer impact.
  • Agility & Adaptability: Skilled at navigating shifting priorities; maintains a consistent development velocity for new features while proactively resolving high-priority production issues to ensure system stability.
  • Tooling Proficiency: Ability to work effectively within the Atlassian suite of products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket).

Why Join Us?

  • Hybrid Work Model: Flexible work arrangements balancing office culture and work-from-home focus.
  • Innovation & Career Growth: Opportunity to expand your scope into GenAI, LLM agent architecture, and modern cloud architecture within an established industry leader.
  • Play a Part in Helping Australians Compare Better: Your work directly empowers consumers to make informed financial decisions every day.
  • Culture: Be part of a supportive, high-performing engineering culture focused on continuous learning, best practices, and collaboration.
  • Perks & Benefits: Fully stocked kitchen for in-office breakfasts & lunches, monthly catered lunches, birthday morning teas, ClassPass benefits, and comprehensive wellness perks.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply now and join Canstar Group as we continue to help Australians compare better.

description:

Our Credit Risk Tech team as one integral part of the broader lending team orchestrates and builds solutions that allow a regulatory compliant credit risk management for the aforementioned lending products. That includes credit assessments, credit risk monitoring and early warning systems, as well as credit agency integrations. In this role, you will be the credit risk tech product owner, collaborating closely with stakeholders across Credit risk Management, Operations, Legal and other departments to deliver a seamless and consumer centric experience.

Your Role

  • End-to-End Product Management: Take full ownership of a product sub-domain, from conceptualization to delivery, ensuring alignment with overall business goals. Together with the Engineering counterparts form the leadership team for the domain. You own and drive the vision, strategy and priorities of the Credit Risk Tech products in collaboration with the rest of the Solaris SE product team.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, clearly communicating product visions, strategies, and updates.
  • Strategic Roadmap Development: Contribute to the creation and execution of product roadmaps, setting clear priorities and milestones.
  • Agile Leadership and Team Guidance: Implement and refine agile methodologies within the development team to enhance productivity and delivery quality.
  • Solution Design and Innovation: Drive the development of solutions that meet market needs and user expectations, staying ahead of industry trends and applying creative thinking to solve problems.
  • Operational Excellence and Compliance: You participate in the proactive identification, management, and mitigation of risks and findings within your product domain, aligning with Solaris' compliance and policy standards.

We'd love to see

Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.

Benefits

  • Deutschland ticket subsidy.

Autat asiakkaita pukeutumaan asianmukaisesti safareille tai muutaman päivän loman ajaksi. Safarien jälkeen vastuullasi on haalareiden, pipojen, sukkien ynnä muiden pesu - ja järjestelytoimet.
