title: R&D Associate
description:
Turn Science Into Products That Make a Difference

At FoodScience, R&D doesn't stop when a formula works at the bench.

We are looking for an onsite in our Williston, Vermont location. An R&D Associate who wants to be part of the entire product development journey, from researching ingredients and developing formulations to figuring out how those products will actually be manufactured consistently, efficiently, and at scale.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys both the science of product development and the problem-solving of process engineering. You will work at the intersection of R&D and manufacturing, helping transform innovative concepts into commercially viable products that support the health and wellness of pets.

You don't necessarily need to come to us with years of pet supplement formulation experience. We're interested in people with strong scientific or engineering fundamentals, curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and experience working with products or processes in a manufacturing environment.

If you enjoy asking "How can we make this work?" and then getting into the lab or onto the production floor to figure it out, this may be the opportunity for you.

What You'll Own

Product Development & Formulation

  • Support the development of new nutritional supplement products from initial concept through commercialization.
  • Develop, modify, and evaluate formulations based on product objectives, ingredient functionality, manufacturability, quality, and performance.
  • Conduct bench-scale trials and experiments to evaluate formulations and processing conditions.
  • Research ingredients, technologies, and scientific developments that can support new product innovation.
  • Document experimental work, observations, results, and recommendations.
  • Support stability studies and evaluate product performance throughout development.

Process Development & Scale-Up

This is where the role goes beyond traditional bench R&D.

  • Help translate successful laboratory formulations into repeatable, scalable manufacturing processes.
  • Partner directly with Operations and Manufacturing to plan and execute pilot and production trials.
  • Evaluate how ingredients, equipment, processing parameters, and manufacturing conditions affect finished-product performance.
  • Identify potential scale-up challenges before products move into full commercial production.
  • Troubleshoot issues that arise during trials, scale-up, and manufacturing.
  • Recommend adjustments to formulations or processes based on production results.
  • Help establish appropriate process parameters and operating requirements for new products.

Commercialization & Production Support

  • Remain involved as products transition from R&D into commercial manufacturing.
  • Provide technical support during initial production runs and product launches.
  • Investigate formulation or process-related issues that affect quality, consistency, yield, efficiency, or manufacturability.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement opportunities for existing products and processes.
  • Help ensure knowledge gained during development is effectively transferred to the teams responsible for ongoing production.

Research & Scientific Innovation

  • Translate scientific research into practical product and process opportunities.
  • Evaluate new ingredients, technologies, processing approaches, and delivery formats.
  • Design experiments that answer meaningful product-development questions.
  • Analyze data and use results to guide formulation and process decisions.
  • Bring curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset to product and process challenges.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Product development at FoodScience is highly collaborative.

You'll work closely with:

  • R&D and Product Development
  • Manufacturing and Operations
  • Quality
  • Regulatory
  • Procurement and ingredient suppliers
  • Marketing and Commercial teams

You'll help connect the scientific intent of a product with the practical realities of producing it successfully.

Documentation & Quality Compliance

  • Maintain accurate and thorough laboratory and development documentation.
  • Support specifications, formulas, manufacturing instructions, protocols, reports, and technical documentation.
  • Work within applicable quality systems, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation accompanies products as they transition from development into production.
  • Contribute to investigations, root-cause analysis, validation activities, and corrective actions when appropriate.

What You Bring to the Table

We're open to different paths into this role.

You may come from R&D, product development, chemical engineering, process engineering, food or nutritional science, pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, or another technically rigorous manufacturing environment.

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

  • A bachelor's degree in Animal Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Hands-on laboratory, product-development, process-development, or manufacturing experience.
  • Strong scientific and technical problem-solving skills.
  • An understanding of how laboratory or technical work translates into manufacturing.
  • The ability to analyze data, troubleshoot problems, and make thoughtful recommendations.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with both scientific and operational teams.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

Experience with formulation, GMP-regulated manufacturing, process validation, scale-up, nutritional supplements, food, pharmaceuticals, consumer products, or pet products is highly valuable—but we are also interested in strong transferable experience.

What Success Looks Like

A successful R&D Associate doesn't simply develop a product that works in the lab.

Success means helping FoodScience develop products that work in the lab, perform as intended, can be manufactured successfully, and can be produced consistently at commercial scale.

You'll be successful when you:

  • Help move new products efficiently from concept through commercial production.
  • Develop a strong understanding of both formulation and manufacturing processes.
  • Identify potential problems early and help solve them practically.
  • Build strong partnerships with R&D, Quality, Operations, and Manufacturing.
  • Use data and scientific reasoning to make sound development decisions.
  • Help improve product quality, process capability, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Become someone the organization can rely on to help bridge the gap between what we want to create and how we successfully make it.

Why FoodScience?

At FoodScience, you'll have the opportunity to see the impact of your work beyond the laboratory.

You'll be part of a team where R&D works closely with the people actually making our products, giving you exposure to the full development lifecycle—from an idea on paper to a product running through production and ultimately reaching the pets and people we serve.

For someone who enjoys science but also wants to understand how products are made, how processes can be improved, and how ideas become commercially successful products, this role offers an opportunity to build a uniquely well-rounded R&D career.

A Little About FoodScience

FoodScience is a Vermont-based company dedicated to helping people and pets live healthier lives through high-quality nutritional products backed by science, innovation, and a commitment to quality.

For over 50 years, that has meant making the highest quality nutritional supplements and products, but it also extends to the care we provide our customers, the workplace culture we nurture, and the communities we serve.

Our R&D team plays an important role in turning scientific insight into products that can make a meaningful difference—and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that process from beginning to end.

FoodScience offers 9 paid holidays per year—including your birthday!—one paid week off during our annual plant shutdown, and a competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) program that begins accruing immediately. Our benefits package includes health insurance with HSA and FSA options, dental, vision, life insurance, and additional voluntary coverages to meet your needs. We also offer employee discounts, professional development opportunities, and the chance to work alongside a supportive, experienced team that is invested in your success.

Position Summary

The IT Infrastructure & Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, maintenance, and performance of the organization’s technology infrastructure across all properties and home office locations. This includes networks, servers, cloud platforms, identity and access management to core business systems that support both guest-facing and back-office operations.

This role ensures that IT services are secure, reliable, and scalable to meet the unique needs of πa hospitality environment—supporting continuous guest service, staff productivity, and regulatory compliance.

Operations & Service Delivery

title: Member of Technical Staff - Fullstack AI Engineer (Toronto)
description:
WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

At Solstice, we're building AI software that helps life sciences teams turn complex scientific and brand information into marketing content they can create, refine, and review with confidence. We've worked with leading life sciences manufacturers and more than 50 pharma brands. You'll build the systems and experiences that make this work faster and easier.

  • Build the foundation for how people work with AI. Your work will span the infrastructure that runs agents and the product experiences that help customers direct, inspect, and use their output.

  • Take on engineering problems with depth. Make long-running agents reliable, stream progress into responsive interfaces, deliver the right context securely, and understand what happens across every step of execution.

  • Have a direct hand in what we build. Join an early team where you'll shape architecture, make product tradeoffs, and work closely with our co-founders, Yiwen and Aris. You'll see your decisions reach customers and use their feedback to improve the product.

We're backed by Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue, and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm.

SOLSTICE IN TORONTO

We're opening our first engineering office outside New York, in Toronto, and you'll be one of its first engineers. The Toronto team will own a product area end to end, with its own roadmap and on-call. It won't be a queue for work handed over from New York.

  • Same time zone as New York, and one of our co-founders will be in Toronto with the team.

  • You'll spend your first month in New York working alongside the team in person. We cover travel and accommodation.

  • This role will be on-site in Toronto. We'll start remotely for the first few months, with a WeWork stipend for those who prefer it. As the team grows, we'll move into our own Toronto office by the end of the year and work from there five days a week.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer to build and maintain our agent platform and bring its capabilities into the product. You'll own work across backend services, APIs, agent orchestration, and customer-facing interfaces, with a strong focus on Python and platform engineering.

Python is our primary backend language, and FastAPI powers our APIs. You'll help decide how agents run, recover from failures, access tools and context, and communicate with the application. You'll also build the React and Next.js experiences that give users visibility and control over that work.

You'll partner with product, design, Applied AI, and the broader engineering team to take problems from an initial idea through architecture, implementation, and production. The scope includes both building new capabilities and making the systems behind them easier to operate and extend.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

  • Build and maintain the agent platform. Use Python, FastAPI, Restate, and Redis to build the shared systems that power our agents. Shape session management, orchestration, tool access, and context delivery so new AI capabilities can build on a dependable foundation.

  • Design APIs that power the product. Build Python and FastAPI services for content creation, document processing, collaboration, and enterprise integrations. Design clear API contracts and PostgreSQL data models that make complex workflows straightforward to build on.

  • Solve the hard parts of agent execution. Make long-running workflows recover from failures, handle cancellation and retries, and run in isolated environments. Give agents current documents, assets, and brand context while keeping customer data and permissions properly scoped.

  • Bring AI workflows to life in the product. Build with React, Next.js, and TypeScript to show streaming progress and tool activity, support reconnectable sessions, and give users intuitive ways to review, accept, or refine AI output.

  • Make the whole system observable. Connect APIs, orchestration, and agent execution through Datadog and OpenTelemetry tracing, structured logs, metrics, and alerts. Build the visibility to explain failures, find bottlenecks, and improve latency, reliability, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable. Partner with Applied AI engineers on evaluations and regression checks, using tools such as Braintrust alongside API and integration tests. Turn production traces and customer feedback into better agent behavior and more dependable releases.

  • Own the path from idea to production. Work with product and customer teams to choose the right problems, make practical tradeoffs, and ship complete features. Deploy, monitor, and improve what you build as customers use it.

SOME IDEAL TRAITS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience. You've built and shipped production software, with experience owning backend services or fullstack applications.

  • Depth in Python and FastAPI. You've shipped and operated production Python services. You can build well-designed FastAPI APIs and understand asynchronous programming, validation, authentication, and error handling.

  • Strong systems fundamentals. You design clear service contracts and data models, work comfortably with PostgreSQL and Redis, and think through concurrency, transactions, idempotency, and failure recovery.

  • Experience turning AI into useful software. You've built AI applications or the infrastructure behind them. You can reason about tool calling, context management, agent sessions, and the boundaries between model behavior and application logic.

  • The ability to deliver across the stack. You're comfortable working in React, Next.js, and TypeScript and connecting an interface to backend APIs. You care about how the product feels, including usability, accessibility, and performance.

  • A habit of making systems understandable. You use traces, logs, and metrics to investigate production issues and build instrumentation that helps the next engineer diagnose them. Testing, security, and maintainability are part of how you ship.

  • Ownership and good judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, explain the tradeoffs, and follow through. You work closely with others, seek feedback, and care about whether your work solves the customer's problem.

Experience with Restate or Temporal, sandboxed agent execution, streaming systems, or AI evaluation tools is a plus. You don't need experience with every tool in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. Healthcare or pharma experience is welcome but not required.

BENEFITS

  • Supplemental health, dental, and vision coverage on top of OHIP

  • Equity in an early-stage company, granted on the same schedule as our New York team

  • RRSP matching

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Your first month in New York, with travel and accommodation covered

  • A stipend for professional development

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is CAD $155,000 to $230,000, plus equity. Where you land depends on your experience, seniority, and the scope of responsibility you take on. We pay at the top of the Toronto market, and we grant equity on the same schedule in every office.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. You must be legally entitled to work in Canada. We can't sponsor work permits for this role at this time.

title: Commercial Analyst
description:
We are seeking a commercially curious and highly analytical Commercial Financial Analyst to join our JAS Finance Team.

Reporting to the Senior Commercial Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering commercial reporting, insights and analysis across the JAS business. You'll work closely with Sales & Operations, Product and Marketing teams to understand what is happening across sales, margins, products, brands, customers, inventory and individual branches.

A major focus of the role will be creating relevant and timely reporting that goes beyond simply presenting numbers. You'll identify trends as they emerge, investigate what is driving performance and provide insights that help the business respond quickly during the trading month.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is highly capable with data and reporting and wants to build their career in commercial finance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver daily, weekly and monthly sales and commercial reporting, identifying trends, risks, opportunities and key performance drivers.
  • Perform detailed analysis across sales, margins, products, brands, customers and branches to provide meaningful commercial insights to the business.
  • Partner with Sales & Operations, Product and Marketing teams to understand performance and translate business requirements into relevant reporting and analysis.
  • Analyse inventory and product performance to identify duplication, excess and obsolete stock and opportunities to improve inventory outcomes.
  • Support and enhance branch-level P&L reporting across JAS, helping provide greater visibility of individual branch performance.
  • Manage the financial reporting and reconciliation requirements for key accounts, including customer rebates and loyalty programs.
  • Create and continually improve reports using Excel, VBA and Power BI, enabling stakeholders to quickly identify trends and make informed decisions.
  • Support month-end, budgeting, forecasting and continuous improvement activities while maintaining strong attention to detail, accuracy and financial controls.

You are someone who enjoys getting behind the numbers and understanding why performance is changing, rather than simply producing a report.

You are agile, tactical and comfortable responding quickly when emerging sales or margin trends require further investigation. You are also a self-starter with strong attention to detail and the discipline to thoroughly review and validate your own work before sharing it with stakeholders.

You will bring:

  • Approximately 2–3 years' experience in commercial finance, financial analysis, management accounting or a similar analytical finance role.
  • Demonstrated experience analysing top-line commercial performance, ideally across sales, margins, products, brands, customers or locations.
  • Strong reporting capability with the ability to turn complex data into practical and commercially relevant insights.
  • Advanced Excel skills, with VBA experience highly regarded.
  • Experience creating or enhancing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with excellent attention to detail.
  • Confidence partnering with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Product, Marketing and Finance.
  • A self-starting, agile and commercially curious mindset with the ability to manage changing priorities.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience working with Pronto, Cognos or Phocas.
  • Experience analysing inventory, product performance, pricing or margin.
  • Exposure to customer rebates or loyalty programs.
  • Experience within a product-based organisation, particularly automotive, FMCG, heavy vehicles, mining, wholesale or distribution.

a. Any deviations to Special Orders

KNOWLEDGE

· Production and Processing: Knowledge of chemical processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing production.

· Mechanical: Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.

· Administration and Management: Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership techniques, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

· Personnel and Human Resources: Knowledge of principles and procedures for personnel management, training, and time keeping.

· Computers and Electronics: Working knowledge of computer systems and business administration software applications. Understanding of interaction and application of electronic instrumentation and Distributive Control Systems (DCS).

· Education and Training: Knowledge of principles and methods for curriculum and training design, teaching and instruction for individuals and groups, and the measurement of training effects.

SKILLS/ABILITIES

· Active Listening: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

· Speaking: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

· Coordination: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

· Critical Thinking: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.

· Management of Personnel Resources: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

· Reading Comprehension: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents.

· Time Management: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

· Judgment and Decision Making: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

· Monitoring: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

· Social Perceptiveness: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

· Deductive Reasoning: The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.

· Oral Comprehension: The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

· Oral Expression: The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.

· Problem Sensitivity: The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing there is a problem.

· Written Comprehension: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

· Speech Clarity: The ability to speak clearly so others can understand you.

· Speech Recognition: The ability to identify and understand the speech of another person.

· Inductive Reasoning: The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events).

· Written Expression: The ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand.

· Category Flexibility: The ability to generate or use different sets of rules for combining or grouping things in different ways.

· The ability to work at heights, navigate ladders and stairs, lift 50 pounds without assistance and operate valves and other controls in the field.

· The ability to participate/lead emergency response teams

· Meet physical requirements to wear personal protective equipment mandated by OSHA or USN policy.

WORK ACTIVITIES

· Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates: Providing information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

· Monitor Processes, Materials, or Surroundings: Monitoring and reviewing information from materials, events, or the environment, to detect or assess problems.

· Organizing, Planning, and Prioritizing Work: Developing specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

· Getting Information: Observing, receiving, and otherwise obtaining information from all relevant sources.

· Scheduling Work and Activities: Scheduling events, programs, and activities, as well as the work of others.

· Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others: Getting members of a group to work together to accomplish tasks.

· Identifying Objects, Actions, and Events: Identifying information by categorizing, estimating, recognizing differences or similarities, and detecting changes in circumstances or events.

· Coaching and Developing Others: Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

· Making Decisions and Solving Problems: Analyzing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

· Controlling Machines and Processes: Using either control mechanisms or direct physical activity to operate machines or processes (not including computers or vehicles).

PREREQUISITES

· High School Diploma or G.E.D.

· 21 years of age with one of the following: Associate degree, military service or two years manufacturing experience.

  • Prefer 5+ Years of supervisor or leadership experience. Preferably in a chemical manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of Process Safety Management and a good understanding of general process control preferred.

· Project management and budget management experience preferred.

title: Nonfoodchef - København V
description:
Nonfoodchef

Nonfoodchefen i føtex har det samlede ansvar for en veldrevet nonfood‑afdeling, hvor daglig drift, højt niveau af varepræsentation, høj kvalitet og god kundeoplevelse går hånd i hånd. Du sætter retningen for, hvordan afdelingen bidrager til varehusets resultater, og omsætter mål, kampagner og koncepter til konkret adfærd i hverdagen – med fokus på fødevaresikkerhed, effektiv lagerdrift og salgsklar afdeling. Som synlig og nærværende leder rekrutterer, motiverer og udvikler du ledere og medarbejdere, følger tæt op på trivsel og arbejdsmiljø og bygger en kultur baseret på Salling Groups værdier. Du planlægger bemanding, sikrer effektiv drift og arbejder aktivt med kundefeedback og nøgletal som omsætning, svind og lønprocent. Nonfoodchefen refererer til varehuschefen, indgår i varehusets ledergruppe og samarbejder tæt på tværs for at skabe en sammenhængende kundeoplevelse i hele varehuset.

føtex er en af Danmarks største detailkæder og hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform. Som medarbejder hos føtex bliver din rygsæk fyldt med erfaringer – dem kan du bruge nu, sammen med os, men også senere hen i din karriere. Det er alene dig som sætter begrænsningen for din udvikling – her er der højt til loftet og mange muligheder. Stillingen som Nonfoodchef inviterer til målrettet arbejde med din personlige- og faglige udvikling.

Med et spændende job som Nonfoodchef indgår bl.a. følgende fordele:

  • en arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab hvor der er plads til alle og til at være præcis den du er. Du vil med andre ord også kunne skabe dig et godt socialt netværk og møde nye venner.
  • gode løn- og arbejdsvilkår
  • en lang række uddannelses- og kursusmuligheder som vil styrke din personlige såvel som faglige udvikling
  • et hav af medarbejdergoder, bl.a.: personalerabatter (føtex, Bilka, Salling, Starbucks m.fl.) og interne og eksterne rabatordninger
  • God, sund og professionel virksomhedskultur
  • Fremragende muligheder for at gøre karriere i Salling Group

Vi mangler en ny Nonfoodchef og hvis du er nysgerrig, så skal det nu handle om dig!

For at komme i spil til vores spændende stilling kan du levere:

  • Du er tillidsfuld, ærlig og respektfuld. Du har en forbilledlig adfærd, går forrest og viser medarbejderne vejen.
  • Du udviser stort engagement og vægter kundeservice og medarbejder trivsel- og udvikling højt. Du bidrager med god energi og sætter et positivt præg på dit arbejde og dine kollegaer.
  • Du er tilpasningsdygtig og bevidst om, at vi aldrig stopper med at lære
  • Du har viljen og arbejder benhårdt for, at du og dit hold lykkes og skaber de bedst mulige resultater.
  • Du arbejder effektivt og søger gerne løsninger for at optimere effektiviteten

Du er en dygtig leder som er empatisk, inkluderende og har høj integritet. Du forstår vigtigheden i af godt samarbejde og god kommunikation. Du er ansvarsfuld og tillidsskabende.

**Er du klar til at sende din ansøgning afsted?**Hvis du stadig er nysgerrig på de mange muligheder føtex kan tilbyde, og er klar til at give den fuld gas i føtex’ blå skjorte, så klik på linket nedenfor og lad os høre mere om, hvem du er. Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig.

Kandidater som søger job hos Salling Group oprettes i en database, som organisationens ledere har adgang til. Ønsker du at din jobansøgning behandles fortroligt og alene må ses af People and Culture og den rekrutterende leder til en konkret stilling du søger er det vigtigt, at du gør os opmærksom på det. Når du opretter din ansøgerprofil på vores hjemmeside skal du tage stilling til fortrolighed under sektionen ”Jeg tillader at min profil er synlig for:”.

Salling Group er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads med 70.000 medarbejdere i Danmark, Tyskland, Estland, Letland, Litauen og Polen.

Vi driver butikker, varehuse, cafeer, spisesteder og webshops med vægt på kvalitet, service og omtanke for de samfund og den klode, vi er en del af.

Vi brænder for at gøre hverdagen bedre for vores kunder

  • Help build and maintain containerized applications and contribute to CI/CD pipelines under guidance.
  • Participate in adding security controls throughout the development lifecycle (DevSecOps).
  • Support development of event‑driven or messaging‑based components (e.g., basic Kafka/RabbitMQ usage).
  • Follow compliance procedures for classified environments, including air‑gapped deployments and controlled updates.
  • Identify and solve issue, monitor, and improve system performance and observability in test and staging environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, learn from architecture discussions, and receive mentorship on standard methodologies.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you…

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience (internships, open‑source contributions, capstone projects).
  • Have 2+ years of full software engineering experience, including software design methodology, requirements development, configuration management, trade studies, and product defect tracking
  • Basic proficiency in at least one modern language/stack (C++, Java, or Python). Academic projects, internships, or personal code are acceptable.
  • Foundational Docker knowledge (building and running containers) and exposure to Kubernetes concepts (pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Helm charts).
  • Experience (or coursework) creating simple CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) that run builds, tests, and basic security scans.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation basics, and JSON data exchange (Protobuf a plus).
  • Familiarity with testing practices – writing unit tests and basic integration tests.
  • Comfortable using Git (feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews).
  • Possess interpersonal skills and are an effective communicator.
  • Have the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
  • Are able to obtain a Top-Secret level security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You’ll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you:

  • Possess a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Have experience with DevOps Engineering or Process Automation
  • Have experience with cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services, Azure, Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of logging frameworks (Log4j/SLF4J), ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana.
  • Introductory experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other async patterns.
  • Have experience with Unix, Linux, and network computing.
  • Are well‑versed in using professional software development tools such as integrated development environments (IDE), version control, issue trackers, debuggers and continuous integration tools and willing to lead teams through integration processes
  • Interest or experience with space‑related software, real‑time systems, or large‑scale data processing.
  • Knowledge of cross‑domain solutions or high‑assurance system integration is a plus.

This is a high‑impact role that offers hands‑on experience building resilient software directly supporting space‑superiority missions in a secure, forward‑leaning development environment. You will grow your technical expertise while working alongside seasoned engineers dedicated to national security.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician, AWS Data Center EngineeringOperations
description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for Data Center Engineering Operations Technicians to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak performance.

Roles available across locations in Sydney, NSW.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Undertake and support management of both routine maintenance and emergency service of critical systems such as switch-gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, and fire systems
  • Installation of new rack capacity and provisioning of power/cooling
  • On-site management of contractors and vendors, ensuring all work is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
  • Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log-taking
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for all facility-related events
  • Assist in the resolution of infrastructure engineering and services issues
  • Troubleshoot events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and encourage a world-class safety culture

Additional Requirements

  • This role involves bending, lifting 20Kgs stretching, reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely
  • Must be able to work in cramped or elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
  • 24/7 shift coverage is required and includes 12-hour rotating shifts
  • Due to the location of our sites, candidates should ideally possess a valid driver’s license and their own vehicle

A day in the life

At today's large-scale data centers, you will be involved in:

  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs.
  • Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA)
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Technical Project Manager - AI Data Processing
description:
Technical Project Manager-AI DataProcessing

Work model: Remote (covering PST hours) - Based in PST timezone
Employment type: Full-time (Contract or Employment)

About DATAmundi

DATAmundi builds advanced software solutions that power our localization and data services. We support AI companies and research teams by delivering high-quality datasets, validation workflows, and scalable data processing. Our R&D initiatives explore how modern AI systems — including LLMs, speech models, and multimodal systems — can be evaluated, improved, and safely deployed through structured data and validation methodologies.

We are expanding our R&D activities and seeking researchers to collaborate on applied research and technical outreach within the AI ecosystem.

About the role

We’re hiring a Technical Project Manager with a hands-on, data engineering skillset to support Data Processing for AI.You’ll translate client requirements into executable validation logic for data processing workflows, support data post processing, and help ensure delivery data is consistent, measurable, and within client metrics and guidelines.

This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, data QA, and automation. You’ll work closely with development teams and support the Operations Team while also writing/maintaining lightweight scripts and queries that turn requirements into quality assurance checks.

Whatyou’lldo

  • Own the end-to-end coordination ofdata deliveries, from intake to validation and handoff.
  • Work with clientdata delivered via S3 buckets or direct uploads; ensure correct structure, completeness, and readiness for downstream use.
  • Translate client guidelines into automated validation using SQL, regex, and supporting scripts.
  • Create and to compute quality and consistency metrics such as:
  • WER (Word Error Rate)maintain Python utilities
  • IAA (Inter-Annotator Agreement)
  • Additional dataset-level metrics as required
  • Use Windows Command Prompt for bulk file operations (creating/moving/downloading folders and files) to support processing and delivery workflows.
  • Partner with internal development teams by writing Jira tickets for platform improvements and bug fixes (requirements, steps to reproduce, acceptance criteria).
  • Quickly ramp on internal platforms and configuration logic (e.g., worktypes / templates), advising on setup patterns and tradeoffs.
  • Investigate issues by querying datasets through database tools and producing clear summaries of findings and next steps.

Whatwe’relooking for

  • 3 years experience in technical delivery / project coordination in a data environment (data, analytics, ML, QA automation, or platform operations.
  • Practical comfort with:
  • Python(scripting for metrics and data validation workflows)
  • SQL (queries used in automated checks)
  • Regex (pattern-based validation)
  • Command line / Windows CMD (bulk file operations)
  • Strong written communication and the ability to convert fuzzy requirements into precise, testable checks.
  • Experience working with engineering teams and using tools like Jira to drive execution.
  • Ability to evaluate options and recommend an approach based on pros/cons, timelines, and maintainability.

Nice to have

  • Experience with speech/audio or text datasets (given WER and annotation agreement use cases).
  • Familiarity with cloud data workflows (especially AWS S3 concepts like buckets, prefixes, access patterns).
  • Experience with data labeling/annotation workflows and quality frameworks.
Salary: $60k-$85k

title: Supervisor - Nibe
description:
Supervisor i Netto – Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for kollegaer og kunder?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i et stærkt fællesskab? Som supervisor i Netto får du muligheden for at prøve kræfter med at have ansvar og du er både rollemodel og sparringspartner for dine kollegaer. Du bliver en central del af teamet og er med til at sikre, at butikken altid leverer gode oplevelser for vores kunder – hver dag.

Hvad indebærer jobbet?
Som supervisor har du ansvaret for at butikken er salgsklar og indbydende. Du bidrager til at motivere og støtte dine kollegaer. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Koordinering af vareopfyldning og trimning
  • Sikre korrekt skiltning
  • Kundeservice og betjening ved kassen
  • Bidrage til rengøring, orden i butik og baglokale
  • Områdeansvarlig for et eller flere udvalgte områder
  • Deltage i oplæring af nye kollegaer

Du får en grundig oplæring i Nettos koncepter, så du er godt klædt på til at tage ansvar for kollegaer og opgaver. Du vil på udvalgte vagter skulle være alene om ansvaret åbne eller lukke butikken – og synes at det er en spændende udfordring.

Hvorfor vælge Netto?
Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar, feedback og fleksibilitet. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen, lære om detailhandel og tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er serviceminded og trives med kundekontakt
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar
  • Kan motivere og støtte et team, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider (dag, aften og weekend)
  • Har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære nyt

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et job med ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • At du kan blive en del af et stærkt team – hvor vi samarbejder og hjælper hinanden
  • Et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Feedback fra chefer og kollegaer
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og en stærk teamkultur

Alle de gode grunde til at blive supervisor i Netto
Du får typisk mellem 20 – 40 kollegaer i butikken, og vi oplever ofte, at kollegaskabet udvikler sig til venskaber.

Du kan også glæde dig til:

  • Løn og arbejdsvilkår der følger HK overenskomst
  • Pensionsordning
  • Sundhedsforsikring
  • Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks
  • Mulighed for leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland
  • Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat
  • Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat

Bliv en del af Netto-ånden: Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab
I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok.

Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig – både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af.

Er du vores nye kollega?
Send din ansøgning online til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

About the project

As an IAM Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust security solutions to protect our organization's digital identities and manage access to critical systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate IAM platforms, automate access workflows, and ensure compliance with security policies, playing a pivotal role in strengthening our overall cybersecurity posture.

  • Automate user lifecycle processes (onboarding, transfers, and offboarding) using low-code tools, scripting, or APIs to eliminate manual tasks.
  • Implement Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) architectures and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across the enterprise.
  • Collaborate with security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with data privacy regulations and internal audits.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity access management incidents, system bugs, and integration issues.
  • Develop custom connectors, scripts, and API integrations to extend the IAM platform’s functionality.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation regarding IAM architectures, deployment procedures, and operational guidelines.

What makes you a great fit 🎯

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Hands-on IAM experience (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, Cognito, Entra ID — FusionAuth is a plus).
  • Strong understanding of OAuth2 / OIDC / SSO.
  • Solid backend/full-stack experience (Java, .NET, or Node).
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Global Impact, Local Culture 🌍

For over 25 years, we’ve been shaping digital transformation, delivering complex solutions for global enterprises and public sector organizations. Today, we are at the forefront of an AI-driven transformation era, helping organizations turn data into real business value. By combining deep domain expertise with data and AI, we design solutions that create immediate impact while scaling for the future.

We believe complexity doesn’t have to mean complicated, and that the best solutions are those that work in the real world, not just on paper. That’s why our clients trust us with their most ambitious, business-critical initiatives.

Apply now and let’s shape the future of technology together! 🧑‍💻

title: Director, Supply Chain Strategy & Excellence (USA - Remote, US)
description:
Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

The Director, Supply Chain Strategy and Excellence is a critical leadership role responsible for driving transformational improvement across Bausch + Lomb's global supply chain network, with an initial focus on Logistics Excellence. Reporting directly to the Vice President, Supply Chain, this role serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor in defining and executing the roadmap that delivers breakthrough improvements in service, cost, quality, and operational performance.

Bausch + Lomb relies on highly effective warehousing and logistics operations to ensure product availability and customer satisfaction across all product categories. This role will lead the identification, prioritization, and execution of enterprise-wide improvement opportunities that create a step change in supply chain performance. Through rigorous analytics, structured problem solving, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined project execution, the Director will build and maintain a robust opportunity pipeline while ensuring sustainable realization of business benefits.

Success in this role will be measured through tangible improvements in customer service levels, On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance, logistics and distribution costs, warehouse productivity, inventory efficiency, quality performance, network reliability, and working capital optimization. The Director will be expected to identify and deliver value creation opportunities, establish a robust transformation pipeline, and accelerate execution of strategic initiatives that improve end-to-end supply chain performance.

This leader will play a pivotal role in shaping the future-state logistics organization, building continuous improvement capabilities, and creating sustainable competitive advantage through measurable improvements in service, cost, and quality across Bausch + Lomb's global supply chain network.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the Supply Chain Excellence agenda across the Logistics organization to deliver measurable improvements in customer service, cost efficiency, operational quality, and network performance.
  • Serve as the strategic partner to the Vice President, Supply Chain in developing and executing the multi-year logistics transformation roadmap.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops, value stream analyses, and opportunity assessments to identify, quantify, and prioritize transformation opportunities.
  • Establish and manage a robust opportunity funnel, including benefit quantification, resource prioritization, and initiative governance.
  • Analyze large and complex data sets across transportation, warehousing, inventory, customer service, and distribution operations to generate actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Lead strategic improvement initiatives from ideation through implementation and benefit realization, ensuring projects deliver targeted business outcomes.
  • Drive adoption of Lean Six Sigma methodologies, operational excellence principles, and continuous improvement capabilities throughout the supply chain organization.
  • Develop performance management frameworks, governance routines, KPI dashboards, and executive reporting mechanisms to track transformation progress.
  • Influence senior leaders and stakeholders across functions, regions, and business units to drive alignment and execution without direct authority.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, quality standards, and operational controls while implementing process improvements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Manufacturing, Consulting, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale supply chain transformation, operational excellence, or continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven ability to facilitate executive and operational workshops that identify opportunities and build actionable improvement roadmaps.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from large, complex data sets and convert findings into measurable actions.
  • Strong project and program management capabilities with a track record of successfully delivering complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Outstanding leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across highly matrixed and global organizations.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution and results delivery.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%.

Specialized Training & Skills:

  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Master Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification strongly preferred or Experience with a leading consulting firm or internal strategy, transformation, supply chain excellence, or operational excellence organization.
  • Expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, Change Management, and Structured Problem-Solving methodologies.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes including transportation, warehousing, inventory management, planning, customer fulfillment, and network optimization.
  • Advanced analytical skills utilizing tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL, Alteryx, or similar analytics and visualization platforms.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI frameworks, transformation scorecards, and performance management systems.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience building business cases, quantifying savings opportunities, measuring ROI, and tracking benefit realization.
  • Proven ability to identify patterns and opportunities from large data sets and convert insights into executable business actions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience leading logistics network transformation, distribution center optimization, transportation improvement, inventory optimization, or warehousing excellence initiatives.
  • Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, consumer health, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • APICS CPIM, CSCP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt, or equivalent professional certification.
  • Demonstrated success driving enterprise transformation programs with measurable service, cost, quality, and productivity improvements.
  • Experience working in global organizations with complex stakeholder environments and diverse operational footprints.

This position may be available in the following location(s): U.S. - Remote

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst is responsible for ensuring software applications, system enhancements, and technology solutions meet business requirements and quality standards before deployment. This role serves as a key partner throughout the solution delivery lifecycle, collaborating with business stakeholders, business analysts, project managers, developers, and support teams to identify risks, validate requirements, execute testing activities, and support successful implementations.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Test Planning and Execution

  • Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are complete, clear, and testable prior to development.
  • Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and supporting testing documentation.
  • Execute functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing on system enhancements, bug fixes, and new releases.
  • Conduct post-deployment validation and smoke testing to confirm successful releases.
  • Experience with automated testing.

Requirements and Quality Review

  • Identify gaps, ambiguities, inconsistencies, and quality risks within requirements and proposed solutions.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and project stakeholders to ensure acceptance criteria are measurable and testable.

Business Systems Testing

  • Validate changes and enhancements to enterprise business applications, including CRM, ERP, and related systems, verifying workflows, business rules, security permissions, integrations, and reporting functionality, and assessing impacts to upstream and downstream systems to ensure changes support business processes and operational needs.

Defect Management

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution, working closely with developers and stakeholders to investigate root causes and verify corrective actions.
  • Retest resolved issues to confirm successful remediation prior to release, and clearly communicate testing results, risks, and recommendations.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support

  • Partner with business stakeholders to develop practical and realistic test scenarios, and coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing activities.
  • Assist users with test preparation, execution, issue reporting, and validation of solutions, while tracking testing progress and supporting business sign-off activities.

Data Validation and Reporting

  • Validate data accuracy across interfaces, integrations, reports, and business applications, and verify calculations, data transformations, and reporting outputs against business requirements.
  • Investigate and document discrepancies between expected and actual results.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, documentation standards, and quality practices, and contribute to the development and maintenance of testing procedures, templates, and best practices.
  • Assist in evaluating opportunities to leverage automation, where appropriate, to improve testing efficiency.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Performance metrics

  • The following metrics apply to this position.
  • People, Franchise Satisfaction, Revenue Growth, and EBITDA (see scorecard)
  • Test Execution Coverage: Complete planned test case execution against the approved test plan for each release cycle. [Target % to be confirmed with IT Project Manager]
  • Defect Escape Rate: Limit post-release (escaped) defects as a share of total defects identified per release. [Target % to be confirmed with IT Project Manager]
  • UAT Sign-Off Timeliness: Obtain business sign-off within an agreed number of business days of test readiness. [Target days/% to be confirmed with IT Project Manager]

Requirements

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or business systems testing.
  • A QA-related certification (e.g., ISTQB Foundation Level) is a plus.
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and QA best practices; ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into test scenarios and test cases.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills; excellent written and verbal communication; strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams; adaptable and detail-oriented.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. Experience testing web-based and enterprise business applications, documenting defects, and writing test plans, cases, and scripts.
  • Experience with CRM, ERP, or other enterprise platforms, SQL for data validation, and API testing tools (e.g., Postman) preferred.

Working Conditions

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • The work is generally sedentary with extended periods of sitting; frequent standing, walking, typing, and use of hand and finger dexterity for keyboard and office equipment operation (e.g., computers, phones, mobile devices).
  • Hearing and vision within normal ranges are essential for effective communication, receiving information, and preparing documents.
  • Occasional lifting or carrying items weighing up to 10 pounds may be required.

Work Environment:

  • This position operates in a standard office setting with moderate noise levels and controlled climate.
  • The office is equipped with typical lighting and equipment conducive to prolonged computer use.
  • The role involves sitting for extended periods with intermittent walking or standing.
  • Interaction with colleagues and clients occurs regularly through meetings, phone calls, and in-person communication.

Salary Structure: Base + 10% Bonus Payout Range

Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. title: Salgsassistent - Thorvaldsensgade
description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Salgsassistent, der kan hjælpe os med at gøre de små øjeblikke i butikken til gode oplevelser hver dag. Her bruger du din erfaring med service, nærvær og overblik, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Det fortæller en kollega om rollen
”Hverdagen er travl på den gode måde, og ingen dage er helt ens. Jeg elsker energien i butikken og følelsen af, at vi løfter i flok."

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…
Kort sagt handler rollen som Salgsassistent om at skabe gode oplevelser for vores gæster og være med til at gøre butikken til et rart sted at være.

Den lidt længere version er, at du møder gæsterne med nærvær, venlighed og et godt overblik, så de føler sig velkomne og har lyst til at komme igen. Du hjælper med god service, deler din viden om produkterne og bidrager til, at hverdagen i butikken fungerer godt, både for gæster og kollegaer, også når der er travlt.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • møder både gæster og kollegaer med venlighed, nærvær og hjælpsomhed
  • har lyst til at lære nyt og holde dig opdateret på vores produkter, nyheder og sortiment
  • trives i en hverdag med tempo og mange forskellige opgaver
  • tager ansvar for, at butikken altid er ren, indbydende og klar til gæsterne
  • bidrager til et positivt fællesskab og hjælper til, hvor der er brug for det

Hvad vi tilbyder dig
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos os
Din arbejdsuge er på 25 timer, og vagterne kan ligge på alle ugens dage med morgen, dag og lukkevagter, primært i tidsrummet kl. 06.00 til 16.00. Du skal være parat til at arbejde hver anden weekend og på helligdage.

Det er et krav til denne stilling, at du er over 18 år.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

description:
Medarbejder til delikatessen - Vejle

Medarbejder til delikatessen

Bilka ønsker at skabe tilfredse kunder og en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse for alle. Vi stræber efter at gøre hver dag speciel for vores kunder med formålet: Vi inspirerer til flere værdifulde øjeblikke. Gennem vores udvalg, konkurrencedygtige priser og engagerede medarbejdere skaber vi en indkøbsoplevelse, der både opfylder behov og bringer glæde. Vil du være med til at skabe inspirerende oplevelser for Bilkas kunder? Så er du måske Bilkas næste delikatessemedarbejder.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Som medarbejder i Bilka – uanset niveau – bliver du en del af et solidt fællesskab med gode kolleger. Du indgår i et team, hvor holdånden er høj, og du er en del af fællesskabet i hele butikken og virksomheden.

Du får værdifuld erfaring, som du kan tilføje dit CV. Du lærer at navigere i dagligdagen i en detailbutik, arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig også samarbejde med dine kolleger, om de bedste løsninger.

Med vores digitale medarbejderapp har du altid din vagtplan ved hånden, samt adgang til informationer og personalegoder. Vi bestræber os på, at din vagtplan passer med eventuel studie og fritidsaktiviteter.

Delikatessen er en del af Bilkas slagterafdeling, og du har derfor Danmarks største sortiment af kød, fisk, køle- og mejerivarer til rådighed. Derudover får vi friskbagt brød fra bageriet, du befinder dig altså i et paradis af kvalitetsprodukter. Mange varer tilbydes direkte fra disken eller fra vores store convenience-udbud. Derudover leverer vi store anretninger ud af huset, hvor vi tilbyder buffeter, brunch, festmiddage, tapas, smørrebrød og meget andet til enhver anledning.

Hvad bringer du med dig?

Vi leder efter dig der har en venlig og imødekommende personlighed. Og så er vi på udkig efter dig, som gerne giver dine kolleger en ekstra hånd, når I sammen leverer den fælles indsats, der skal til, for at I med stolthed kan tage godt imod kunderne i afdelingen. Med dit gode overblik tager du gerne ejerskab – og også lederskab, hvis der er behov for det.

Der kan være mange veje ind i jobbet, og vi er åbne overfor forskellighed. Derfor opfordrer vi kandidater med forskellige baggrunde til at søge.

Griber du chancen?

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden. Vi screener og kalder til samtaler løbende.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 9.500 motiverede kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Design Manager
description:
Job Title: Design Manager (Project Harker)

Reporting to: Design Management Regional Lead

Role purpose

The Design Manager is a key member of the Design Management team and will be fully dedicated to Project Harker (Carlisle, UK). They are responsible for the end‑to‑end management, coordination and assurance of design activities across the project, ensuring that all design outputs are delivered on time, to the required quality, and in line with client specifications and Omexom governance.

This role requires regular on‑site presence at Harker, with a minimum of three days per week spent on site to support coordination, stakeholder engagement, design reviews and construction interface activities.

Working closely with the Design Management Regional Lead for England, the Design Manager will oversee the design programme, design deliverables, technical assurance processes and design‑related coordination, collaborating with PMs, Designers, Planning, Commercial and Business Unit leadership. They will promote effective communication, proactive issue resolution and value‑driven design approaches throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities & Duties

Including but not limited to the following:

1. Design Programme Ownership

  • Develop, maintain and issue the design programme for all schemes.

  • Proactively monitor progress, highlight deviations, and implement recovery strategies.

  • Coordinate programme interfaces with planning, procurement and construction.

2. Design Quality & Technical Assurance

  • Ensure design outputs meet NG, SSE and Omexom specifications in line with the LCDAE.

  • Manage the assurance submission process, hold-point reviews and gateway approvals.

  • Provide oversight for compliance with internal procedures, standards and CDM.

3. Commercial & Change Control (NEC Focus)

  • Act as the custodian of design change, maintaining registers and logs.

  • Manage EWNs, CEs, PMIs and ensure contractual obligations are followed.

  • Identify design impacts on cost, programme and risk, and support forecasting.

  • Supporting cost forecasting by linking design activity to commercial impacts.

4. Design Coordination & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead design review meetings and coordinate multidisciplinary design teams.

  • Interface with clients, OEMs, subcontractors, internal, and external, Design teams and delivery teams.

  • Manage RFIs, TQs and design communications flow.

5. Risk, Safety & CDM

  • Identify and manage design risk, including temporary and permanent works considerations.

  • Ensure Principal Designer communications are flowing and documented.

  • Promote the principles of prevention and safety-by-design.

6. Tender & Pre-Construction Input

  • Supporting the BUGM and Bid Manager with technical input, design methodology, design assumptions and risk assessment during tender development.

  • Ensuring that tender designs and proposals are robust, compliant and commercially defensible.

7. Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Promote collaboration, innovation and smart Design delivery.

  • Drive lessons learned and standardisation across multiple projects.

  • Support the development and mentoring of assistant design managers.

Key interfaces

Relationships with key stakeholders:

  • BUGM / Head of Design

  • Project Managers

  • Internal & External Design teams

  • Planning Engineers

  • Commercial & QS Teams

  • Principal Designer

  • Site Delivery Teams

  • Client Representatives (NG / SSE)

Person Specification

Qualifications and experience

The jobholder shall possess:

Essential:

  • 8+ years of experience in a related role and possess relevant qualifications

  • Experience working on HV substation projects, ideally within the UK transmission sector.

  • Proven ability to deliver Design related projects, with a high level of attention to detail.

  • A strong belief in developing people and building a team, to deliver programs safely, on time, on budget and to a high quality.

  • Internal and external stakeholder management experience

  • Project leadership at a management level, delivering a range of projects that vary in complexity, are multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural teams

  • Familiarity with National Grid processes, standards, assurance pathways or project delivery expectations.

Desired:

  • Degree qualified in a relevant Engineering discipline or Project Management / Construction management or similar.

  • National Grid persons (substations)

  • Experience working to energy transmission and distribution specifications, processes and procedures.

  • Experience of working in the UK Energy sector or within highly regulated industries

  • Membership of a relevant professional institution

Values

In line with Omexom’s values, the jobholder must have the following qualities:

Team Spirit & Generosity – able to work effectively within and contribute to the Omexom team to deliver results, provide support and drive performance.

Trust and Empowerment – enjoy managing their responsibilities and time to ensure work is completed efficiently and professionally.

Integrity and Responsibility – enjoy taking responsibility for their duties and managing these effectively to ensure efficient high quality results.

Innovation & Entrepreneurship – continually strive to improve processes and introduce new initiatives to improve efficiency.

ADDICTION COUNSELOR

The Addiction Counselor is responsible for providing direct therapeutic services, group, and individual, to adults with substance use disorders. It is essential to have a thorough knowledge of substance use disorders, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, related evidenced based assessments, and treatment practices.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    • Conducts initial clinical assessments using a multitude of standardized assessment tools, including the ASAM Assessment. (Mental health, Substance Use Disorder, Trauma, Daily Living Skills, etc.)
    • Administers follow-up assessments.
    • Conducts group and individual therapeutic interventions.
    • Works collaboratively with the client to develop a comprehensive treatment plan that addresses priority needs of the client, an agreed upon plan of action, and desired treatment outcomes.
    • Utilizes approved curriculum to facilitate weekly groups and/or provides individual treatment to members.
    • Evaluates and reports progress and outcome of treatment services.
    • Completes accurate and timely clinical assessments, intakes, treatment plans/reviews, monthly reports, assessments, progress notes, and discharge summaries.
    • Participates in mental health on call.
    • Provides crisis intervention and de-escalation skills.
    • Promotes and demonstrates the Mission, Vision, and Core Values of Embrave.
    • Develops and maintains good working relationships with all departments, the management team, regulatory agencies, and community partners.
    • Embraces cultural diversity amongst ourselves and our community.
    • Responsible for the human, financial, and material resources as well as data and information entrusted to us.
    • Performs other job-related duties as required.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: None

EDUCATION/ WORK EXPERIENCE:

Requires a licensure with the Colorado Department of Regulatory Agencies (DORA) in good standing as a Licensed Addiction Counselor.

OR

Current certification as a Certified Addiction Specialist (previous Certified Addictions Counselor II (CAC II) or higher (CAC III) with Colorado's Department of Regulatory Agencies (DORA) in good standing, along with a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Professional Counselor Candidate (LPCC), Licensed Social Worker Candidate (SWC), or Addictions Counselor Candidate (ADDC) in good standing with Colorado's Department of Regulatory Agencies (DORA).

title: Teamkoordinator til Frugt og Grønt - Ballerup
description:
Teamkoordinator til frugt og grønt

Teamkoordinatoren i føtex er et meget vigtigt led i den daglige koordinering af opgaver, ressourcer og projekter og så indgår de i varehusets samlede ledergruppe. føtex er en af Danmarks største detailkæder og hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform. Som medarbejder hos føtex bliver din rygsæk fyldt med erfaringer – dem kan du bruge nu, sammen med os, men også senere hen i din karriere. Det er alene dig som sætter begrænsningen for din udvikling – her er der højt til loftet og mange muligheder. Stillingen som teamkoordinator inviterer til målrettet arbejde med din personlige- og faglige udvikling.

Vi har et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor vi bakker hinanden op og løfter i flok.

Med et spændende job som teamkoordinator indgår bl.a. følgende fordele:

  • en arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab hvor der er plads til alle og til at være præcis den du er. Du vil med andre ord også kunne skabe dig et godt socialt netværk og møde nye venner.
  • gode løn- og arbejdsvilkår, herunder frivalgskonto
  • en lang række uddannelses- og kursusmuligheder som vil styrke din personlige såvel som faglige udvikling
  • et hav af medarbejdergoder, bl.a.: personalerabatter (føtex, Bilka, Salling, Starbucks m.fl.) og interne og eksterne rabatordninger
  • Koncerter og festlige events både lokalt og på tværs af koncernens mange forretningskæder
  • God, sund og professionel virksomhedskultur
  • Fremragende muligheder for at gøre karriere

**
Om Frugt og Grønt afdelingen
**
I Frugt og Grønt har man ansvaret for et føtex profilområde. Man håndterer højkvalitetsvarer i stort sortiment. Opgaver og rutiner spænder bredt, men her er et lille udsnit af hvad man blandt andet laver i løbet af en uge:

  • vareopfyldning og opbygning af oplæg
  • planlægning af varer i tilbudsavisen, demoer og andre salgsaktiviteter
  • lagerstyring
  • varebestilling
  • følge op på waste (svind og madspild)
  • afholde og deltage i teammøder
  • yde god vejledning og kundeservice til varehusets kunder

Herudover har man en lang række andre opgaver som håndteres med lidt større mellemrum som eksempelvis arbejde med sæsonvarer, spaceterminer (ombygning af sortimenter og afdeling) og meget mere. I Frugt og Grønt starter vi tidligt på dagen for at kunne levere en flot og velopfyldt afdeling til vores kunder. Her må vi arbejde effektivt og dynamisk for at skabe vores resultater. Udover arbejdet med varer og vedligehold af lager, så koordinerer man ressourcerne i afdelingen og leder og fordeler dagens opgaver.Desuden bidrager man aktivt og positivt til trivsel i afdelingen og vores dygtige medarbejderes udvikling.

Følg med her, hvor Lenett fortæller om jobbet og uddannelsen i føtex!

Medarbejder

Vi mangler en ny teamkoordinator og hvis du er nysgerrig, så skal det nu handle om dig!

For at komme i spil til vores spændende stilling kan du levere:

  • Du er tillidsfuld, ærlig og respektfuld. Du har en forbilledlig adfærd, går forrest og viser medarbejderne vejen.

  • Du udviser stort engagement og vægter kundeservice og medarbejder trivsel- og udvikling højt. Du bidrager med god energi og sætter et positivt præg på dit arbejde og dine kollegaer.

  • Du er tilpasningsdygtig og bevidst om, at vi aldrig stopper med at lære

  • Du har viljen og arbejder benhårdt for, at du og dit hold lykkes og skaber de bedst mulige resultater.

  • Du arbejder effektivt og søger gerne løsninger for at optimere effektiviteten

Du har fornemmelse for ledelse, tror på egne evner og forstår vigtigheden i at samarbejde og kommunikere. Du udvikler dig fagligt, tager ansvar, leverer resultater, stræber efter forbedringer og er en holdspiller.

**Er du klar til at sende din ansøgning afsted?**Hvis du stadig er nysgerrig på de mange muligheder føtex kan tilbyde, og er klar til at give den fuld gas i føtex’ blå skjorte, så klik på linket nedenfor og lad os høre mere om, hvem du er. Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig :)

Salling Group er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads med 60.000 medarbejdere i Danmark, Tyskland og Polen.

Vi driver butikker, varehuse, cafeer, spisesteder og webshops med vægt på kvalitet, service og omtanke for de samfund og den klode, vi er en del af.

Vi brænder for at gøre hverdagen bedre for vores kunder
