title: QA Tech - Vial Dept B Shift (7pm-7am; 3 on/3 off rotating shift)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Quality Technician is part of the Quality Assurance team and has responsibility for supporting activities in the manufacturing departments.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Must have good eye hand coordination: Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

• Conduct line qualifications and in-process quality inspections.

• Perform dimensional testing with both manual and automated optical comparators

• Document inspections and quality related events on worksheets/notebooks

• Maintain organization of drawing and gauge cabinets.

• Fill in for QA Technicians in all departments on all shifts as necessary for vacations, personal time, meetings, etc.

• Able to work any shift on any day, work overtime as required.

• Understand DWK’s Quality Policy and relevant Quality Objectives.

• Recognize his/her contribution to the effectiveness of the QMS including the benefits of improved performance.

• Comprehend the impact or effect of not conforming to the QMS.

• May perform any or all of these tasks depending upon work assignment.

• Maintain work area in a clean and habitable condition. Observe all safety precautions, rules and regulations.

• Additional duties as required by QA Manager.

• Observe all safety precautions, rules and regulations. Complies with and helps to enforce standard policies and procedures.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

• High school diploma is required.

• One year experience in a Quality related role is preferred

• Strong computer skills (preferably Excel) is preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT / CONDITIONS / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly (more than 2/3 of the time) required to use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee must regularly (more than 2/3 of the time) walk, sit, stand and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly (more than 2/3 of the time) lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently (between 1/3 to 2/3 of the time) lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally (less than 1/3 of the time) lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 12 hours per shift dependent upon where you’re needed. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly (more than 2/3 of the time) exposed to extreme heat. The employee is occasionally (more than 2/3 of the time) exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level is the work environment is usually loud. The company reserves the right to require employees to work overtime when deemed necessary.

title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst
description:
LAKE Autism Therapies is committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based support to individuals with autism and their families. We believe in nurturing both our clients and our team members through professional development, collaboration, and a strong focus on quality care.

We are currently seeking a dedicated and experienced Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join our team. In this role, you will provide direct services and supervision while helping shape the future of our behavior technician team. You will also mentor Behavior Technicians (BTs) and support their development into Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) through structured training and ongoing supervision.

Position Overview:

As a BCBA at LAKE Autism Therapies, you will lead the development and implementation of individualized ABA programs tailored to each client’s unique needs. You will conduct assessments, supervise staff, train caregivers, and ensure the integrity and effectiveness of treatment plans. This position is ideal for a collaborative, forward-thinking clinician who values mentorship, clinical excellence, and person-centered care. You will play a key role in supporting both client progress and staff development.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Complete initial and ongoing ABA assessments to drive effective, individualized treatment plans

  • Conduct parent training to support skill generalization and consistency across environments

  • Provide supervision to RBTs (5–10%) and client supervision (10–20%)

  • Deliver 1:1 direct observation and supervision sessions

  • Implement direct ABA therapy as needed

  • Review and analyze data to monitor client progress and make data-driven decisions

  • Identify objective, measurable goals based on assessments and data trends

  • Collaborate with caregivers and healthcare professionals for well-rounded care

  • Develop, implement, and update Comprehensive Response (CR) learning trees

  • Lead weekly team meetings with RBTs and Clinical Director

  • Participate in bi-weekly meetings with Dr. Ryan for clinical oversight

  • Track and support 40-hour RBT training and certification, including competency assessments and ongoing mentorship


Position Requirements:

  • Must be a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) in good standing with the BACB

  • Must currently reside in Michigan

  • Must hold and maintain all required Michigan licensure/credentials to provide behavior-analytic services in the state

  • Previous experience conducting ABA assessments, developing treatment plans, and supervising RBTs preferred

  • Strong leadership, communication, and mentorship skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively with families, RBTs, fellow clinicians, and other healthcare professionals

  • Commitment to ethical, evidence-based, and person-centered ABA services

Position Overview:

As a BCBA at LAKE Autism Therapies, you will lead the development and implementation of individualized ABA programs tailored to each client’s unique needs. You will conduct assessments, supervise staff, train caregivers, and ensure the integrity and effectiveness of treatment plans.

This position requires the BCBA to reside in Michigan and maintain all applicable Michigan licensure and professional credentials.

This position is ideal for a collaborative, forward-thinking clinician who values mentorship, clinical excellence, and person-centered care. You will play a key role in supporting both client progress and staff development.

Why Join LAKE?

  • Opportunities for mentorship and leadership

  • Supportive team culture focused on clinical excellence

  • Structured path for Behavior Technicians to become RBTs, under your guidance

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Ongoing professional development and CEU opportunities

title: Legal Officer till Alandia – med affärsnära juridik i fokus
description:
Legal Officer till Alandia – med affärsnära juridik i fokus

Vill du arbeta med juridik i en affärsnära roll där du är med och utvecklar verksamhet och affär?

Hos Alandia får du möjlighet att arbeta med komplexa frågor inom försäkringsrätt, affärsjuridik och regulatoriska områden i en internationell kontext och inom en specialiserad bransch.

Som Legal Officer är du en viktig rådgivare och bidrar med juridiska lösningar som är både affärsmässiga och praktiskt genomförbara.

Om rollen

Som Legal Officer ingår du i Legal Services, som är en del av Operationsstaben. Du rapporterar till Head of Legal Services. Förutom din juridiska kompetens är de interna och externa relationerna en nyckel för att lyckas i rollen. Du kommer att samarbeta med affärsansvariga, underwriters och andra funktioner för att bidra till lösningar på juridiska och regulatoriska frågeställningar. Du kommer också ha kontakter med externa parter såsom myndigheter, distributörer, samarbetspartners och juridiska rådgivare.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Proaktivt lösa juridiska och regulatoriska frågor samt ge löpande stöd inom Alandias olika affärsgrenar.

  • Följa rättsutvecklingen och tillsammans med verksamheten omsätta nya och förändrade regelverk till praktiska arbetssätt.

  • Delta i affärsutvecklingsprojekt och implementering av nya regelverk som förverkligar Alandias strategi och affärsmål.

  • Medverka i myndighetskontakter och fungera som juridiskt stöd i regulatoriska ärenden.

  • Utveckla och dokumentera juridiska arbetssätt som stärker kvalitet, kontinuitet och effektivitet.

Om dig

Du har en juristexamen motsvarande Master of Laws (LLM) och erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete med affärsfokus. För att lyckas i rollen vill du verkligen sätta dig in verksamheten. Du vill också förstå hur de affärsmässiga, operativa och juridiska förutsättningarna formar olika beslut. Vi tror också att du kan förklara komplexa frågor på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt och trivs med att samarbeta både med interna och externa intressenter.

För att lyckas i rollen har du:

  • Juristexamen (LLM eller motsvarande)

  • Erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete

  • Mycket god juridisk-, och affärsmässig analysförmåga

  • Förmåga att omsätta juridiska och regulatoriska krav till praktiska och affärsnära lösningar

  • Ett positivt, proaktivt och professionellt förhållningssätt

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Kunskaper i finska är meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Försäkringsverksamhet eller annan finansiell reglerad verksamhet

  • Sanktioner, KYC och AML/CFT-regelverk

  • Arbete i internationell kontext

  • IKT-, och/eller AI-reglering

Vi erbjuder

Hos Alandia blir du en del av ett i specialistbolag med stark position inom marinförsäkring och ett tydligt fokus på framtiden. Vår kultur präglas av driv, engagemang och ansvar.

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • En varierad och utvecklande juridisk roll med stor bredd och mycket eget ansvar

  • En verksamhetsnära roll där du tydligt bidrar till affärens och verksamhetens utveckling.

  • En internationell miljö med komplexa och utmanande frågeställningar

  • Kompetenta kollegor och goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling

  • Möjlighet att fördjupa dina kunskaper inom marinförsäkring, försäkringsrätt och finansiell reglering samt utveckla kompetens inom nya och specialiserade försäkringsområden.

Placeringsort: Mariehamn. Rollen innebär ett visst antal resdagar per år.

Omfattning: Tillsvidareanställning på heltid, inledande prövotid 6 månader.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Sista ansökningsdag: Urval sker löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är 15.10.2026

Kontaktperson: Lukas Hellman, Head of Legal Services lukas.hellman@alandia.com +358 400985958

Vi värdesätter mångfald och välkomnar alla sökande, oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund eller erfarenhet.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Commerce7, part of the Fullsteam organization, is a customer-centric commerce platform in the alcohol industry. Today we are the platform that powers over 3,500 leading alcohol brands including Opus One, Caymus, Harlan Estate, William Chris Winery and more. We believe that above price and product, the number one reason why a consumer chooses a brand is customer experience. Customer experiences that are customer-centric lead to loyalty, customer happiness, and ultimately drive sales and profit. Our mission at Commerce7 is to empower wineries with the tools and insights needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences and succeed in DTC.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with a strong background in software engineering and data to help design, build, and optimize the data systems that power our products and business insights, who is passionate about data architecture, reporting, and building scalable backend systems. The ideal candidate is results-driven, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement. If you thrive in a collaborative environment that values openness, innovation, and high standards, we’d love to hear from you.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Data & Reporting Ownership: Take ownership of a multi-tenant reporting architecture (currently 16 pools with individual tenant databases, over 3,000 tenants), ensuring stability, accuracy, and high performance for millions of processed records.
  • Migration Strategy: Architect and execute the long-term migration of legacy reporting systems (MSSQL/SSRS) into our modern core infrastructure (NodeJS/Aurora MySQL/AWS) with the potential to introduce Quicksights, Redshift or other technology.
  • Data Pipelines & ETL: Build, maintain, and scale robust ETL processes, data replication processes, and data sync engines utilizing batch processing and parallel execution chains.
  • Database Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks using advanced database performance strategies like index optimization, denormalized columns, and rollup tables.
  • API Development: Design and build data-intensive, scalable REST APIs that power core SaaS reporting features without relying on excessive external API calls.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product to translate reporting requirements into technical implementation plans. Work with Frontend Engineers to ensure smooth delivery of data visualizations.
  • Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, write automated integration/unit tests, and ensure backend code and data models follow modern best practices.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Database Performance: Proven ability to manage massive data volumes (millions of records). Strong understanding of indexing, stored procedures, denormalization strategies, and creating rollup tables for reporting.
  • Advanced SQL & MySQL: Deep expertise in MySQL and writing highly performant, direct SQL code. Must be comfortable with advanced concepts including complex Joins, Subqueries, Dynamic SQL, and Common Table Expressions (CTEs).
  • ETL & Data Sync: Extensive experience building ETL processes, data replication, and high-volume data synchronization engines.
  • AWS Cloud Ecosystem: Experience working with AWS cloud services, specifically Aurora Serverless, DynamoDB, Lambda, and SQS.
  • NodeJS & JavaScript: Proficiency with NodeJS (Express/Fastify), JavaScript (ES6+), and asynchronous programming patterns.
  • ORM Experience: Experience working with modern ORMs (like Sequelize) while knowing when to bypass them for raw SQL performance.
  • System Migration: Demonstrated experience modernizing legacy databases or migrating complex architectures into modern cloud ecosystems.
  • Detailed-Oriented: A strong sense of ownership for data integrity, code reliability, and accuracy in a product environment.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.
  • User first: A deep empathy for the user and a desire to learn about how they use Commerce7.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering with a direct focus on database architecture, data processing, ETL, and reporting systems.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and NodeJS (Express, Fastify, AWS Lambda).
  • Advanced hands-on experience with MySQL, modern ORMs (e.g., Sequelize), and writing optimized raw SQL.
  • Direct experience working with AWS cloud services (Aurora Serverless, DynamoDB, SQS).
  • Demonstrated track record of executing database migrations or legacy system modernizations (experience with MSSQL, SSRS, or PowerShell is a strong advantage).

Salary Range:

$116,000 - $140,000 CAD

Fullsteam recognizes that your health and wellbeing are a priority. This is why we offer a full suite of benefits that include:

  • Medical
  • Extended Health and LTD plan
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • RRSP (with employer match)
  • Health Spending Account

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
About this job


Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.


We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior SDET to support the next evolution of quality engineering by combining automated functional validation, production health monitoring, and AI-driven failure analysis.


This role is focused on ensuring that our Disaster Recovery (DR) and production environments are not only available, but fully functional, continuously validated, and increasingly capable of self-diagnosis. The ideal candidate will bring strong automation skills, systems thinking, and a passion for improving reliability across complex distributed systems.


Job Overview


As a Senior SDET, you will design and build automated quality and validation systems that strengthen confidence in both production and disaster recovery readiness. You will partner closely with QA, SRE, and Engineering teams to validate critical business workflows, improve observability, reduce alert noise, and accelerate incident detection and resolution.


This role sits at the intersection of test automation, production reliability, and intelligent diagnostics, helping advance Socure’s shift from traditional QA practices toward more autonomous, resilient quality systems.


Job Responsibilities



  • Design and implement automated functional health checks for DR and production environments using synthetic transactions and API validation.

  • Build continuous validation pipelines that verify end-to-end business workflows such as authentication, transactions, and system integrations.

  • Develop intelligent alerting mechanisms based on functional failures and customer-impacting behavior, not solely infrastructure metrics.

  • Integrate observability signals including logs, metrics, and traces with automated test frameworks to improve system visibility and diagnosis.

  • Develop AI/ML-driven approaches to detect failure patterns, correlate issues across services, and identify probable root causes.

  • Build systems that recommend or trigger automated remediation actions to support early-stage self-healing capabilities.

  • Partner cross-functionally with QA, SRE, and Engineering teams to improve service reliability, incident response, and recovery readiness.

  • Define, measure, and report on functional SLAs, service health indicators, and quality metrics.

  • Contribute to disaster recovery drills, readiness exercises, and automated validation efforts that improve resilience over time.


Job Requirements



  • 5+ years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks, including tools such as Playwright, Jest, SuperTest, and REST API testing frameworks.

  • Experience working in cloud environments, preferably AWS.

  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, Splunk, or similar tools.

  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar languages.

  • Experience designing end-to-end test strategies for distributed systems and production-like environments.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze failures across application, infrastructure, and workflow layers.


Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience with synthetic monitoring, production validation, or proactive health-checking systems.

  • Exposure to AI/ML techniques for anomaly detection, log analysis, or failure correlation.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and validation gates.

  • Understanding of microservices architecture, distributed system failure modes, and incident management practices.

  • Familiarity with SRE concepts such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, or production-readiness practices.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location

Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives. Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization – the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success. You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands‑on implementation, build functional proof‑of‑concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities
  • Full‑Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front‑end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
  • De‑Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof‑of‑concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company‑wide commitment.
  • Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
  • Ensure Frictionless Hand‑offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.
Qualifications
  • 0‑to‑1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high‑performance software in fast‑paced environments.
  • Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self‑directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
  • Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
  • AI‑Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI‑assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
  • High‑Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade‑offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high‑signal summaries for technical leadership.
  • Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi‑tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
What We Offer
  • Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
  • An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
  • Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
  • A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
  • Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world.
  • Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.
Who We Are

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry‑leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modelling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

At Bentley, you'll help shape the future of infrastructure with innovative solutions, a global impact, and a culture that values growth, collaboration, and sustainability.

description:
Position Summary:

The AI Engineer designs, develops, and deploys AI/ML-powered software solutions that advance Atlas's business operations and product innovation. Working within the software engineering team, this role builds and integrates AI capabilities—including LLM-based tools, copilots, data pipelines, and cloud applications—in alignment with established architecture, engineering standards, and product roadmaps. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical depth across the full AI/ML lifecycle with strong collaboration skills, translating requirements from product and engineering leadership into scalable, reliable, production-grade solutions while upholding security, privacy, and responsible-AI practices.

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Development

  • Develop, test, and deploy AI-powered software applications, including LLM-based tools, copilots, and automation solutions
  • Develop and integrate APIs, services, and data pipelines that support AI functionality
  • Contribute to identifying and prototyping high-value AI use cases in partnership with business, engineering, and lab-services stakeholders

Deployment & MLOps

Collaboration & Process

Compliance & Quality

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field required

Experience

  • 2+ years in software engineering, architecture, or applied data/ML engineering roles, with experience delivering AI/ML solutions (model development and/or LLM/RAG applications) into production environments

Technical Skills

Professional Skills

  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills; able to manage multiple tasks and deliver high-quality results

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

title: WIREMAN
description:
While the Inside Wireman/Installer is installing the wire and Homerun feeders on a project, the Foreman will be inspecting their work and addressing any issues with the work directly with the Wireman/Installer. Typical work that the Wireman/Installer would be responsible for is installing the network of low voltage cabling that is used for video, voice and data, Fire Alarm or other low voltage signaling.

While most installations are in buildings that are partially or fully enclosed to protect from sun, wind and rain; these installations are often installed before air conditioning, heat or permanent light fixtures have been installed in the buildings. Many jobs, however, are in existing buildings or offices; and some work may be outside under varying weather conditions.

Backbone voice and data cables are routed between the entrance facility, where communications signals enter a building: to equipment rooms and telephone rooms. Voice and data horizontal cables are routed between telephone rooms or equipment rooms and individual workstations throughout the building. Equipment rooms often contain energized equipment such as hubs, file servers, electrical panels or telephone switches.

In some cases these devices are configured and connected to equipment that currently serves the building and must not be interrupted as a result of work performed by unqualified workers or those only partially trained. Any question of how a system goes together or works must be immediately brought to the attention of the foreman.

The Wireman/Installer installs voice, data, video and Fire Devices at the time of trim in their designated locations as identified on the approved plans/layouts. In addition, they install punch down blocks and cross connects in telephone rooms when required. These may be wall mounted or rack mounted, and must be grouped and identified according to specific installation standards. Whether the work is in new construction or in existing office or manufacturing space, the craftsman takes pride in the work he or she has and can performed. All testing required to insure the installation was done properly must be done to avoid return trips to do repairs or perform quality control work that should have already been completed.

Job Description:Many of the work processes of the Installer Technician are listed below. There are many systems that utilize low voltage voice, data, video and Fire Devices. Not all Wireman/Installers work on all systems. However, properly trained Wireman/Installers can work on a variety of types of systems, including systems for voice, data, video and Fire Devices.

  • Plan and Initiate Projects at the apprentice level
  • Install Underground voice, data, video and Fire Devices Feeders to Facilities
  • Install Pathways, Hangers and Spaces for Installation of Low Voltage Wiring
  • Install, Terminate and Test Wires and Cables, both Copper and Fiber-Optic
  • Install, Test, Certify and Troubleshoot Local Area Network (LAN) Cabling Systems
  • Lay Out, Install and Verify Operation of Security and Access Control Systems
  • Install Communications and Sound Distribution Systems
  • Provide Testing, Analysis and Repair of Video, Voice and Data Systems; including Electronic Devices
  • Prefabricate Systems, such as Telecommunications Racks, for Field Installation
  • Work on other Sub-systems such as Communications, Entertainment, Environmental, Fire Life Safety and Access Control.
  • Seal all penetrations through rated areas with approved Fire Stopping Methods.

Responsible for the filling out of their own timesheet correctly and getting it into the payroll dept. by the required time and day.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer

Waystation AI | Redwood City, CA (in person, 5 days per week) | Full-time

You build the data systems for the scale we are heading into, not the scale we have today. You also build product.

About Waystation

CPG is a $4 trillion market in the US. The manufacturers in it still buy ingredients through email and spreadsheets. Waystation reads supplier email and makes a structured record of each quote, spec, COA, and PO. Procurement, QA, and R&D teams then compare ingredients, track certifications, and write to suppliers.

We are seed-stage and we have paying customers. One customer saved more than $200,000 in three months. Our founder and CEO is Ryan Caldbeck, who started CircleUp. Our investors include Founder Collective, Homebrew, Slow Ventures, 87 Capital, Floodgate, and SuccessVP.

What you'll own

  • The most difficult data work. You design the schema for suppliers, items, prices, and documents. The model covers raw materials, packaging, and freight.

  • Migrations and backfills on live customer data. You plan the steps, the tests, and the recovery if a step fails. Every migration gets harder as the data grows, so you build the method now.

  • Queues and jobs at the volume that is coming. We add customers each month, and each customer connects several inboxes. The inbox count grows faster than the customer count. The pipeline works today. It will not work at 10x, 100x, or 1000x the volume as the company grows. You own the order of the steps, the retries, the failure behavior, and the throughput. You make the pipeline ready before the load arrives, not after a customer reports a delay.

  • Guidance for other engineers. You are the most experienced person on the team in these areas. You review the difficult designs and you set the patterns. Other engineers still make their own schema decisions and write their own migrations.

  • Product work, not only architecture. You build customer-facing features, not only the systems behind them. You talk to customers directly, and you use what you learn.

What we're looking for

  • Six or more years of experience with production software, with depth in backend and data work.

  • Two or more years at a startup between seed and Series B. This is a requirement. A career only at large companies is not a match.

  • You designed schemas for difficult domains, and you changed them on a live system without data loss. You know what a flexible model costs later.

  • You work with data that is not clean. Supplier data has different units, names, and languages.

  • You built queues and background jobs. You plan for retries, duplicate work, and the part that fails first when the load increases.

  • You design API patterns, internal and external, that stay consistent as the product grows. Other engineers follow the patterns you set.

  • You use AI tools every day. We use Claude Code. You also ship features that use models.

  • You want to build product, and you have opinions about the interface.

  • You write and speak with precision. Engineers, customers, and the CEO know what you decided and why.

Our stack is TypeScript, Node, React, GraphQL, and Postgres. Experience with it helps, but we do not require it.

Not the role for you if

  • You want to work only on data and pipelines. This role also builds product.

  • You want a defined lane and a backlog of specified tickets.

  • You cannot work in Redwood City five days per week.

What we offer

Competitive salary and meaningful equity. Health, dental, and vision insurance. Unlimited vacation. You work directly with the CEO.

title: Kundedirektør til Private Banking Sjælland
description:
Private Banking Sjælland fortsætter med at vækste, og derfor søger vi en kundedirektør. Vi søger dig, der både kan og vil opbygge stærke relationer. Du skaber følgeskab i teamet og bidrager aktivt til et tæt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen.

Du bliver en del af et strategisk vigtigt vækstområde i Nykredit-koncernen og får ansvaret for at lede og udvikle et dygtigt team af Private Bankere. Samtidig indgår du i et lederteam med tre ledere. Sammen arbejder vi for at levere rådgivning af højeste kvalitet og skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • Sikre, at strategien omsættes til konkrete handlinger i teamet.
  • Fremme en feedbackkultur med fokus på samarbejde samt personlig og faglig udvikling.
  • Sikre, at Private Banking er solidt forankret i sunde værdier og høj faglig ekspertise.
  • Skabe et engageret team, der arbejder målrettet med at styrke kundeoplevelsen.
  • Skabe tryghed og tillid, så både kunder og kolleger oplever dig som en troværdig og tillidsskabende leder.
  • Afholde afdelingsmøder med teamet.
  • Følge op på aftaler med lokalbankerne.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Vi søger dig, der har solid og relevant ledelseserfaring, og som motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre. Du sætter en tydelig retning, omsætter strategi til handling og følger op. Samtidig giver du medarbejderne ansvar, sparring og de rette rammer for at lykkes. Du har erfaring med at udvikle både mennesker og forretning og kan med et analytisk blik og en struktureret tilgang identificere den enkelte medarbejders styrker og udviklingsbehov.

Som leder er du empatisk, nærværende og oprigtigt nysgerrig. Du tør give noget af dig selv, så medarbejdere og kolleger oplever en autentisk, troværdig og tillidsskabende ledelse. Du kommunikerer klart, skaber følgeskab og bidrager aktivt til en kultur præget af feedback, samarbejde og engagement.

Samtidig har du en solid faglig baggrund og gerne praktisk erfaring med rådgivning af formuende kunder. Det gør dig i stand til at udfordre og understøtte teamet i ambitionen om at løfte kundeoplevelsen. Med din handlekraft, medmenneskelighed og forretningsmæssige forståelse styrker du relationerne til både kunder og kolleger og bidrager til vores fælles mål om at skabe værdi, overblik og tryghed for kunderne.

Til gengæld tilbyder vi gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling til dig, der har ambitionerne og lysten til at gøre en forskel.

Dit nye team
Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med 28 Private Bankere, tre formuerådgivere og tre ledere samt adgang til et stort team af investeringsrådgivere. Vi samarbejder bredt med kolleger i Nykredit-koncernen, blandt andet i lokalbankerne, International og Private Banking Elite.

Hos os går godt humør, et højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater hånd i hånd. Du skal trives i en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du sjældent sidder på den samme plads to dage i træk. Omgangstonen er frisk og uformel, og vi lægger vægt på en positiv og løsningsorienteret tilgang.

Du får fast arbejdssted i Roskilde, men får også mulighed for at arbejde fra vores lokalbanker på forskellige lokationer i Regionalbank Sjælland.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Lars Thier, på 60 56 70 06, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Lars Thier | LinkedIn.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit CV.

Ansøgningsfrist

18.10.2026

By

Roskilde

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (Applied AI) (Toronto)
description:
SENIOR MEMBER OF TECHNICAL STAFF (APPLIED AI)

LOCATION: TORONTO, ONTARIO

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

Solstice is redefining how life sciences organizations commercialize therapeutics. We are building a commercial engine that allows pharmaceutical marketers to launch campaigns at 100x the speed. Our mission is to accelerate the knowledge of life-saving medicines.

  • Rapid growth: Over the past year, we have worked with some of the top life sciences manufacturers and over 50+ pharma brands including Pfizer and AstraZeneca.

  • A hard technical problem: We are trying to rethink the way the largest, most innovative therapies in the world come to market. Every claim in pharma marketing content must trace to an approved source. Fair balance rules govern placement. All materials go through rigorous medical, legal, and regulatory review, which can last months. Building persuasive and defensible content is a genuine challenge, with no playbook. We have the customers and proprietary data to do this right.

  • Top-tier investors: Our backers include Transformation Capital, Twelve Below, Virtue and the founders of Datavant, Commure, and Paradigm.

  • Influence and ownership: This senior role directly shapes our architectural future. We're seeking someone who wants responsibility, not someone who needs work handed to them.

SOLSTICE IN TORONTO

We're opening our first engineering office outside New York, in Toronto. This is one of the first hires there. The Toronto team will own a product area end to end, with its own roadmap and on-call. It won't be a queue for work handed over from New York.

  • For the right person, this role leads Toronto engineering. That includes a seat in engineering leadership from your first week and a direct hand in hiring and growing the team that joins after you.

  • Same time zone as New York, and one of our co-founders will be in Toronto with the team.

  • You'll spend your first month in New York working alongside the team in person. We cover travel and accommodation.

  • This role will be on-site in Toronto. We'll start remotely for the first few months, with a WeWork stipend for those who prefer it. As the team grows, we'll move into our own Toronto office by the end of the year and work from there five days a week.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a senior Applied AI engineer to own the technical direction of our AI systems: retrieval, generation, verification, evaluation, and keeping systems running in production. Nothing's predetermined. When there's a fork in the road, you decide.

You will work closely with VP of Engineering Jay, and co-founders Aris and Yiwen, influencing product strategy, technical hiring, and our market positioning.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

  • High-craft output: Our clients demand work with polish, not "AI slop." Pharma assets like emails, banners, slides and leave-behinds require both visual and textual excellence. ISI must be prominent, brand systems must endure, and hierarchy and typography must survive generation. Our job isn't just compliance. It's making sure assets don't get quietly rewritten by marketers.

  • Connecting content to outcomes: Passing MLR review means a piece can ship, but not that it worked. We'll connect generated assets to real-world performance, including engagement, HCP response and scripts written, and use that data to improve future output.

  • Evaluation where ground truth is slow: Determining compliance is slow, coming back as reviewer redlines in inconsistent formats. Developing offline metrics that track downstream MLR pass rate is critical.

  • Claim-level attribution: True grounding means every sentence can be traced back to a specific, defensible source. Our proprietary corpora span prescribing information, clinical data, approved assets, style guides and claim libraries, and provenance must be preserved through generation.

  • ML Ops and behavioral regression: Full CI/CD for ML, versioning, automated testing, monitoring, and the harder under-the-hood work. Upgrades shift output in ways easy stats can miss, and tail risks matter most. Ongoing vigilance is required.

IDEAL TRAITS

title: Demand Planner
description:
Demand Planner

Position Summary

The Demand Planner plays a critical role in driving demand visibility and supporting business growth across Safilo's portfolio. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining demand forecasts and partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between commercial plans and supply chain capabilities. Through data analysis, market insights, and close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Category Management, and Supply Planning, the Demand Planner helps maximize product availability, support successful product launches, and drive continuous improvement in forecasting and inventory management processes.

Key Responsibilities


Demand Forecast Process and Product Lifecycle

  • Assist in preparing and maintaining a rolling 12-month demand forecast using historical sales, customer orders, market trends, and business inputs.
  • Update monthly forecasts to reflect changes in demand, promotions, new product introductions, and end-of-life transitions.
  • Analyze forecast performance and identify trends, risks, and opportunities that may affect forecast accuracy, inventory, or service levels.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Category Management, and Supply Planning to incorporate commercial inputs into the demand plan.
  • Support new product forecasting through analysis of comparable products, launch assumptions, and early sales performance.

Measure and track performance:

  • Track and report key planning metrics, including forecast accuracy, forecast error, SKU coverage, availability, slow movers, and best sellers.
  • Prepare planning reports, dashboards, and management summaries with a strong focus on data quality and actionable insights.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen planning effectiveness, reporting, forecast accuracy, and service levels.


SKU rationalization strategies:

  • Support assortment reviews, SKU rationalization, excess inventory reduction, closeout activities, and stock utilization initiatives.
  • Help identify potential stockouts, overstock situations, and portfolio opportunities, communicating findings clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Analytics, Operations, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
  • 0-2 years of experience in supply chain, demand planning, inventory, operations, or data analysis; relevant internship or co-op experience is welcomed.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; exposure to macros or advanced data tools is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, or broader supply chain concepts.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
  • Strong organizational skills, curiosity, adaptability, and a proactive approach in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exposure to SAP, Tableau, Shopify, Analysis-BW, JDA, or Blue Yonder is preferred but not required.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and statistical skills
  • Proactiveness, strong organizational skills, adaptability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Focus on achieving results and driving continuous improvement in demand planning processes
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

The Logistics Specialist is a highly organized and detail-oriented professional responsible for supporting Mach Industries’ domestic and international logistics operations. This role will coordinate the movement of hardware, materials, equipment, and demonstration assets across commercial, government, and military-related programs while ensuring shipments are executed safely, on time, and in compliance with applicable trade, transportation, and customer requirements. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-paced defense startup environment, managing complex international shipments, working directly with freight forwarders and customs brokers, and supporting Business Development activities including tradeshows, demonstrations, and customer events. This position requires strong knowledge of shipping documentation, tariff classification, export/import processes, and defense-industry logistics requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and execute domestic and international shipments by air, ocean, ground, and courier, including time-critical and high-value defense hardware.
  • Manage end-to-end international logistics, including freight bookings, routing, pickup coordination, customs clearance, delivery tracking, and final-mile execution.
  • Prepare and review commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, air waybills, certificates of origin, shipper’s letters of instruction, and other import/export documentation.
  • Determine and validate HTS/HS and Schedule B tariff classifications; support country-of-origin, valuation, duty, tax, and customs documentation requirements.
  • Support export compliance activities involving ITAR, EAR, AES/EEI filings, Foreign Trade Regulations (FTR), export licenses, exemptions/exceptions, and recordkeeping requirements in coordination with Trade Compliance.
  • Coordinate temporary exports and imports for Business Development demonstrations, tradeshows, customer events, field tests, and international deployments, including ATA Carnets and other temporary-import mechanisms when applicable.
  • Partner with Business Development, Engineering, Program Management, Security, Trade Compliance, and Operations to develop logistics plans for events, demonstrations, and customer deliveries.
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, airlines, ocean carriers, and overseas agents to resolve transportation, documentation, and customs issues.
  • Support packaging, preservation, labeling, and marking requirements for government and military shipments, including familiarity with applicable MIL-STD requirements such as MIL-STD-2073 and MIL-STD-129, as well as ASTM D3951 when contractually required.
  • Ensure shipments comply with applicable hazardous materials and dangerous goods requirements, including 49 CFR, IATA/ICAO, and IMDG regulations, as applicable.
  • Support government and defense contract logistics requirements, including familiarity with FAR, DFARS, ITAR, EAR, and customer-specific shipping instructions or contract clauses.
  • Maintain shipment records, export/import documentation, proof of delivery, tracking data, and audit-ready files in accordance with company and regulatory retention requirements.
  • Identify logistics risks, shipment delays, customs holds, documentation gaps, and routing constraints; proactively communicate issues and drive resolution.
  • Develop and improve standard work, carrier processes, shipping documentation, and international logistics workflows to support Mach’s continued growth.
  • Operate forklifts and other approved material-handling equipment as needed to safely load, unload, stage, and move freight, equipment, and program assets.
  • Support other Logistics, Shipping, Receiving, Warehouse, Material Handling, and Operations functions as needed to meet program schedules, shipment deadlines, and changing business priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, international shipping, import/export operations, or supply chain management.
  • Working knowledge of HTS/HS and Schedule B tariff classifications, customs documentation, country of origin, and commercial invoice requirements.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. export/import regulations and processes, including ITAR, EAR, AES/EEI, and Foreign Trade Regulations.
  • Experience working with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and international logistics providers.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel/Google Workspace and experience maintaining shipment records, reports, and logistics documentation.
  • Ability to function effectively in a fast-paced defense startup environment and support occasional after-hours or event-driven logistics requirements.
  • Willingness and flexibility to support cross-functional logistics and warehouse activities outside primary responsibilities when operational needs are required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting aerospace, defense, government, or military logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with ATA Carnets, temporary imports/exports, bonded movements, and international customs procedures.
  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-2073, MIL-STD-129, ASTM D3951, or other U.S. Government packaging, preservation, marking, and shipping requirements.
  • Knowledge of hazardous materials/dangerous goods transportation requirements, including 49 CFR, IATA/ICAO, and IMDG.
  • Familiarity with FAR, DFARS, government contract clauses, Defense Transportation Regulation (DTR), or Military Freight Traffic Unified Rules Publication (MFTURP-1).

Additional Requirements

  • Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Pay Range
$30—$38 USD

At Mach, we believe that compensation is more than just a paycheck. It's a comprehensive package designed to reward the time, skills, and expertise you bring to our team. We are committed to offering competitive compensation that is equitable, transparent, and aligned with market trends.

Key Elements of Our Compensation Philosophy:

  • Competitive Salaries: We continuously research market rates to ensure our salaries are competitive with those in our industry and geographic location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Our bonus structure is tied to both individual and company performance, creating a win-win scenario that motivates our team members to excel.
  • Equity Participation: We offer stock options or equity to employees, ensuring that you share in the success and growth of the company.
  • Benefit Packages: Our benefits include healthcare, dental and vision plans, retirement savings, and paid time off, because we understand that your well-being extends beyond the office.
  • Professional Development: We allocate funds for continuing education, training, and career growth.
  • Transparency: We are committed to openness about our compensation tiers and how decisions are made, ensuring trust and mutual respect.

By joining Mach, you’re not just accepting a job—you’re becoming a key part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your growth. Together, we aim to create a rewarding environment that sets the stage for long-term success.

Data Privacy

Disclosures

Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

title: Director of Brand Strategy
description:
The Brand Strategy Director role is for a strategic leader who thinks deeply about human behavior, audience mindsets, motivations, emotional drivers, and the moments that influence decision-making; and knows how to translate those insights into cohesive brand, communications, and experience strategies and narrative platforms that are informed by both qualitative insight and performance data.

You will define the strategic foundation that unifies how a brand shows up across creative, communications, content, and experience touchpoints. You will also shape the core brand story and experience principles that guide how that story is expressed across channels and moments. The goal is to ensure the ecosystem reflects what customers actually need, care about, and respond to while clearly defining what success looks like and enabling teams to measure, learn, and optimize over time.

You’ll partner closely with Creative, Growth, Analytics, and Client Leadership. Working in active collaboration with analytics teams to define KPIs, interpret performance signals, and translate insight into strategic refinement guiding multidisciplinary teams with clarity, insight, and a compelling point of view to architect experiences and storytelling journeys that feel relevant, resonant, and purposeful.

Your Impact

  • Shape audience-led strategies that clarify how brands build meaningful, lasting relationships with people and how those relationships translate into measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a unified experience and narrative architecture that aligns brand storytelling, communications, customer journeys, and success metrics.

  • Elevate creative output by grounding ideas in deep human insight and clearly articulated objectives that enable performance evaluation and learning.

  • Help clients reframe challenges, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategy to outcomes across brand, engagement, and conversion through clearer narrative direction and experience design choices.

  • Contribute to the evolution of SiaX’s strategic POV by strengthening how insight, experience design, brand narrative systems, and measurement work together in an integrated offering.

What Success Looks Like

When you’re thriving in this role, the impact is felt across the work, the team, the client relationship, and the business:

Audience Insight & Behavioral Understanding

  • The team rallies around a clear, shared understanding of who the audience is, what they care about, and why they behave the way they do, supported by research and behavioral data.

  • Strategy consistently starts from human truth and is reinforced by performance signals, resulting in work that feels intuitive, relevant, and grounded and expressed through consistent brand storytelling frameworks.

  • Client conversations evolve from surface-level tactics to deeper discussions about motivation, mindset, moments that matter, story resonance, message clarity, and how effectiveness is measured.

Experience & Narrative Architecture

  • The brand shows up as a cohesive, intentional ecosystem, not disconnected campaigns or channels with clarity on how success is defined across the customer journey.

  • Stories evolve naturally across touchpoints, with each interaction reinforcing a clear emotional and functional value exchange that can be evaluated over time and mapped to a defined narrative spine.

  • Teams can clearly articulate how individual ideas ladder to a broader narrative and experience vision and how impact is assessed and optimized.

Strategic Leadership & Creative Enablement

  • Creative teams feel inspired, focused, and well-armed—briefs unlock better thinking while clearly defining objectives, success criteria, and learning agendas and the role each execution plays in the broader brand story.

  • Creative work reflects strong audience insight, strategic intent, and a clear understanding of what outcomes the work is meant to influence and what story it is meant to advance.

  • Strategy is seen as a catalyst for great creative and smarter decision-making, elevating both ambition and effectiveness while protecting narrative and experience consistency.

Cross-Disciplinary Orchestration

  • Strategy acts as connective tissue across Creative, Growth, Analytics, and Client teams, aligning vision, execution, and performance measurement.

  • Planning feels intentional and customer-led, with shared priorities and a common understanding of what success looks like and how brand experience and story expression stay coherent across channels.

  • Teams understand not just what they are doing and why, but how progress will be measured and learned from and how it contributes to the evolving brand narrative.

Client Partnership & Business Impact

  • Clients view you as a trusted strategic partner who helps them see their business and customers more clearly and make more informed decisions.

  • Strategic thinking drives longer-term relationships, deeper scope, and more meaningful influence by connecting insight, experience, and results through differentiated brand storytelling and experience strategy.

  • Your work contributes to stronger client outcomes and reinforces SiaX’s reputation for insight-led, integrated strategy and experience-driven brand storytelling with measurable impact.

  • 7–12+ years of strategy experience within a full-service advertising agency or integrated creative consultancy, spanning integrated strategy, brand strategy, communications planning, experience strategy, brand narrative development, storytelling strategy, or a closely related audience-centric discipline.

  • Proven track record leading strategy for complex, multi-channel brand ecosystems where storytelling, behavior, communications, experience design, and collaboration with analytics teams must work together seamlessly.

  • Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams (creative, media/growth, analytics, CX, account leadership) through a unified strategic vision from insight to execution and consistent brand story expression.

  • History of shaping strategic foundations that scale across campaigns, platforms, and customer journeys not one-off initiatives or isolated campaign narratives.

Skills

  • Exceptional insight development, paired with the ability to partner with analytics teams to define success metrics and interpret performance data.

  • Strong narrative thinker who distills complexity into clarity and builds frameworks teams can rally behind including brand story and experience frameworks.

  • Skilled at guiding creative and experience development through a customer psychology and journey-led lens while maintaining accountability to outcomes and narrative cohesion.

  • Confident presenting to senior clients and shaping how they think about their brand’s role in people’s lives and business performance through experience and story, not just messaging.

Mindset

  • Human-centered, curious, empathetic, and pattern-oriented.

  • Highly collaborative and comfortable navigating multiple inputs, stakeholders, and data sources.

  • Balances strategic rigor with creative intuition and narrative sensibility.

  • Energized by ambiguity, vision-setting, and elevating the work of teams through insight and learning and through stronger brand and experience storytelling.

Additional Information

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in supporting our team professionally and personally. Here’s a snapshot of the comprehensive benefits you’ll enjoy as part of Sia.

  • Annual base salary starting at $180,000-$190,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Extras that Make Life Easier

title: Kalankäsittelijä, fish processer to Föglö, Åland Islands for Fish Industry, +6 months,
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for fish processer(s) to Föglö, Åland Islands.

The job involves many different functions at the fish factory: killing, gutting, "cleaning" the fish, "collecting" roe, packing, lifting heavy boxes, among other tasks. If you have forklift skills, you can also drive a counter balance forklift. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. At Nordic Trout/Bolt.works, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
The work requires decent general strength, endurance, and proactivity. Previous experience in fish processing jobs is a plus but not necessary. You will receive orientation to the job. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. Finnish hygiene passport will be needed but we can train it for the right person. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5hr/week
- Salary: approx. 12-13 EUR/h, depending on experience
- Contract length: approx. 6 months, with good possibility to continue further as permanent employment
- Start date: Sometime during October
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has small grocery store, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car/bus. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Etsimme nyt kalankäsittelijää Föglöön, Ahvenanmaalle.

Työtehtävät pitävät sisällään monipuolisia toimintoja kalatehtaalla: kalan teurastusta, perkausta, "putsaamista", mädin keruuta, pakkaamista sekä raskaiden laatikoiden nostelua. Jos sinulla on trukin ajotaitoja, voit ajaa myös vastapainotrukkia. Työskentelyolosuhteet ovat viileät (noin +2 – +6 °C), joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Nordic Troutilla / Bolt.worksilla pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todella yhteisöllistä "työperhettä".

Kelle työ sopii?
Työ vaatii kohtalaista yleiskuntoa, kestävyyttä ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Aiempi kokemus kalankäsittelystä on plusa, mutta ei välttämätöntä – saat työhön perehdytyksen. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka nauttii luonnon läheisyydestä, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella saaristossa. Hygieniapassi vaaditaan, mutta voimme kouluttaa sen oikealle henkilölle. Sinun tulee pystyä kommunikoimaan englanniksi sujuvan tiimityöskentelyn takaamiseksi.

- Työaika: 20–37,5 t/vk
- Palkka: n. 12–13 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen
- Sopimuksen kesto: n. 6 kuukautta, hyvä mahdollisuus jatkua vakituisena työsuhteena
- Aloitus: Lokakuun aikana
- TES: Elintarvikealan työehtosopimus
- Työsuhde: Bolt.worksin kautta

Tietoa työpaikasta ja käytännön järjestelyistä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupunkipalveluita: saarella on pieni ruokakauppa, kirjasto ja kuntosali, kun taas muut palvelut löytyvät Maarianhaminasta (35 min lautalla + 30 min autolla/bussilla). Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee majoituksen lähellä ja Maarianhaminaan kulkee bussi. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: yleensä asut toisen työntekijän kanssa kaksiossa. Vuokra on noin 300–450 €, ja se voi sisältää tai olla sisältämättä sähköä/vettä asunnosta riippuen (saat tarkat tiedot työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Nordic Trout (Kalaneuvos):
Nordic Trout on Suomen kalatoimialan suurin toimija sekä edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, tukkukaupassa, tuonnissa, viennissä ja kasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuotta panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändi tarjoaa laajan valikoiman herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Her kan du læse mere om vores bageri.

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 8.500 ambitiøse kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Facilities Development Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Facilities Development Specialist leads the coordination of capital improvement initiatives, facility development projects, acquisitions, and operational facility programs across the organization. This position independently manages multiple projects, develops implementation plans, evaluates vendor performance, monitors capital investments, and partners with operational leaders to ensure facilities meet organizational standards and strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Acquisition & Facility Development

  • Conduct acquisition walkthroughs and facility assessments to evaluate building conditions, equipment, and operational readiness.
  • Document facility conditions, equipment inventories, deficiencies, and capital improvement opportunities.
  • Develop capital expenditure (CapEx) budgets and facility investment recommendations.
  • Develop recommendations and reports supporting documentation for acquisition reviews and leadership approval.
  • Monitor and analyze facility compliance with VIVE operational standards.
  • Development and monitoring of 30-, 60-, and 90-day post-acquisition facility improvement plans.

Capital Project Coordination

  • Manage multiple facility remodels, branding initiatives, and capital improvement projects simultaneously, establishing project priorities, timelines, budgets, and execution strategies.
  • Direct contractors, vendors, and subcontractors to support project execution.
  • Monitor project timelines, milestones, and completion schedules.
  • Oversee permitting, inspections, and occupancy requirements with local jurisdictions.

Monitor capital expenditures, identify budget variances, and recommend corrective actions to maintain fiscal accountability.

Equipment Installation & Facility Upgrades

  • Oversee the installation of shop equipment including paint booths, air compressors, frame machines, lifts, welders, measuring systems, and ADAS calibration equipment.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate project scope and pricing, and recommend vendor selection based on cost, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Manage equipment deliveries, installations, commissioning, and operational readiness.
  • Direct vendor training and ensure equipment is fully functional upon project completion.

CapEx Budget & Vendor Management

  • Manage approved and planned capital expenditures across all VIVE locations.
  • Monitor and analyze project budgets, spending forecasts, and financial performance.
  • Participate in monthly CapEx reporting and budget reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings through competitive bidding and vendor negotiations.
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers.

Facility Maintenance & Compliance

  • Manage preventative maintenance schedules for facility assets across all locations.
  • Manage maintenance vendors and service contracts to ensure timely completion of work.
  • Track inspections, repairs, warranties, preventative maintenance, and service agreements.
  • Monitor maintenance completion and facility compliance with company standards.
  • Monitor and support initiatives that reduce equipment downtime and improve facility reliability.

Qualifications

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Facilities Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Experience coordinating facilities, construction, maintenance, CapEx, or commercial building projects.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing multiple construction, facilities, or capital improvement projects with responsibility for project planning, budget management, vendor oversight, and execution.
  • Experience working with contractors, vendors, and service providers.
  • Financial aptitude with experience tracking project budgets and expenditures.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with project management software is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to travel approximately 75% to support acquisitions, facility projects, and operational initiatives.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel independently.

Decision-Making & Autonomy

  • Prioritizes multiple concurrent facility and capital projects with minimal supervision.
  • Evaluates operational needs and develops project recommendations for leadership approval.
  • Exercises independent judgment when resolving vendor issues, project delays, scheduling conflicts, and facility-related operational challenges.
  • Recommends process improvements to enhance facility operations, project execution, and capital investment effectiveness.
  • Serves as the primary point of coordination between operations, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

This position is primarily remote but requires extensive travel to VIVE Collision facilities, acquisition sites, vendor locations, and project sites throughout the company's operating footprint. Work is performed in both office and active construction or collision repair environments. The role requires flexibility to accommodate project schedules, vendor coordination, and acquisition timelines.


Physical Demands

  • Frequent travel by automobile and commercial airline (approximately 75%).
  • Ability to walk construction sites and active collision repair facilities.
  • Ability to climb stairs, ladders, and safely navigate uneven surfaces during facility inspections.
  • Occasionally lift and carry materials or equipment up to 25 pounds.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting, driving, and working on a computer.
  • Regular verbal and written communication with vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits
