title: Software Engineer – Inference
description:
An active TS//SCI clearance with polygraph is required for this role

Bitwise is a leading provider of mission-focused intelligence solutions that advance national security for the Intelligence Community and Department of Defense. We're a small and growing company, so you can expect to hop in on the ground floor with us and be a consequential member of the team. You'll be more than a contract performer for us — you'll also be asked for ideas to improve our company and improve your career, and you'll contribute to our team culture. We value growth and community above almost all else, so we gather regularly for game nights, happy hours, tech talks, and plenty more. We think you'll like it here!

Remember, Bitwise is not a cult.

What We Look For

Bitwise hires talented engineers who are driven by purpose and who value a culture of technical excellence, growth, and overall wellness. We deliver new and innovative intelligence solutions to our customers at the very forefront of our country's national security missions. And we do it every single day. Our work matters, and so will you.

We ask that every new hire be able to:

  • Contribute meaningful thought leadership — if not right away, over time
  • Interact with our customers and earn their confidence in your abilities
  • Be detailed, even if that means taking a little more time to get it right
  • Contribute their ideas and ideals to improve all aspects of our companyli>
  • Allow us to invest in their education so we both grow together

We're building the next generation of AI infrastructure that will power innovation across our customer's organization, and we need a software engineer to help us do it. In this role, you'll support our AI infrastructure team by helping build and maintain the foundation for customer AI capabilities while supporting a broader ecosystem of AI-enabled applications. Your focus will be ensuring access to the highest available quality LLMs to users throughout the inference software stack.

Requirements shift quickly as mission needs evolve and new technologies emerge, so you'll keep sharpening your skills and learning to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions. You'll work directly with our team to develop robust systems that power critical national security capabilities.

What You'll Do:

  • Procure, configure, and test new inference models, preparing them for release to our user base
  • Develop in-house services and techniques to guarantee continual high-quality inference service for our customer
  • Work with model vendor teams and representatives to create reliable pipelines for closed-source model usage
  • Collaborate with teammates on surge efforts to support short-term, high-priority inference needs from our customer
  • Engage with other teams in our organization to establish solid infrastructure for our services and integrate LLM-powered tools for user needs

Requirements

  • 3 years of experience in software engineering, OR a B.S. in a technical discipline plus 4 additional years of related experience
  • Experience with Python and/or other modern programming languages
  • Familiarity with Argo CD and/or other CI/CD frameworks
  • Experience with Kubernetes/Helm
  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud service providers
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to ask questions
  • Experience with vLLM, LiteLLM, or similar inference-serving frameworks
  • Experience with other LLM hosting frameworks and practices
  • Experience supporting production software using Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices
  • Experience with Elastic, Grafana/Prometheus, or other observability frameworks and practices
  • Experience with Docker and containerization
  • Experience in traffic shaping and quality-of-service engineering
  • Knowledge of and interest in hosting AI capabilities

Benefits at Bitwise

  • Top salaries because we're top performers
  • Pick your PTO — Everyone values time and money differently, so we give you the flexibility to choose between 3 and 5 weeks of PTO with a corresponding adjustment to your pay. Your choice, your balance.
  • All 11 federal holidays, paid!
  • Up to 2 snow days, paid!
  • We'll quadruple (4x!) the first 6% you contribute to your 401(k), giving you up to a 24% company match. Contributing less than 6%? Unclaimed matches come right back to you as extra income, giving you a guaranteed 24% that goes to your retirement, to your paycheck, or both. C'mon now!
  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurances. That's a lot. Already covered on health insurance? No problem — we'll trade you this benefit for a boost to your salary instead.
  • $5,250 annual education assistance for training, certificates, tuition, and even student loan repayments.
  • Spot bonuses for obtained certifications, customer recognition, and just about anything else that makes us go "Hot damn!". We hope to say that many times about you.

Salary Range

$197,500 – $232,500

This range includes our flex income and depends upon your annual work hours.

Salary is determined on an individual basis following the interview process and considering various factors such as years of experience, skills, education, and certifications.

What to Expect After Applying

You'll get an email from us right away to acknowledge your application. After that, we'll:

  • Send over additional company materials for you to review
  • Schedule a video call to talk about you, our company, and your place in it
  • Craft a delightful offer package for you and record a video walkthrough
  • Work closely with you through onboarding. We'll keep it joyful and easy.

Bitwise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Dual Rate Security Supervisor

Join a team where leadership, vigilance, and professionalism make a difference every day. Apply today and build your career in a role dedicated to safety, security, and exceptional guest service.

title: Senior Product Manager

title: Bliv leder for AI Engagement i Nykredits AI Center of Excellence
description:
Vil du stå i front for Nykredits AI‑rejse og være drivkraften bag at modne, engagere og klæde hele organisationen på til at være bedst til ansvarlig og skaleret AI-ibrugtagning? Har du erfaring med transformation, træning og digitalisering – og kan du sætte retning, opbygge struktur og sikre forankring i en større organisation? Så har vi en af de mest spændende roller på Nykredits AI‑agenda til dig!

**En hverdag med strategisk betydning og bredt samarbejde i koncernen
**Vi er et dynamisk og engageret AI CoE, der driver udviklingen af Nykredits AI‑modenhed og omsætter potentialet i både klassisk og generativ AI til reel forretningsværdi. Vores mission er at sikre ansvarlig og værdiskabende brug af AI på tværs af hele organisationen – fra Copilot-adoption til skalering af ny AI‑teknologi og forankring af nye arbejdsformer.

**Din rolle som leder for AI Engagement
**Hos os bliver du en del af et team, der har ansvaret for at løfte AI‑agendaen strategisk og operationelt. Du vil få en særskilt og central rolle i at forme retning og rammer for AI‑engagement i Nykredit, hvor du får en unik mulighed for – i samarbejde med HR - at præge, hvordan hele organisationen tager AI til sig i praksis.

Du vil få en bred kontaktflade, arbejde tæt med ledergrupper, strategiske funktioner som HR og Kommunikation samt med kollegaer i både forretning og stabe.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Samle og lede et team af AI engagement-konsulenter og mere tekniske faglige profiler.
  • Facilitere strategiske dialoger med ledelse, HR, Kommunikation og øvrige nøglepersoner om retning, prioritering og organisatorisk udvikling.
  • Sikre sammenhæng på tværs af kommunikation, træning og retningslinjer, så organisationen opmuntres til at opbygge kompetencer og anvende AI ansvarligt med forståelse for risici og faldgruber.
  • Sætte strategisk retning for, hvordan Nykredit ibrugtager brede AI værktøjer, herunder hvilke værktøjer der skal anvendes, og af hvem.
  • Udvikle og videreudbygge et samlet engagement‑framework, inkl. modenhedsmodeller, målinger og principper
  • Drive adoption af Copilot og andre AI‑værktøjer gennem strukturerede dialoger, træningsprogrammer og implementeringsindsatser
  • Planlægge og gennemføre kommunikationsindsatser såvel som træning på flere niveauer.
  • Være en central formidler, der kan oversætte AI‑potentiale, risici og ændringer til klare budskaber og praktiske handlinger.
  • Eje de brede AI-værktøjer og governance her for, således at koncernens brug af AI understøttes af både nye muligheder og sikkerhed i anvendelsen.
  • Indsamle og omsætte feedback fra organisationen, så AI‑indsatsen løbende udvikles og skaber dokumenteret effekt.

**Er det dig, vi leder efter?
**Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og kommer med betydelig erfaring fra større transformations‑, digitaliserings- eller AI‑initiativer i komplekse organisationer. Du har arbejdet med organisatorisk forandring i skala og har forståelse for, hvordan man driver varig adfærdsændring på tværs af ledelseslag, forretning, IT og stabe. Samtidig har du en solid forståelse for AI som drivkraft for forandring og kan oversætte tekniske muligheder og risici til klare organisatoriske valg og prioriteringer.

Du trives i roller, hvor retningen ikke er givet på forhånd, og du har et naturligt ejerskab, solide konceptuelle evner og formår at skabe klarhed og retning i komplekse landskaber. Samtidig er du en dygtig kommunikator og facilitator, der kan engagere både ledere og medarbejdere og skabe forståelse, energi og alignment omkring AI‑agendaen. Du motiveres af selv at være på banen som spillende træner – og ser det som en styrke at være tæt på den teknologiske udvikling, træningsindsatserne og dine medarbejdere i den praktiske udmøntning af engagement arbejdet. Som person er du relationelt dygtig, nysgerrig og motiveres af at bygge noget nyt op i tæt samarbejde med andre.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

**Dit nye team
**I Nykredit er der fuld fokus på digitalisering, AI og automatisering. Hos os bliver du en del af et tværgående team bestående af mere end 25 kolleger, som brænder for at drive AI- og new tech-agendaen frem i Nykredit. Vi tilbyder en inspirerende arbejdskultur, hvor der er plads til alle og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig og tage øget ansvar i takt hermed. Høj performance, sammenhold og humor er vigtigt for os - og for dig.

**Vil du vide mere?
**Du er velkommen til at kontakte, Head of Intelligent Automation, AI CoE Josephine Müller på tlf. 24 77 77 09, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Ansøgningsfrist

12.10.2026

By

Nordhavn

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

title: Bliv privatkundechef i Lokalbank København, Danmarks største lokalbank
description:
Motiveres du af at sætte retning, fortsætte udbygningen af Nykredits og Spar Nords solide position i Storkøbenhavn, samt fastholde et højt engagement blandt vores dygtige medarbejdere? Og vil du lede et team af privatrådgivere og privatrådgivere - ejerleder, der gør drømme til virkelighed og giver flere muligheden for at bidrage til et grønnere Danmark? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som privatkundechef.

Du inspirerer og udvikler
Du har det daglige ledelsesansvar for et engageret privatteam på 12 medarbejdere. Du refererer til lokalbankdirektøren, men indgår i en samlet ledergruppe på otte. Vi sætter sammen retning for medarbejdere, udøver salgsledelse og følger op på den enkeltes performance. Samtidig skaber du gode rammer og mange muligheder for, at den enkelte kan udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Gennem effektiv ledelse og resultatskabende evner, med fokus på fælles mål, sikrer du tilfredse kunder, så Nykredits og Spar Nords position styrkes.

Dine ansvarsområder bliver at:

  • Håndtere den daglige ledelse i sammenspil med lokalbankdirektøren og den øvrige ledergruppe.
  • Tiltrække og fastholde boligbankkunder – herunder mindre erhvervskunder.
  • Sikre enhedens forretningsmæssige udvikling.
  • Sikre høj arbejdsglæde.
  • Varetage forandringsledelse ved at sætte retning og skabe engagement.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?
Vi forestiller os, at du har ledelseserfaring med bankfaglig baggrund. Du motiveres af at udvikle mennesker og er klar på at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med resten af lederholdet, hvis fælles mål er at være de dygtigste til det, vi gør. Gennem holdånd, gejst og engagement sætter du retning for dit team med fokus på både vækst og udvikling. Dine initiativer udspringer fra din vilje til altid at gøre dit bedste, og du er en inspirator, der motiverer og udvikler dit hold, så alle tager ansvar. Du vækker tillid og er optaget af at opbygge og videreudvikle dit netværk. Du er ambitiøs på dit teams vegne, motiverer, udøver salgsledelse samt følger op på den enkelte medarbejders resultater og præstationer gennem løbende individuel feedback.

Dit nye team
Du bliver en del af Nykredits og Spar Nords største lokalbank, hvor kunderne er det vigtigste. Godt humør, et højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater betyder meget for os. Vi har en frisk og uformel omgangstone og vægter højt, at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde, da vi mener, det er forudsætningen for at kunne nå vores mål.

I Lokalbank København betjener vi både privatkunder og erhvervskunder. Vi er i alt 90 kolleger, herunder 50 i privat, hvor du som privatkundechef har ledelsesansvaret for et af fire privatteam. Vi lægger vægt på at bruge vores forskellige evner til at udvikle hele holdet samt sikre en god holdånd og et altid godt humør. Du har store muligheder for at sætte et solidt præg på Lokalbank Københavns udvikling. Du vil få en rolle i forhold til at tegne banken udadtil – både overfor eksisterende og nye kunder samt øvrige vigtige samarbejdspartnere.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, lokalbankdirektør Michael Sonne på tlf. 61 56 56 81, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

title: Product Specialist
description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omni-channel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis—our operating platform unifying a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services—to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins.
With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and more—premier home and outdoor banners that double as real-world innovation hubs. CSC Generation continues to grow through M&A, revitalizing companies with strong brand recognition and loyal customers.
As a Product Speicalist, you’ll be the go-to sales and service contact for customers and trade partners interested in our furniture and collections, turning inquiries into confident purchases through expert, design-forward guidance. In this role, you’ll manage inbound and outbound touchpoints, support custom and project-based needs, collaborate with marketing and operations, and use CRM tools to nurture relationships, drive repeat business, and deliver a seamless end-to-end customer experience.
This position will report into the Customer Service Lead.

What you’ll do every day:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound customer inquiries, purchase calls, and product questions related to Euro Style’s furniture and collections.
  • Guide customers through the buying process by providing expert product knowledge, design-forward recommendations, and comparisons that help close sales.
  • Support trade clients, interior designers, and high-value customers with personalized service and project-based needs.
  • Manage custom orders, special pricing requests, and order status updates to deliver a seamless end-to-end customer experience.
  • Proactively follow up on inbound leads, abandoned quotes, and past purchasers to drive repeat business and incremental revenue.
  • Conduct targeted outbound outreach to nurture relationships, re-engage customers, and upsell or cross-sell complementary products.
  • Partner with marketing to support promotions, launches, and campaigns, ensuring consistent messaging and strong conversion.
  • Coordinate with operations and logistics to track priority orders, resolve delivery questions, and escalate issues or claims as needed.
  • Participate in product launches, trainings, and industry events to stay current on the assortment and strengthen customer credibility.

What you bring to the role:

  • Proven ability to build trust quickly and convert inbound customer interest into closed sales.
  • Strong consultative selling and communication skills, with a customer-first mindset and attention to detail.
  • Experience handling custom orders, pricing discussions, and complex product questions.
  • A proactive approach to driving revenue through follow-ups, outreach, and relationship management.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, and logistics teams to resolve issues and improve outcomes.
  • Experience using CRM tools to track customer interactions, manage pipelines, and prioritize outreach.
  • An interest in furniture, design, or home furnishings, with the ability to translate product features into customer value.

What’s in it for you? Joining our team isn’t just about having a seat at the table—it’s about helping redesign the table entirely. You’ll be challenged, stretched, and supported as you grow faster than you thought possible. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer:

  • Executive Access: Work directly with brand CEOs and senior leadership, solving real business problems and earning mentorship from top operators.
  • AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with the most advanced AI tools in the market. From automation to prompt engineering, you’ll build a modern tech stack that sets you apart in any industry.
  • Accelerated Career Path: High performers are quickly entrusted with greater responsibility, new challenges, and leadership opportunities across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive benefits:Paid time off policies, 401(k)/RRSP match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts at our portfolio companies

What our interview process looks like:

  • 📞 Step 1: If you align with our vision and meet the qualifications, we’ll reach out to schedule a conversation and introduce Euro Style.
  • 🧠 Step 2: You’ll complete a short AI or product-building challenge so we can understand how you approach problems and execution.
  • 💬 Step 3: Participate in deep-dive interviews with leadership focused on your experience, product mindset, and operational thinking.
  • 📩 Step 4: Offer. We’ll move fast for the right candidate.
For US-based candidates, this posting is intended for candidates that reside in the following states:
AZ, DE, FL, GA, IN, LA, MI, MS, MO, NV, NC, OK, PA, TN, TX, UT, WV, WI, and WY.
Our preference is for candidates who reside near our hubs in Northwest Indiana, Austin, Texas, and Toronto, Ontario.

Job Summary

IPA Peru is seeking a Research Analyst to support the Household Registration (SISFOH): Process Improvement Piloting Project, in coordination with the Social Targeting and Information Office (OFIS). The project is part of the Peru Social program, co-financed by the European Union and German development cooperation (GIZ), and aims to strengthen the social registry system through piloting and validating methodological and operational improvements in districts of Lima and Trujillo. The Research Analyst will support the programming and testing of the digital data collection tool and monitor data quality throughout the piloting and enumeration phases.

Responsibilities

Data Collection Supervision and Tool Development (40%)

  • Supervise and monitor data collection activities across the piloting and enumeration phases to ensure data quality and adherence to IPA protocols.
  • Run high-frequency checks (HFC) to identify and flag data quality issues in real time.
  • Co-design and test research instruments and the digital data collection tool in SurveyCTO, incorporating adjustments identified during piloting.
  • Support the delivery of field training sessions on instrument application, ethical protocols, and data quality standards.

Quantitative Data Processing and Analysis (30%)

  • Clean, organize, and analyze quantitative databases using statistical software such as R or Stata.
  • Generate data visualizations and descriptive analyses to detect inconsistencies and inform operational decisions during fieldwork.
  • Support the interpretation of results and the drafting of reports in English and Spanish.

Coordination with Administration, Finance, Field Team, Partners, and Stakeholders (20%)

  • Coordinate with IPA's administrative, human resources, and finance teams to ensure compliance with protocols throughout the project cycle.
  • Communicate regularly with the Social Targeting and Information Office (OFIS) and the Local Registration Units (ULE) to align on operational planning and implementation timelines.
  • Process timely requests related to field equipment procurement, payments, and other operational needs.

Synthesizing Evidence and Lessons Learned (10%)

  • Conduct literature reviews and synthesize findings to support research design, intervention development, and contextual analysis.
  • Contribute to the documentation of methodological and operational lessons learned, informing recommendations for national scale-up of the piloted improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Education, Psychology, Sociology, Public Policy, Statistics, or a related social science field.
  • Experience monitoring field data collection, including high-frequency checks (HFC), back-checks, and other real-time data quality monitoring procedures.
  • Experience identifying and resolving field-level implementation issues quickly and independently.
  • Quantitative skills and experience managing and analyzing data in Stata, R, or Python.
  • Familiarity with survey programming software, such as SurveyCTO, including experience testing instruments ahead of field deployment.
  • Understanding of fundamental principles of statistics and econometrics.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in Spanish; working proficiency in English for reporting purposes.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with field teams, supervisors, colleagues, and government partners.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Experience supervising large-scale field teams (enumerators, supervisors, or auditors) in urban contexts (preferred).
  • Experience coordinating with government partners or international organizations (preferred).
  • Experience working on social protection or social registry projects (preferred).
  • Experience supporting impact evaluations or randomized controlled trials (RCTs) (preferred).

Location

The position is based in IPA Peru's office in Lima, with field travel to piloting sites in Lima and Trujillo required to supervise data collection activities. No additional travel, physical, or work-environment requirements were specified in the source vacancy form.

Reports To

Associate Research Manager

Deadline to apply: October 18

About IPA

Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA) is a research and policy nonprofit that discovers and advances what works to improve the lives of people living in poverty. IPA brings together researchers and decision-makers to design, rigorously evaluate, and refine these solutions and their applications, ensuring that the evidence created is used to improve the lives of people living in poverty. In recent decades, trillions of dollars have been spent on programs designed to reduce global poverty, but clear evidence of which programs succeed is rare, and when evidence does exist, decision-makers often do not know about it. IPA exists to bring together leading researchers and these decision-makers to ensure that the evidence we create leads to a tangible impact on the world. Since its founding in 2002, IPA has worked with over 600 leading academics to conduct over 1,000 evaluations in 52 countries. This research has informed hundreds of successful programs that now impact millions of individuals worldwide.

Safeguarding at IPA

At Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA), we are committed to creating a safe and respectful environment for all individuals, particularly children and vulnerable adults. As IPA adheres to strict safeguarding principles, selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards. By joining IPA, you become part of a team dedicated to ethical conduct, social responsibility, and meaningful impact in the fight against global poverty. Together, we work to create a better world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive with dignity and respect.

title: Vil du starte en karriere i Equity Trading i Nykredit Markets?
description:
Equity Trading i Nykredit Markets har ansvaret for handel med danske og internationale aktier, investeringsforeninger og ETF'er. Som market maker i danske investeringsforeninger sikrer vi likviditet ved at stille priser på Nasdaq og handle med både danske og internationale markedsdeltagere.

Vi udvider nu teamet og søger en ny kollega til en spændende entry-level stilling. Rollen er ideel for dig, der ønsker at starte en karriere inden for trading og få hands-on erfaring i et professionelt og dynamisk handelsmiljø.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Opnå omfattende forståelse for de danske og globale aktie- og ETF-markeder, herunder særligt noterede og unoterede investeringsforeninger fra et trading perspektiv.
  • Få indsigt i den proces, der driver det rigtige beslutningsgrundlag, når der dagligt handles i ovennævnte markeder, og opnå indblik i bagvedliggende handels- og kapitalmarkedsrelateret regulering/lovgivning.
  • Have tæt samarbejde med øvrige enheder i Markets og på tværs af organisationen – herunder rådgivende- og porteføljeenheder.
  • Medansvar for optimering af systemopsætning og implementering af handelsinfrastruktur.
  • Efter onboarding og introforløb, mere selvstændigt ansvar for håndtering af positioner, risikostyring og handelsstrategier.
  • Du vil i løbet af det første år skulle gennemføre Finans Danmarks CMD-license, som er et krav i denne stilling.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

  • Du udviser stort engagement for trading særligt indenfor aktie- og ETF handel.
  • Du har demonstrerbar interesse for de relevante finansielle produkter og markeder og har desuden gerne interesse for systemopsætning/optimering, heriblandt trading-platforme.
  • Relevant akademisk baggrund, cand.merc.(fir/mat), cand.polit. eller lignende kvantitativt/finansielt studie, med basal forståelse af statistik, investering, finansiering og makroøkonomi.
  • Du har en robust og målrettet personlighed, kan håndtere flere opgaver parallelt og arbejder struktureret under pres.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

**Dit nye team
**Equity Trading området er struktureret med 3 trading-teams på tværs af syv medarbejdere - Equity Execution, Market Making og Institutional/Funds Trading. Equity Trading håndterer flows fra retail kunder, professionelle kunder, kapitalforvaltere og modpartsbanker. Du vil blive involveret i alle processer på tværs af teams, og du vil indledningsvist primært blive tilknyttet Funds Trading. Der er stor grad af vidensdeling og koordinering på tværs, og du vil opleve en stejl læringskurve inden for eksekvering og risikostyring af ovennævnte produkter, hvor du får hands-on erfaring og en konkret udviklingsplan for at lære at handle aktierelaterede produkter.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Praktisk om forløbet:

  • Vi holder løbende samtaler.
  • Ansøgningsfrist er senest 23. oktober 2026 eller indtil en kandidat er fundet.
  • Har du påbegyndt job, men synes, at dette lyder som en unik mulighed, hører vi også gerne fra kandidater relevant erhvervserfaring.

**Vil du vide mere?
**Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Troels Carlsen på tlf. 44 55 18 27, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

title: Full Satck Engineer
description:
**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

  • Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.
  • Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.
  • Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.
  • Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.
  • Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.
  • Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.
  • Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

  • First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.
  • First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.
  • Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.
  • Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.
  • Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.
  • Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

  • Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.
  • Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.
  • Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.
  • Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.
  • Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.
  • Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

  • Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React
  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data
  • Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review
  • Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs
  • Some exposure to automated testing
  • Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not
  • Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

  • The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.
  • What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation
  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan
  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us
  • Flexible remote work
  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities
  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe
  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

title: Head of Consumer Product Licensing - North America
description:
About Seminal

Seminal Artist Group is the world's first label dedicated to visual artists. We identify and develop artists' practices, helping them transform their work into products that forge deep, personal, and emotive connections with fans worldwide. With offices and partners across more than 20 countries, Seminal unlocks the global earning power of art by connecting today's most compelling visual artists to the world's leading brands, retailers, and manufacturers.

Our team spans Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Korea, Japan, Singapore, India, Sri Lanka, and beyond. We move fast, think globally, and operate at the intersection of art, culture, commerce, and technology.

Seminal is a technology-driven company. Data sits at the core of how we operate, make decisions, and grow. From artist analytics to licensing performance to global market intelligence, we run on information and the people who know how to use it.

The Role

We are looking for a highly motivated, commercially driven, and entrepreneurial Head of Consumer Product Licensing - North America to lead Seminal's consumer products licensing business across the region. This role is responsible for building new licensing revenue across categories, developing relationships with leading licensees and retailers, and expanding the reach of Seminal's growing catalogue of artists and artworks across North America, Canada, and Latin America.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine strategic thinking with direct sales execution. The successful candidate will work across manufacturers, retailers, agencies, and internal teams to identify opportunities, build partnerships, develop market strategies, and represent Seminal in the region. Over time, the role will also build and lead a broader licensing team as the business scales.

Reporting

Reports to the Global Head of Licensing & Partnerships and works closely with the Founder & CEO, regional sales and creative teams, and other key internal stakeholders across Seminal.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver new business across consumer product categories through both manufacturers and direct-to-retail relationships.
  • Work with the Global Head of Licensing & Partnerships and the Founder & CEO to identify global and regional licensing opportunities.
  • Use existing industry relationships to promote the benefits and capabilities of the Seminal platform and identify new sales opportunities domestically and internationally.
  • Develop and refine strategies to grow and diversify Seminal's artwork licensing business.
  • Lead the development, management, and motivation of licensing agency partnerships.
  • Identify new agent and referral opportunities where additional market coverage is required.
  • As the business scales, recruit and build a licensing team capable of servicing agencies and licensees directly.
  • Act as a Seminal ambassador in the region and identify opportunities to raise the profile of the company, its licensing platform, and the value of art within licensing.
  • Conduct strategic technology, market, and business research and develop recommendations in close collaboration with internal colleagues and external service providers.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to develop marketing materials, sales tools, and presentations that support agency and direct sales activity.
  • Attend relevant trade events, conferences, and client meetings domestically and internationally while operating within agreed budgets.
  • Provide clear reports, presentations, and communications so the management team remains informed of significant licensing activity, opportunities, and developments.

Skills

Commercial & Licensing Skills

  • Deep knowledge of the licensing landscape, ecosystem, market trends, and key industry participants.
  • Strong new-business development capability across third-party licensing and direct-to-retail opportunities.
  • Excellent negotiation, deal interpretation, commercial analysis, and revenue/profit modelling skills.
  • Ability to develop licensing strategies and translate them into practical commercial execution.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with licensees, retailers, agencies, and senior decision-makers.

Leadership & Execution Skills

  • Entrepreneurial, self-directed, and comfortable operating with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Hands-on leadership style with a willingness to lead from the front in sales and partner development.
  • Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, including the confidence to represent Seminal at industry forums, conferences, and partner meetings.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, languages, backgrounds, and global time zones.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of IP licensing experience with a demonstrable record of delivering third-party and direct licensing deals.
  • Demonstrated success building and leading licensing partnership programs.
  • Established relationships with in-market professionals and key decision-makers across the U.S. licensing ecosystem.
  • Ability to travel for trade shows, conferences, partner meetings, and other business requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Available to work full-time and able to start immediately or as soon as practicable.
  • Legally authorized to live and work in the United States.

Highly Valued

  • Experience across multiple consumer product categories such as fashion, CPG, homewares, toys, collectibles, beauty, gaming, entertainment, and publishing.
  • Experience managing licensing agencies or agent networks.
  • Experience building or scaling a regional licensing team.
  • Experience working in a technology-enabled licensing, creative, media, or consumer products business.
  • International licensing experience across North America, Canada, Latin America, or broader global markets.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Commercially ambitious and motivated by building a licensing business, not simply maintaining existing accounts.
  • Brings an established industry network and knows how to turn relationships into new opportunities.
  • Can move comfortably between strategy, partner management, direct sales, and detailed execution.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, complex partner ecosystem and takes ownership without requiring heavy structure.
  • Is excited by art, technology, consumer products, and the opportunity to expand how visual artists participate in global licensing.

title: Machine Learning Scientist - AppleCare WW Demand Planning
description:
Imagine what you could do here! The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they build the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. At Apple, inclusion is a shared responsibility, and we work together to develop a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

At Apple, the customer experience doesn't end with a purchase; that is just the beginning. The Worldwide Demand Planning team ensures service continuity across every channel. We forecast the inventory needed to support customers everywhere—whether they visit an Apple Store, mail in a device, or seek help through our external Carrier and Insurance partners. Our scope spans across whole unit devices, repairable parts such as battery or display, packaging, and tools required for repair. We ensure the right forecast for parts is in place at our warehouses, Retail stores, and thousands of Service Providers worldwide.

We are expanding our technical capabilities and seeking a Machine Learning Scientist to help us operationalize and scale our forecasting models. You will join a diverse team of data scientists and planners, bringing the specific engineering rigor needed to turn complex analyses into robust, self-improving production systems. Your work will enable the team to move faster and deploy models that directly impact resource availability for millions of customers. Join us to build the infrastructure that powers the heartbeat of AppleCare.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field with 3+ years of industry experience in deploying Machine Learning models OR Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with 3+ years of industry experience in deploying Machine Learning models.
  • Applied Machine Learning: Practical experience creating and deploying models in real-world environments, with specific expertise in Time Series forecasting, Anomaly Detection, or Optimization.
  • Software Engineering Proficiency: Expert proficiency in Python, with a strong grasp of software design principles (Object-Oriented Design), data structures, and writing testable, maintainable code beyond just scripting.
  • Data Systems: Expert-level SQL skills and experience working with large-scale distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., modern cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, Oracle, Spark, Hadoop, etc.).
  • Communication: Superior ability to translate meticulous mathematical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production Engineering: Proven experience taking models from research prototypes to production systems (using CI/CD, APIs, and containerization).
  • Creative Modeling: Ability to engineer novel features and apply advanced Time Series or ML techniques to solve complex demand challenges.
  • Business Insight: Proficiency in translating raw data into compelling narratives that drive strategic business decisions.
  • Mentorship: Proven track record of up-skilling teammates, bridging the gap between statistical analysis and software engineering.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Backend
description:
The Cari Network is building a blockchain-based payment system powering real-time, 24/7 movement of digital money across the traditional finance and digital asset ecosystems. A pre-launch startup, we’re creating an entirely new category of financial infrastructure that brings cash on chain through tokenization while powering the full spectrum of payments for our network—banks, digital asset exchanges, and, most importantly, the customers they serve.

About the Role

You’ll own core transaction processing platform infrastructure that our banking and blockchain services both build on—the durable workflow and ordering layer that keeps financial operations correct under concurrency.

You’ll be the trusted technical decision-maker for the services you own—defining what production-ready looks like, leading incident response when something breaks, and writing the design docs that other engineers, including ones outside your immediate team, build against.

What You’ll Do

  • Own our transaction processing platform infrastructure for signing and settlement flows—service design, correctness guarantees, and operational health
  • Own the transaction-ordering and concurrency-control logic that keeps our transaction processing platform correct and consistent at scale
  • Design data models, API contracts, and retry/backoff logic for the services you own; write RFCs that Banking and Blockchain engineers rely on when integrating against your services
  • Define what "production-ready" means for platform services you own: SLOs, alerting thresholds, and runbooks
  • Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for the services in your domain, and drive postmortems that prevent recurrence
  • Reason about consistency models, failure modes, and capacity for the systems you own, and flag architectural risk before it becomes an incident

Salg og salgsmøder med egen kundeportefølje

Vi sætter en ære i at yde god service, ekspedition og rådgivning til alle vores kunder, og klarer en travl hverdag med et godt humør – det forventer vi også af dig.

Teamplayer med drive og bred faglighed

For at få succes i dette job er det essentielt at du:

  • Har erfaring med salg primært rettet mod B2B.
  • Har god kæde- og forretningsforståelse med brancheerfaring og/eller produktkendskab.

  • Opretholder en kundefokuseret attitude.
  • Håndterer en bred vifte af forskellige kontakter.

  • Skaber struktur og overblik.
  • Tager en aktiv og deltagende rolle i teamet.

”Jeg er vild med vores strategi, fordi den klare røde tråd gør det nemmere for mig, hver dag, at give kunderne en god oplevelse, når de handler i forretningen”, siger Carsten Lund, medarbejder i STARK

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende, så jo før du sender din ansøgning, jo bedre er dine muligheder. Send din ansøgning senest den 15. oktober 2026 ved at benytte linket ”Ansøg”. Har du spørgsmål inden da, så kontakt meget gerne Salgschef Tina Uglebjerg på tlf. 21 36 07 99

Tiltrædelse er snarest mulig.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Branch Manager Per Wendell Ranfelt på telefon +45 28108750.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 85 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.500 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats.

The Care Giver/Med Tech role includes providing hands-on care, physical and emotional support to each resident while maintaining a safe and comfortable home-like environment.

Responsibilities:

Care Giver:

  • Responsible for a designated group of residents during the shift; knows where their residents are and physically checks on them throughout the shift.
  • Observes, reports and documents symptoms and conditions of residents for changes in condition such as skin, behavior, alertness, weight, dietary and participation in activities.
  • Responds to security system and resident call bells promptly.
  • Notifies supervisor and/or Health Care Coordinator if a resident has increased care needs.
  • Assists with continence management and disposes of all continence products properly to ensure sanitation of resident suite and community restrooms.
  • Serves and collects food trays and assists as needed; reports refusal of meals or loss of appetite.
  • Maintains cleanliness of resident’s room and work areas.
  • Practices good standard care precautions of cleanliness, hygiene and health.
  • Helps residents maintain independence, promotes dignity and physical safety of each resident.
  • Actively participates/leads and assists residents with activities of daily living (i.e. bathing, dressing, toileting, grooming, ambulation, transferring, eating) as instructed.
  • Engages residents in life skills and other life enrichment activities.
  • Greets and assists all internal and external customers, guests, family members, residents, vendors and team members.
  • Does resident laundry as assigned and needed.

Medication Tech duties:

  • Reviews service plan to learn pertinent information about residents.
  • Assists/observes medications and treatments for each resident using the medication observation record and the Six Rights of Medication Pass.
  • Documents and initials form as medications are given including appropriate documentation for refusal or missed doses.
  • Maintains confidentiality of all resident information including resident medication.
  • Reports all resident concerns made while assisting resident with the medication to the Nurse and/or Health Care Coordinator (HCC).
  • Restocks medication cart after all medication passes.
  • Assists in checking medication regardless of packaging system.
  • Counts all narcotics with another Medication Care Manager or Nurse each shift.
  • Maintains and cleans the Medication Room, med charts, treatment carts for neatness cleanliness, availability of medications and expired medications.
  • Follows re-fill process for medications.
  • Participates in the development of the Service Plan and monthly updates.
  • Takes and records temperature, blood pressure, weight, pulse and respiration rates.
  • Reports occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, sharp sticks and hazardous chemicals immediately.
  • Other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.

Qualifications:

  • Certified Nurse’s Aid certification preferred.
  • High School diploma/GED
  • Must be 18 years of age.
  • CPR Certification preferred
  • First Aid Certification preferred
  • Previous experience working with seniors preferred.

title: Staff Software Engineer — Backend
description:
The Cari Network is building a blockchain-based payment system powering real-time, 24/7 movement of digital money across the traditional finance and digital asset ecosystems. A pre-launch startup, we’re creating an entirely new category of financial infrastructure that brings cash on chain through tokenization while powering the full spectrum of payments for our network—banks, digital asset exchanges, and, most importantly, the customers they serve.

About the Role

You’ll set technical direction for the platform infrastructure that our Banking and Blockchain engineering teams both build on—durable workflow orchestration, transaction-ordering guarantees, and the shared architectural patterns that keep two fast-moving product teams from quietly reinventing the same infrastructure twice. This is a cross-team role: your decisions constrain and enable how both teams design their own services.

You’ll have deep expertise in at least one area the org draws on—most likely distributed transaction ordering, durable workflow systems, or data-consistency guarantees for financial flows—and you’ll be the person other senior and staff engineers escalates to when a cross-service design question doesn’t have an obvious owner.

What You’ll Do

Set the technical direction for cross-cutting backend platform infrastructure: durable workflow orchestration (Restate), transaction-ordering and concurrency-control patterns, and the shared primitives Banking and Blockchain services build on

Design systems that span multiple services—data flow across the platform, migration strategies for live systems, and versioning strategy for shared infrastructure APIs

Establish reliability standards that apply across services, not just your own: load testing profiles, deployment safety gates, and the failure-mode analysis that should happen before launch, not after

Multiply the team's impact through systems, not just review: build the tooling, templates, and enforced standards (shared CI patterns, reusable service scaffolding, common observability conventions) that reduce process overhead org-wide

Align multiple engineering teams on shared technical direction—this means building consensus, not just publishing a decision

Represent backend platform engineering in cross-org technical planning, and flag architectural risk before it becomes another team's incident

Qualifications

8–10+ years of backend software engineering experience, including a track record of setting technical direction across multiple services or teams, not just owning your own

title: Network Software Engineer
description:
Description

Do you love to develop creative and impactful communications and networked systems solutions for the nation's most critical challenges?

Are you searching for meaningful work in software engineering?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking an experienced Network Software Engineer to help us solve the nation's security challenges. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and test of communications and network software, including protocol implementation, network services, and distributed systems for the Government across numerous departments and agencies. Our solutions need to be able to operate in a timely and reliable manner in degraded or contested environments, ranging from integration or adoption of existing solutions to first-of-their-kind capabilities. Ultimately, you will join a team whose goal is to build meaningful capabilities to enable the availability of information to decision makers and warfighters under challenging conditions.

You will be joining a hardworking team of engineers and scientists who are passionate about building creative and novel communication systems. Our team is committed to national security. We strive to cultivate an environment that promotes professional growth and a balanced life. We value the exchange of different thoughts and ideas.

As a Network Software Engineer, your primary responsibilities will be to:

  • Provide technical contributions and leadership in the development of software systems as part of critical communications systems for the Government.
  • Provide thought leadership in the areas of communications systems and application software development by teaming with colleagues to propose creative approaches and new concepts to address hard problems.
  • Architect, develop, integrate, and test software-based command and control, secure communication, and networking systems in operationally-realistic environments, working closely with sponsors to ensure mission success.
  • Interact with technical specialists in other fields as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Detail work in technical reports and memoranda and present work to sponsors and the technical community.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals and experience with networking concepts to understand performance tradeoffs of networked systems and systems of systems.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you have...

  • A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or another related technical discipline.
  • At least five years of relevant experience in the development of software systems, ideally in a Linux environment.
  • A strong understanding of networking fundamentals (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS).
  • Demonstrated skill with software development following current software engineering best practices using several of the following languages: C, C++, Python, Rust, and BASH scripting.
  • Experience devising approaches and using tools to debug networked systems (e.g., tcpdump, Wireshark, netstat, ss).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, work independently, and work in a multi-organizational team.
  • Willingness and ability to travel on an as needed basis.
  • Are able to obtain an Interim Top Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you have...

  • A Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or another related, technical discipline.
  • At least twenty years of relevant experience in the development of software systems.
  • Experience leading software projects and managing teams of engineers.
  • Exposure to US Government and military communication systems and network technologies, voice and video streaming, or conferencing software.
  • Experience implementing or adapting network protocols (application, transport, routing, or custom protocols).
  • Deep knowledge of Linux networking internals (kernel stack, netfilter, eBPF, XDP).
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting real‑time, low-latency, or high‑bandwidth systems.
  • Experience with container networking and orchestration (Kubernetes, CNI plugins, service meshes).
  • Familiarity with software‑defined networking (SDN) and network function virtualization (NFV).
  • Experience and passion for DevOps practices, processes, and tools.
  • Experience applying software expertise to full project lifecycles, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, and testing.
  • An active Top Secret security clearance with SSBI and have recently been adjudicated for access to Sensitive Compartmented Information.

title: Community TelePrEP Navigator
description:
The Community TelePrEP Navigator serves as a trusted community-based resource supporting individuals in accessing HIV prevention services through the Philadelphia TelePrEP Program. The Navigator provides PrEP education, community outreach, telehealth navigation, client follow-up, and connection to supportive services. The position will also support implementation research activities for the STEP-UP (Streamlining Telehealth for Equitable PrEP Utilization through Community Partnerships) study.


The Navigator will work closely with organizational staff, healthcare providers, the Philadelphia TelePrEP Program, and the STEP-UP research team to reduce barriers to PrEP access and strengthen community-based HIV prevention.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Community Outreach & PrEP Education

  • Conduct community outreach and promote awareness of PrEP and TelePrEP services.
  • Provide culturally responsive PrEP education and answer questions about accessing PrEP.
  • Explain the Philadelphia TelePrEP Program and available COLOURS support.
  • Engage clients in a welcoming, confidential, and nonjudgmental manner.

TelePrEP Navigation

  • Assist clients with scheduling TelePrEP appointments.
  • Help clients access technology and private space for telehealth appointments when needed.
  • Assist clients with navigating laboratory testing through Labcorp/Quest, or applicable self-sampling options.
  • Identify barriers to accessing PrEP and connect clients with appropriate supportive resources.
  • Follow up with clients after TelePrEP appointments and assist with next steps.

STEP-UP Research Support

  • Invite eligible clients to participate in required surveys and provide survey invitation information.
  • Complete Outreach, Navigation, and Time-Activity Cost Logs accurately and on time.
  • Maintain organized program and research documentation while protecting client confidentiality.
  • Communicate implementation questions or challenges to the designated research team.

Supervision & Collaboration

  • Report to the designated COLOURS supervisor and participate in regular check-ins.
  • Communicate with the Philadelphia TelePrEP Program and STEP-UP research team as needed.
  • Participate in required training, meetings, outreach events, and program activities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in community outreach, health education, HIV prevention, healthcare navigation, or a related field preferred.
  • Preferred candidate – High School Diploma or GED;
  • Clinical experience with HIV prevention and harm reduction strategies;
  • Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills;
  • Comfortable using computers, telehealth platforms, email, and electronic documentation systems.
  • Demonstrates understanding of the cultural and ethnic diversity of sexual and gender minority people of color;
  • Ability to multi-task;
  • Willingness to travel to partnering agencies, client appointments, boards and committees that support program outcomes
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and accurate records.
  • Reliable, organized, self-directed, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Lived experience and/or strong knowledge of Philadelphia communities disproportionately affected by HIV is highly valued.
  • Willing to work evening weekends, Flexibility is a must

title: Metsäasiantuntija Länsi-Lappi
description:
Tule kanssamme kasvattamaan huomista! Me Metsähallituksessa käytämme, hoidamme ja suojelemme valtion maa- ja vesialueita kestävästi. Me luomme mahdollisuuksia vastuulliselle liiketoiminnalle, tuotamme kestävästi hoidetuista metsistä uusiutuvaa raaka-ainetta sekä tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia nauttia luonnosta retkeillen ja eräillen. Miljoonat ihmiset saavat työstämme iloa, terveyttä ja hyvinvointia. Meidän tehtävämme on merkityksellinen ja vastuullinen, ja sen eteen työskentelemme joka päivä arvojemme mukaisesti. Metsähallituksessa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja edistämme yhdenvertaisuutta työyhteisössämme sekä kannustamme monenlaisista taustoista tulevia hakemaan meille töihin. Meitä on lähes tuhat ympäri Suomen, liity osaksi monimuotoista joukkoamme!

Haemme nyt joukkoomme metsäasiantuntijaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Metsähallitus Metsätalous Oy:n Länsi-Lapin metsätiimiin. Tehtävässa aloitus on 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

Metsäasiantuntijana tehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuoliset metsätalouden suunnittelutyöt, kuten puunkorjuu-, metsänhoito- ja luonnonhoitotöiden suunnittelu sekä oman vastuualueesi metsäautotieverkoston ylläpito. Tehtävässä keskeistä on metsien eri käyttömuotojen yhteensovittaminen ja uusimpien suunnittelumenetelmien hyödyntäminen. Toimipaikkana tehtävässä on Kittilä tai Pello.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää soveltuvaa metsäalan korkeakoulututkintoa. Työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä ja hyvä tietojärjestelmäosaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Työssä tarvitset myös hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, kehittävää ja itsenäistä työotetta sekä valmiutta maastossa liikkumiseen.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja haastavan tehtäväkuvan yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisessä organisaatiossa, jossa on mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Metsähallituksessa pääset osaksi monimuotoista eri alojen asiantuntijajoukkoa. Työskentelemme monipaikkaisesti ympäri Suomen samat yhteiset arvot jakaen. Arvomme ovat:

-
Ilo

-
Kestävyys

-
Yhteistyö

-
Tuloksellisuus

Tuemme työntekijöiden hyvinvointia tarjoamalla hyvinvointi-, kulttuuri- sekä lounasedun. Palkkaus määräytyy Metsähallituksessa noudatettavan palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti tehtävän vaativuuden ja henkilökohtaisen työsuorituksen perusteella. Työskentelemme joustavalla monipaikkatyömallilla etä- ja lähityön yhdistäen. Työ sisältää matkustamista. Työssäsi tarvitset autoa ja B-ajokorttia.

Täytäthän sähköisen hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 7.10.2026 mennessä.

Pyydämme liittämään mukaan myös CV:si.

title: Pediatrician
location: PanCare Pediatrics, Panama City, FL, US
description:
At PanCare of Florida, our mission is to bring quality healthcare to underserved communities. We believe that compassionate, dedicated healthcare professionals are essential to fulfilling this promise.

Are you a dedicated and detail-oriented Pediatrician looking to make a meaningful impact on patient care? PanCare of Florida is seeking a skilled and compassionate Pediatrician to join our team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring the safe and effective use of medications, working closely with healthcare professionals and patients to optimize treatment outcomes. If you have a passion for patient safety, a keen eye for detail, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we invite you to apply and become a vital part of our mission to provide exceptional healthcare services.

Position Summary:

The Pediatrician provides comprehensive primary and preventive healthcare services to infants, children, adolescents, and young adults in accordance with accepted medical standards and organizational policies. This role is responsible for diagnosing and treating acute and chronic illnesses, promoting preventive health measures, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams to ensure high-quality patient care.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide comprehensive medical evaluations, diagnoses, and treatment plans for pediatric patients from birth through adolescence.
  • Conduct routine wellness visits, physical examinations, and developmental screenings.
  • Diagnose and treat acute illnesses, chronic conditions, and injuries.
  • Prescribe medications and therapies in accordance with applicable laws and medical standards.
  • Order, interpret, and evaluate diagnostic tests and laboratory results.
  • Provide health education and counseling to patients and families regarding preventive care, nutrition, growth, and development.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete medical records within the electronic health record (EHR) system.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and organizational regulations, including HIPAA and applicable healthcare standards.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and peer review activities.
  • Adhere to clinical protocols, policies, and evidence-based practice guidelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing staff, behavioral health providers, dental providers, and other interdisciplinary team members.
  • Refer patients to specialists and coordinate continuity of care as appropriate.
  • Participate in staff meetings, committees, and organizational initiatives as assigned.
  • Foster a compassionate, culturally competent, and patient-centered environment.
  • Meet productivity, quality, and patient satisfaction expectations established by the organization.
  • Support organizational goals related to access to care, quality outcomes, and community health initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support business operations.


Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of pediatric medicine, preventive care, and clinical best practices.
  • Excellent diagnostic and clinical decision-making skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with pediatric patients and families.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment.
  • Proficiency in electronic health records and medical documentation systems.
  • Regular and predictable onsite attendance is required to support business operations.


Education/Experience:

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree from an accredited medical school required.
  • Completion of an accredited Pediatric Residency Program required.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of pediatric clinical experience preferred.
  • Current unrestricted license to practice medicine in the State of Florida required.
  • Board Certification in Pediatrics required.
  • Current DEA registration required.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) and Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) certifications required.


Physical Demands:

  • Ability to sit, stand, bend, and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to perform clinical procedures requiring manual dexterity.
  • Ability to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Works in a clinical healthcare environment with frequent exposure to communicable diseases, bodily fluids, and other healthcare-related hazards.


PanCare provides a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental and vision insurance. In addition, to health coverage, we offer 14 paid holidays and 3 weeks of paid vacation per year. Employees are also eligible to participate in our 403(b) plan with a 6% employer match and 3% base employer contribution.

Join PanCare of Florida and be part of a dedicated team that is committed to delivering high-quality healthcare to our communities. We offer a supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a real difference in the lives of our patients. If you're ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to our mission, we encourage you to apply today. Together, we can continue to improve patient outcomes and build healthier communities.

PanCare of Florida is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity and inclusion are key to our success, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

description:
