🏢 Work Model: 25% Remote

💼 Role: Senior Kafka Platform Engineer – Integration & Cloud

⭐ Seniority: Senior

📅 Assignment Period: 19 October 2026 – 30 September 2027

🕐 Workload: 100%

💼 Visa: Sweden Work Authorization visa is mandatory and no visa sponsorship is available for this role.

⏳ Availability: Immediately/On a short notice

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka Platform Engineer to join one of our consulting assignments in Stockholm.

You will be responsible for building, operating, securing, and continuously improving integration and messaging platform capabilities used by multiple development teams.

The role has a strong focus on Apache Kafka, Strimzi, Kubernetes, HiveMQ, automation, observability, security, and platform operations. You will work with a “you build it – you run it” approach, taking end-to-end responsibility for platform stability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

This is primarily a platform engineering and integration role, rather than a traditional application development position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, operate, and maintain multi-cluster and multi-region Apache Kafka environments using Strimzi on Kubernetes.
  • Manage enterprise HiveMQ MQTT broker environments.
  • Plan and execute Kafka, Strimzi, and HiveMQ upgrades and security patching with minimal or zero application downtime.
  • Develop and maintain custom Kafka Connect Source/Sink connectors for integration between legacy systems and cloud environments.
  • Design Kafka scaling strategies, node affinity, topology spread constraints, persistent storage, and resource allocation for high-volume workloads.
  • Manage Kafka topics, partitions, compaction, retention, segments, and cluster resources.
  • Design and maintain high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions, including cross-region replication and automated failover.
  • Manage Schema Registry and support Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema governance.
  • Design secure ingress and traffic-routing solutions for messaging platforms.
  • Implement Kafka ACLs, SASL authentication, OAuth/OIDC integrations, RBAC, SSL, and mTLS.
  • Build and maintain observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Fluent Bit, and/or OpenTelemetry.
  • Develop proactive monitoring and alerting for infrastructure and Kafka-related issues.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for platform incidents and implement preventative measures.
  • Provide advanced/Tier 3 support for issues including consumer lag, rebalance problems, storage issues, and network bottlenecks.
  • Act as a technical SME for development teams using Java and Spring Boot, providing guidance on Kafka producer/consumer configurations and best practices.
  • Develop reusable GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, configuration, and deployment validation.
  • Use ArgoCD, Helm, Terraform, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to manage platform environments.
  • Implement automated scaling solutions such as KEDA where appropriate.
  • Build developer self-service capabilities for provisioning topics, schemas, credentials, and other platform resources within defined governance and security controls.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, READMEs, and operational guidelines.
  • Take ownership of incident, problem, and change management at platform level.
  • Collaborate with security, architecture, infrastructure, and development teams.

Required Skills & Experience

Kafka & Integration

  • 4–6 years of hands-on experience with Apache Kafka at platform level.
  • Strong experience with Strimzi and Kafka running on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Kafka Connect API and KRaft.
  • Experience with HiveMQ or enterprise MQTT platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Kafka cluster administration, performance, security, scalability, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Schema Registry and Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema.

Cloud & Kubernetes

  • Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Solid Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience with Linux environments, including WSL.
  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud is beneficial.

Java & Application Integration

  • 4–6 years of experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Understanding of Kafka integration patterns and Producer/Consumer configuration.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL.

DevOps & Automation

  • Strong experience with CI/CD using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
  • Experience with ArgoCD.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with Helm and OCI-based artifacts.

Observability

  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Knowledge of Splunk, Fluent Bit, and/or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience designing monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational KPIs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with API Management platforms.
  • Experience across Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud.
  • Cloud cost optimization experience.
  • Experience working within large enterprise integration or platform organizations.
  • Experience with advanced API security and OAuth/OIDC.
  • Swedish language skills.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable taking end-to-end operational responsibility for production platforms.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with development, security, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A humble, collaborative, and continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantage.

Why Join Us?

As a consultant with Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB, you will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging assignments within leading organizations in Sweden.

You will work with modern cloud, integration, messaging, Kubernetes, and DevOps technologies while contributing to platforms that support multiple development teams and business-critical workloads.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Risk Assessment Lead
description:
Role Purpose

The Risk Assessment Lead is accountable for overseeing enterprise risk management for AZPIL, ensuring effective controls, policies, and monitoring mechanisms are in place to protect the organisation from internal and external risk exposure.

The role has end-to-end responsibility for:

  • Internal audit leadership and execution
  • Enterprise risk assessment and maintenance of the risk register
  • Financial controls framework oversight
  • Internal monitoring of high-risk business areas
  • Forensic risk and whistleblowing review support
  • Process excellence, simplification, and automation initiatives

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the enterprise risk agenda by proactively identifying key risks and ensuring appropriate mitigating controls, processes, and governance mechanisms are established.
  • Develop and manage the annual internal audit plan based on risk assessment and periodic refresh of the audit universe.
  • Oversee quarterly internal audits, partnering with external consultants and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion, robust reporting, and effective presentation of findings to Board committees.
  • Track and follow up on remediation actions arising from internal audit reports to ensure timely and sustainable closure.
  • Oversee Business Responsibility & sustainability report (BRSR), partnering with auditors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion, robust reporting.
  • Own and maintain the Risk Register in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, capturing active, emerging, and enduring risks, along with mitigation plans for presentation to governance committees.
  • Own the Financial Controls Framework (FCF) for the India Marketing Company, ensuring alignment with global standards while incorporating additional local controls where required.
  • Independently monitor high-risk areas such as Patient Assistance Programs, diagnostics, and government business supply, ensuring processes are compliant with AstraZeneca standards and control expectations.
  • Partner with Compliance and external advisors on whistleblowing case reviews and forensic risk assessments, ensuring appropriate governance and follow-through.
  • Review new business initiatives at the ideation stage as part of cross-functional teams, identifying risks and recommending mitigation strategies across contracts, SOPs, and business cases.
  • Conduct annual distributor risk assessments for institutional distributors and other high-risk third parties, escalating concerns and recommending corrective actions where needed.
  • Mentor the Process Excellence Lead in developing and executing the annual process audit plan, reviewing audit outcomes, and supporting implementation of action plans.
  • Perform periodic self-reviews of key business processes, including travel bookings, procurement, sponsorships, and meetings, to identify trends, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain regular engagement with Distribution, Government Business, and Compliance teams to strengthen controls, processes, and policy effectiveness.
  • Drive process simplification and automation initiatives, including the use of AI-enabled tools for exception monitoring, iRisk, and SOP centralisation through Master SOP.
  • Monitor usage and reporting of compliance tools related to statutory compliance obligations.
  • Collaborate with business teams on automation projects, such as NRV tool automation, SAP integrations, and other process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and control.

Essential Requirements

  • Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 10+ years of post-qualification experience
  • Strong experience in internal audit, ideally within a regulated industry; pharmaceutical industry experience is preferred but not essential
  • Deep knowledge of financial accounting, internal controls, audit, business processes, and taxation
  • Proven experience in developing financial reports, controls, and performance metrics
  • Strong stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior leadership
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment
  • Consistent demonstration of AstraZeneca Values

Preferred Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of risk leadership, business partnering, governance strength, and transformation mindset. They should be comfortable working at both strategic and operational levels, with the credibility to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders, and drive meaningful improvements in risk and control effectiveness.

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca, we 're dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

Where can I find out more?

  • Our Social Media, Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn
  • Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook

title: Building Official
description:
Building Official

Department of Community Develoment

Makes a daily difference in the Campbell County organization and locality through: hard work, open and honest communication, ongoing improvement and accountability.


Performs with excellence, the following tasks, including but not limited to:

  • Directs the operations of Building Inspections; oversees the collection of fees and issuance of permits.
  • Supervises the inspection of buildings to determine adherence to standards of construction, in all applicable code areas;
  • Determines compliance with handicapped accessibility standards for new construction and existing buildings and structures per building code requirements;
  • Works with State and local Fire Marshal’s offices with plan reviews and periodic inspections of buildings for compliance with applicable fire codes.
  • Assists and coordinates with the Zoning Office, Commissioner of Revenue and other local staff;
  • Provides code books and materials for staff and advises of changes and certain requirements;
  • Exercises supervision over technical and administrative personnel involved with obtaining compliance with established standards;
  • Responsible for making final decisions on technical problems and disputes subject to administrative review by the proper authorities;
  • Maintains adequate and proper records of all actions of the Department as required for code compliance;
  • Assists the Director with administrative duties;
  • Participates in the Project Evaluation Committee;
  • Reviews permit applications and building plans for code compliance and approval;
  • Performs onsite inspections to determine compliance with all applicable codes. Conducts investigations of nonconforming situations and complaints; coordinates with state enforcement officials as needed;
  • Provides technical assistance to departmental personnel, contractors, builders, general public, Building Code Board of Appeals, Board of Supervisors, and others as requested;
  • Responsible for initial and updated training for Code Enforcement Officers to insure compliance with state requirements and performance standards set by the County;
  • Responsible for the care, maintenance, and cleanliness of any vehicle assigned, or in their care.
  • Prepares budget recommendations and administers the approved budget for Building Inspections.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in administrative management or technical and structural engineering.
  • Five years of progressively more responsible nature in construction and/or building inspection.
  • Additional education and/or training may be substituted where applicable.
  • Certifiable as a Building Official in the State of Virginia
  • Valid Virginia Drivers’ License and be insurable under the County’s policy.
  • Requires completion of National Incident Management System IS-700 and IS-100 within
  • 90 days of employment.
  • Requires completion of National Incident Management System IS-200 within 120 days of employment and ICS-300 within one year of employment (based on availability of scheduled classes).
  • Desirable: Three years of supervisory experience.



Core Skill Sets:

  • Thorough knowledge of state and local laws governing building construction, use and occupancy and the ability to apply this knowledge in the analysis and interpretation of construction plans and specifications;
  • Thorough knowledge of approved methods and materials used in building construction and allied structural and mechanical work;
  • Ability to interpret and enforce building codes firmly and tactfully and to establish and maintain effective working relationships with contractors, architects, property owners, employees and the public;
  • General understanding and ability to utilize the County’s adopted software platform, including Microsoft Office Suite products and system software run on the County’s AS 400 computer system.


General Service Areas/Conditions: Work is performed both indoors and outdoors where uncomfortable conditions exist. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Some nights and weekends could be required as needed.




Standard hours are Monday-Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

title: Senior Software Engineer – Go & Rust, Blockchain Infrastructure — QuickNode
description:
• Company: QuickNode
  • Location: United States
  • Sector: Blockchain
  • Source: web3.career

Quicknode is a cloud-based infrastructure company that powers the blockchain ecosystem.


Our mission is to be the indispensable utility that empowers companies and innovators globally to build next-generation, Web3 enabled businesses & applications using blockchain technology. Quicknode is backed by some of the world’s best investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, SoftBank, and the Seven Seven Six Fund. The Quicknode team has over 110 people maintaining high performance global data infrastructure for amazing customers serving billions of requests daily.


We are a global remote company with offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL and Lisbon, Portugal.


The Role


Quicknode deploys institutional-grade infrastructure – Core RPC API, Streams, Webhooks, Clusters, and developer tooling – across 80+ blockchain networks for teams building onchain. The Engineering team behind this infrastructure needs a senior individual contributor who can design, build, and improve the distributed systems that ingest, process, and serve blockchain data at scale, working across both Go and Rust.


This is a hands-on engineering and technical-leadership role for someone who moves comfortably between high-throughput Go services and performance- and security-critical Rust components. You will own complex systems from design through production and raise the engineering bar on reliability, performance, security, and operational quality.


This role reports into Engineering leadership for the Blockchain Infrastructure team and carries no direct reports at this level. As scope grows, you will take on larger system ownership, mentor other engineers, and help set engineering standards adopted across teams – a natural path toward Staff or Principal Engineer.


What You’ll Do


Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency backend services, APIs, and data-processing systems in both Go and Rust for production blockchain infrastructure.


Own production Go services and Rust components, including their architecture, interfaces, concurrency models, memory and resource efficiency, testing, observability, deployment, and operation.


Architect distributed systems that ingest, process, validate, and serve blockchain data with strong guarantees around consistency, fault tolerance, scalability, and availability.


Own technical work end to end, including requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.


Profile and benchmark production systems, identify bottlenecks, and improve throughput, latency, resource efficiency, resilience, and correctness under load.


Assess security risks in blockchain and distributed-system components and design or review controls that protect transactions, data, credentials, and system integrity.


Debug complex failures across services, databases, streaming systems, networks, and blockchain nodes, then drive durable root-cause fixes.


Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Experience teams to translate customer and protocol requirements into maintainable systems.


Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, document important decisions, and establish engineering standards that improve quality across teams.


What You’ll Bring


Minimum Qualifications:


8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in high-scale production environments.


Advanced professional proficiency in both Go and Rust, with demonstrated experience shipping and operating production software in each language. Go and Rust are both core requirements for this role, not interchangeable alternatives.


Deep knowledge of distributed systems, algorithms and data structures, concurrency, memory safety and ownership, databases, networking, operating systems, and production software architecture.


A record of delivering reliable, scalable systems with measurable improvements in performance, availability, correctness, or developer experience.


Experience with blockchain infrastructure, high-throughput APIs, node or RPC infrastructure, data-streaming pipelines, or similarly demanding distributed platforms.


Experience applying secure-design principles, threat modeling, and disciplined testing to systems where correctness and availability are critical.


Strong written and verbal communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead ambiguous, cross-team projects without constant direction.


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Ethereum, Solana, or other major blockchain protocols and their node, RPC, indexing, or transaction-processing architecture.


Experience designing clean interfaces between Go services and Rust systems, libraries, or performance-sensitive components.


Experience designing or reviewing cryptographic, wallet, signing, custody, or other security-sensitive systems.


Experience with streaming and data infrastructure such as Kafka, queues, event-driven services, distributed databases, or large-scale observability systems.


Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentorship, incident leadership, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams.


The Quicknode compensation philosophy includes pillars to ensure fair and unbiased compensation for all employees. To design and deliver total reward offerings that are employee-centric. To offer a competitive benefit package in all locations where we operate. To prioritize attracting and retaining the best talent globally. To maintain a high-performing and flexible way of working.


During the hiring process, we are committed to discussing compensation openly and honestly. We encourage candidates to share their salary expectations and requirements early, allowing for an individualized discussion. We know that our total rewards practices impact the lives and wellbeing of our employees. title: Bliv Kundedirektør i Private Banking København og stå i spidsen for et vigtigt vækstområde
description:
Bliv Kundedirektør i Private Banking København og stå i spidsen for et vigtigt vækstområde

Private Banking København fortsætter med at vækste, hvorfor vi nu søger yderligere en Kundedirektør

Du bliver en del af et strategisk vigtigt vækstområde i Nykredit, hvor du får ansvaret for at lede og udvikle et dygtigt team af Private Bankere og indgå i et lederteam på syv ledere. Sammen arbejder vi for at levere den bedste rådgivning og skabe de bedste kundeoplevelser. Vi søger dig, der ikke kun har evnerne, men også interessen for at opbygge og vedligeholde relationer, så vi i fællesskab skaber et godt samarbejde og gode relationer - både i teamet og på tværs i organisationen.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • sikre, at strategien bliver omsat til konkrete handlinger i teamet
  • fremme en feedback-kultur, hvor samarbejde og personlig såvel som faglig udvikling er i fokus
  • være med til at sikre, at Private Banking er forankret i sunde værdier og faglig ekspertise
  • skabe et engageret team, der arbejder målrettet på at optimere kundeoplevelserne
  • formidle tryghed og tillid, så både kunder og kolleger oplever dig som en tillidsskabende og troværdig leder.

**Er det dig, vi leder efter?
**Vi søger dig, som er motiveret, resultatorienteret og har en solid faglig og relevant baggrund. Din praktiske erfaring med at yde kvalificeret rådgivning til formuende kunder kombineret med din vilje til at tage kundeoplevelsen til næste niveau er vigtigt for os. Du har et godt analytisk blik og en struktureret tilgang, og med dine kommunikative evner og din oprigtige nysgerrighed er du i stand til at identificere dine medarbejderes færdigheder og bidrage til deres udvikling. Med din handleevne, medmenneskelighed og engagement skaber du resultater, der forandrer, nytænker og forbedrer vores relationer til kunderne, samtidig med at du bidrager til at realisere vores fælles mål om at skabe værdi, overblik og tryghed for vores kunder.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

**Dit nye team
**Du bliver en del af et team, som består af motiverede kolleger, herunder 66 Private Bankere, syv formuerådgivere og syv ledere. Derudover får du adgang til et stort team af investeringsrådgivere. Vi samarbejder bredt med kolleger i Nykredit, herunder både med Lokalbanker, International og Private Banking Elite. Hos os betyder godt humør, højt aktivitetsniveau og gode resultater meget, og du skal være indstillet på en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du sjældent sidder på den samme plads to dage i træk. Vi har en frisk og uformel omgangstone - og lægger vægt på et positivt mindset.

Du får fast arbejdssted i Charlottenlund, men vil fra vores lokalbanker få mulighed for at arbejde fra forskellige lokationer i Regionalbank København

**Vil du vide mere?
**Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Michael Sparring på tlf. 40 83 22 45 hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Michael Sparring | LinkedIn.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Ansøgningsfrist

16.10.2026

By

København

Vi er ikke helt som de andre

Nykredit-koncernen er nemlig ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det giver os bl.a. nogle særlige muligheder for at dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, fx gennem konkrete fordele, der gør det billigere at være kunde hos os. Det mærker man også i de lokalområder, vi er til stede i – fx når alle vores rådgivere i Nykredit og Spar Nord hvert år får et beløb til rådighed til at gøre en forskel for en lokal forening eller klub. Det kalder vi Det lokale løfte.

Som kollega mærker du også vores foreningsejerskab. Vi giver fx et medarbejderløfte, hvor vi lover udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. Du vil derfor opleve, at din leder er ambitiøs – ikke mindst på dine vegne – og er trænet i at støtte din udvikling og guide dig videre, når du er klar til næste skridt i din karriere. Selvfølgelig i Nykredit-koncernen.

På tværs af Nykredit og Spar Nord får du cirka 5.500 nye kolleger, der sammen skaber vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads. Det gør vi med en kultur, der er præget af holdånd, ligeværd og handlekraft. Og med målet om at give vores kunder markedets bedste oplevelser.

Dét er bare nogle af fordelene ved at være en del af vores foreningsejede arbejdsplads.

Nykredit-koncernen omfatter bl.a. følgende brands Nykredit, Spar Nord, Totalkredit, Nybolig og Sparinvest.

Læs mere om ansættelsesprocessen samt vores behandling af personoplysninger.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer / Python Engineer / Developer
description:
Job Title : Senior AI Platform Engineer / Python Engineer / Developer
Duration: 12 months+
Location: St. Louis, MO- Hybrid-3 days/week on site in St. Louis

Local or willing to relocate before starting (relo candidates will get second priority)
2 interviews. Second interview must be in person in St. Louis.

Job Description

Day-to-day

  • Lead the design and development of an enterprise AI platform that enables agentic workflows across structured and unstructured data. This hands-on role combines software development, platform architecture, AI strategy, and technical leadership to build scalable AI solutions and guide key technology decisions.
  • 3 must-have skills: experience w/ production agentic systems. implementing, monitoring, and evaluating those systems.
  • Nice-to-have skills: If they have worked with Agent Bricks in any meaningful capacity. Working with LangGraph. Self-motivated and willing to help other teammates. Not looking for someone who just wants to “shut up and code”

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to design, build, and operate enterprise AI solutions. You will help evolve our platform from Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications to agentic AI systems that leverage reasoning, orchestration, tool use, and autonomous workflows.

You will work closely with platform engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to build scalable, reliable, and measurable AI solutions. A key part of the role is ensuring AI systems can be evaluated, monitored, and operated successfully in production.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, deploy, and support production AI solutions.
  • Develop agentic workflows, tool integrations, and orchestration pipelines.
  • Build and evolve RAG and agent-based architectures.
  • Create evaluation frameworks to improve quality, groundedness, and reliability.
  • Implement AI observability, tracing, and monitoring capabilities.
  • Develop automated testing and regression validation processes.
  • Integrate AI solutions with APIs, enterprise applications, and data sources. Design reusable AI patterns, frameworks, and components that increase platform scalability and team productivity.
  • Establish engineering best practices and contribute to code reviews.
  • Research and adopt emerging AI technologies where they provide business value.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business problems into AI solutions

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade production software.
  • Strong Python development skills.
  • Experience building, deploying, and operating production AI systems.
  • Experience designing and implementing RAG solutions.
  • Experience with Databricks.
  • Hands‑on experience with LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience building AI workflows that leverage tools, APIs, and external systems.
  • Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and quality measurement.
  • Experience implementing AI observability and tracing solutions.
  • Understanding of agent architecture patterns, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation techniques.
  • Experience with AWS in production environments.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Knowledge of secure coding principles and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience collaborating within Agile software development teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AgentBricks.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot extensibility and agent development.
  • Experience with LangChain and related frameworks.
  • Experience with MCP integrations.
  • Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Grafana, MLflow, DeepEval, or similar tooling.
  • Experience deploying multi-agent systems.
  • Experience with Terraform.
  • AWS, Databricks, Microsoft, or AI-related certifications.

Mindset

  • Delivers AI solutions that create measurable business value.
  • Treats evaluation and observability as first-class engineering disciplines.
  • Balances innovation with reliability, scalability, and governance.
  • Takes ownership of production systems and outcomes.
  • Thinks holistically about data, architecture, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Continuously learns and adapts to evolving AI technologies.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work across multiple feature areas of Fortnite from season-to-season Battle Pass progression and engagement systems to the social overlay experience. This is a uniquely broad role that gives you the opportunity to shape several of Fortnite's most player-facing systems, partnering with cross-functional teams to define strategy, execute live operations, and drive meaningful outcomes across your portfolio.

In this role, you will

  • Drive initiatives across Battle Pass progression, seasonal engagement, and the Fortnite social gameplay systems, contributing to a cohesive player experience across feature areas
  • Partner with development teams to design, implement, and iterate on features that improve player retention, engagement, and long-term season health
  • Leverage insights from the analytics team to define measurable goals, track performance, and share updates with key stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to support go-to-market strategies and execution for seasonal launches and major content activations
  • Partner with product leadership to translate company direction into actionable plans across your portfolio of initiatives
  • Drive alignment across teams by clearly documenting and communicating product requirements, ensuring all stakeholders share a unified understanding of goals and execution plans

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in live operations for consumer-facing products or games
  • Comfort operating as a generalist with proven success managing multiple concurrent initiatives across a broad feature portfolio
  • A passion for games and a deep understanding of player retention, engagement, and progression mechanics
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and turn insights into actionable product decisions; SQL proficiency required
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience writing product requirement documents and presenting to senior stakeholders

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. title: Servicechef - Højbjerg
description:
Servicechef - Højbjerg

Servicechef

Servicechefen i føtex har det samlede ansvar for kundeservice, kasselinje og bagerudsalg, hvor daglig drift, stærk kundeoplevelse, høj butiksstandard og medarbejdertrivsel går hånd i hånd. Du sætter retningen for, hvordan området bidrager til varehusets resultater, og omsætter mål, koncepter og serviceprincipper til konkret adfærd i hverdagen. Som leder rekrutterer, motiverer og udvikler du ledere og medarbejdere, følger tæt op på trivsel og arbejdsmiljø og bygger en stærk kultur baseret på Salling Groups værdier. Du planlægger bemanding, sikrer fødevaresikkerhed og kvalitet og arbejder systematisk med kundefeedback – samtidig med at du tager aktivt del i driften på gulvet, er synlig og tilgængelig for dit team. Du refererer til varehuschefen og indgår i varehusets ledergruppe.

føtex er en af Danmarks største detailkæder og hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform. Du omsætter koncepter, driftskrav og best practice til konkrete arbejdsgange i afdelingerne, arbejder systematisk med kundefeedback og nøgletal som omsætning, svind, waste og lagerbeholdning og sætter ind, når der er afvigelser. Gennem tæt samarbejde, god koordinering og stakeholder management opnår du effektive løsninger, rutiner og standarder for driften i varehuset. Du deltager selv aktivt i driften, fx med vareopfyldning og opfølgninger i afdelingerne. Du træner, onboarder og understøtter varehusets ledere og medarbejdere i driftsprocedurer og nye systemer. Driftschefen refererer til varehuschefen, indgår i ledergruppen og samarbejder tæt med regionens fagkonsulent for drift om at løfte både varehusets og regionens resultater.

føtex er en af Danmarks største detailkæder og hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform. Som medarbejder hos føtex bliver din rygsæk fyldt med erfaringer – dem kan du bruge nu, sammen med os, men også senere hen i din karriere. Det er alene dig som sætter begrænsningen for din udvikling – her er der højt til loftet og mange muligheder. Stillingen som Driftschef inviterer til målrettet arbejde med din personlige- og faglige udvikling.

Med et spændende job som Driftschef indgår bl.a. følgende fordele:

  • en arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab hvor der er plads til alle og til at være præcis den du er. Du vil med andre ord også kunne skabe dig et godt socialt netværk og møde nye venner.
  • gode løn- og arbejdsvilkår
  • en lang række uddannelses- og kursusmuligheder som vil styrke din personlige såvel som faglige udvikling
  • et hav af medarbejdergoder, bl.a.: personalerabatter (føtex, Bilka, Salling, Starbucks m.fl.) og interne og eksterne rabatordninger
  • God, sund og professionel virksomhedskultur
  • Fremragende muligheder for at gøre karriere i Salling Group

Vi mangler en ny Driftschef og hvis du er nysgerrig, så skal det nu handle om dig!

For at komme i spil til vores spændende stilling kan du levere:

  • Du er tillidsfuld, ærlig og respektfuld. Du har en forbilledlig adfærd, går forrest og viser medarbejderne vejen.

  • Du udviser stort engagement og vægter kundeservice og medarbejder trivsel- og udvikling højt. Du bidrager med god energi og sætter et positivt præg på dit arbejde og dine kollegaer.

  • Du er tilpasningsdygtig og bevidst om, at vi aldrig stopper med at lære

  • Du har viljen og arbejder benhårdt for, at du og dit hold lykkes og skaber de bedst mulige resultater.

  • Du arbejder effektivt og søger gerne løsninger for at optimere effektiviteten

Du er empatisk, inkluderende og har høj integritet. Du forstår vigtigheden i af godt samarbejde og god kommunikation. Du er ansvarsfuld og tillidsskabende.

**Er du klar til at sende din ansøgning afsted?**Hvis du stadig er nysgerrig på de mange muligheder føtex kan tilbyde, og er klar til at give den fuld gas i føtex’ blå skjorte, så klik på linket nedenfor og lad os høre mere om, hvem du er. Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig.

Ønsker du at din jobansøgning behandles fortroligt og alene må ses af People and Culture og den rekrutterende leder til en konkret stilling du søger er det vigtigt, at du gør os opmærksom på det. Position: Seasonal Ambassador

Contract Role

Seasonal Ambassador

Seasonal Ambassadors at Lush are experts in product and brand knowledge, as well as providing exceptional customer consultations and product demonstrations. Seasonal Ambassadors cultivate strong team relationships and contribute to overall shop excellence in both sales and operations. On the shop floor, they consistently surpass daily sales goals while creating a fun and inclusive team environment that keeps customers coming back for more.

We encourage you to put yourself in the customer's shoes and think about what would make their day. Whether it's providing personalized product recommendations or sharing your knowledge and expertise, you have the power to create a unique and memorable experience for every shopper.

For our Seasonal Ambassadors, it's not just about selling soap – it's about making a positive impact on the world, one bar at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales and Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize StoreForce dashboard results and seek feedback to exceed sales goals. Take ownership of your results and actively work to grow your contribution to the store’s overall sales.
  • Customer Experience: Consistently deliver a world-class customer experience to every customer who walks through our doors. Connect with customers and identify their needs by listening attentively and asking open-ended questions. Show off our amazing products by demonstrating their unique benefits and features. Seek opportunities to make customers' day and leave the world Lusher than we found it.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on our brand values including our stance on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging. Expertly articulate these values in the shop and through community engagement by hosting store parties and other initiatives that help bring in more traffic. Spread the word about what makes Lush unique, and inspire others to join us in making a positive impact on the world!
  • Product Passion: Continually expand your product knowledge with ongoing learning and diving deep into all things Lush. Stay up-to-date on our products, ingredients, and unique benefits to confidently and consistently make informed product recommendations for every customer's needs.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Utilize Lush resources to develop effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve your performance, support the growth of your team, and increase sales. Take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge, and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members’ perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Time and Attendance: Be punctual, reliable, and present at work. Actively participate in teamwork, prioritize your wellbeing by taking breaks when necessary, and keep up-to-date with company news and updates.

  • Flexibility to adapt to changing situations and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

  • Experience working in a team environment

title: Railcar Repair Technician
description:
Build Your Career With a Team That Keeps America Moving

Cypress Rail Solutions is hiring Railcar Repair Technicians to support railcar inspection, maintenance, and repair operations in the field. This role is part of our Vermillion Team and offers hands‑on work, variety in job locations, and the opportunity to grow your skills alongside experienced rail professionals.


Whether you’re building your railcar repair experience or bringing a strong mechanical background to the field, this is a chance to work with a stable company that values safety, skill, and teamwork.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform mobile railcar repairs under the guidance of a lead or Level 2 technician
  • Remove and replace brake systems, couplers, draft gears, air hoses, valves, and fittings
  • Repair or replace structural components including side posts, floors, panels, piping, and underframes
  • Weld, burn, straighten, patch, and install steel components using proper tools and procedures
  • Stencil letters and numbers and prepare railcars for painting
  • Inspect, clean, and maintain railcar surfaces and components
  • Safely move, position, and handle heavy equipment and railcar parts
  • Assist with switching, ground operations, and track mobile equipment as trained
  • Follow all safety rules, FRA, AAR, and company procedures

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and hands‑on repair skills
  • Welding and machine experience preferred
  • Ability to read and follow safety rules, work instructions, and procedures
  • Willingness to learn rail industry rules and regulations
  • Reliable, safety‑focused, and able to work independently or as part of a team
  • Comfortable working outdoors, on uneven surfaces, and in varying weather conditions
  • Able to travel daily (50%+) and work flexible hours as job demands change
  • Railcar repair experience is a plus but not required—training will be provided for qualified candidates
  • CDL preferred

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Full‑time, stable employment
  • Mobile work that offers variety and field experience
  • On‑the‑job training and skill development
  • Supportive leadership and team‑driven culture
  • Competitive pay based on experience and comprehensive benefits

Join a company where your work matters, your skills are valued, and your effort helps keep rail freight moving safely across the country.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities but are not limited to:

  • Stencil letters and numbers on cars.
  • Fasten parts of car using impact wrench or hydraulic bolt fastener for riveting.
  • Remove and replace brake assemblies and brake shoes.
  • Remove and replace uncoupling lever.
  • Repair or replace steel sections such as side posts, rafters, crossties, panels, under framing, and piping using welding torch, electric welder, power wrench, and hand tools.
  • Replace and/or repair gaskets, air hose, train line, etc., as required.
  • Straighten and/or replace grab irons, handholds, still steps on cars.
  • Maintain, repair, or replace air brake pipes, valves, fitting, or other appurtenances.
  • Remove and replace couplers, draft gears, and yokes.
  • Clean and prepare surfaces of railroad cars or cabooses to be painted.
  • Repair freight car sides, ends, doors and floors by burning, straightening, or patching.
  • Pull, push, and position heavy equipment or car components when making or completing repairs.
  • Other duties as assigned by foreman/manager.
  • Ability to throw/align a switch.
  • Ability to be trained as track mobile operator and/or groundman.

Competencies:

To perform this job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Good mechanical background will be required to become conversant with the General Code of Operating Rules, Safety Rules, AAR Rules and regulations, and FRA requirements.
  • Welding and machine experience preferred.
  • Apply principles of rational systems to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Be able to read and understand safety rules, instructions in the use and maintenance of shop tools and equipment, and methods and procedures in mechanical drawing and layout work.


Physical Demands:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the physical demands listed below:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform on uneven or slippery surfaces, platforms, ladders, equipment in all weather and temperature conditions. Most of the day could be spent on feet standing. Eye/hand coordination, hand/feet dexterity and grasping hand tools, materials & equipment is required. The employee is frequently required to perform manual labor & physical activities that require considerable use of the whole body, such as standing and lifting from various levels.
  • Additional physical demands are listed in the chart below.

Environmental:

  • Continuous: Standing on concrete.
  • Occasional: Vibration, noise, hot or cold temperature extremes, work at heights, uneven surfaces, shift work, paperwork, travel, smoke & dust, paint, cramped quarters & moving machinery.
  • Wash rail cars outside in all weather conditions.
  • Must wear correct PPE and masks for identified jobs and painting.


Education and Training:

  • GED or higher.
  • Must have and maintain an insurable driving status which includes but is not limited to CRS driver provisions.

Our comprehensive pre-employment process ensures the well-being and integrity of our team. To join our organization, candidates are required to:

1.  Pass a mandatory drug test to maintain a drug-free workplace. Random, reasonable suspicion and post-accident testing may also be required throughout employment.

title: Programmer
description:
Position Summary

The Programmer role is to aid the engineering department by using computer software to program various machines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Utilizes MasterCam and VeriCut software to develop programs to control contour-path machining of metal parts on 3 through 5 axis machine tools.
  • Utilize CAD/CAM software to program fixtures and to develop drawings and bill of materials for the construction of tools of varying complexity and type.
  • Tooling includes holding fixtures, drill jigs, form blocks, check fixtures.
  • Provide and create cnc programs, tool designs and concepts to achieve end item product build and production rate working within engineering and quality specifications.
  • Analyzes drawings, part design data and tooling methods to determine proper tool path, selection of cutting tools, and machine speeds and feed rates, according to knowledge of machine shop processes, part specifications, and machine capabilities.
  • Ensures conformance to established procedures and quality level.
  • Work with shop floor leadership and personnel in the execution of new product development.
  • Policy and conformance to Customer Engineering and Specifications.
  • Create computerized setup documents, including all tool requirements and CNC programs.
  • Continuous improvement of Cutting methods to reduce cost and improve quality.
  • Suggest changes to process or product design to simplify tooling and reduce cost.
  • Must work with Production to determine type and sequence of operations related to tooling and production operations.
  • Creates fixture setup documents and planning outlines for CNC programming.
  • Ongoing self-training to increase personal effectiveness.
  • Regularly report status of tasks and projects.
  • Maintain records to organize and report status of personal backlog, and of tasks/project.

Position Requirements

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • NC programming in MasterCam required.
  • Experience in the use of VeriCut machine simulation and verification software.
  • Working knowledge of aerospace engineering models, drawings and specifications.
  • Requires 3+ years CAD/CAM experience programming aerospace structural components manufactured from all types of metallic materials.
  • Working knowledge of cnc machine controls and basic G-code.
  • Strong machining background with cutting tool speeds and feeds required for aerospace metallic materials.
  • Ability to design, program fixtures and tooling.
  • Desire to service internal and external customers.
  • Ability to handle diverse assignments from technical analysis to economic justification, to data entry.
  • BS degree in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering or Equivalent Work Experience in programming and CNC Machining.

Role Title: Public Safety Communications Dispatcher

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging Public Safety Communications Dispatcher experts to contribute to a high-impact customer project involving real-time request coordination and routing. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity suits dispatchers and coordinators experienced in any area of public safety communications—including 911, police, ambulance, emergency, and fire services—who excel at prioritizing incident requests, communicating clearly, and following standardized protocols.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and triage incoming incident or service requests, promptly determining priority levels based on established criteria.
  2. Route requests to appropriate resources or agencies using clear, efficient communication via simulated radio, phone, or digital chat channels.
  3. Maintain composure and accuracy when handling multiple simultaneous communication channels, ensuring critical information is relayed without delay.
  4. Apply standardized protocols and checklists to ensure consistent, protocol-driven responses in all scenarios.
  5. Document scenarios and decision-making processes to provide valuable input for AI training datasets.
  6. Offer insights into workflow optimization, escalation procedures, and multi-channel coordination for public safety environments.
  7. Participate in periodic feedback reviews to enhance the relevance and quality of training data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated expertise as a dispatcher or coordinator in public safety environments (e.g., 911, police, ambulance, emergency, or fire services).
  2. Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests under pressure.
  3. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, especially in fast-paced settings.
  4. Experience with radio, phone, and digital chat communication platforms.
  5. Strong grasp of standardized operating procedures, checklists, and escalation protocols common to public safety communications.
  6. Ability to remain calm, focused, and detail-oriented in dynamic scenarios.
  7. Familiarity with documenting incident details, actions taken, and rationale for decisions as part of routine processes.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Skills: Prioritization and triage of requests under pressure, Clear, concise communication (radio/phone/chat), Handling multiple channels simultaneously (multitasking), Applying standardized protocols/checklists
